Connaissance des règles de sécurité
Maîtrise des normes qualité

Précis et méthodique, le tourneur est également apte à effectuer des calculs, à visualiser des volumes dans l'espace et à répondre aux objectifs de production. Il ne redoute pas les tâches répétitives et le travail en station debout prolongée, souvent posté.
Informations pratiques :

Type de contrat : Temps plein de 39h avec possibilité d'heures supplémentaires
Horaires : En journée
Rémunération : Entre 28K€ et 32K€, selon profil et expérience

Si vous êtes passionné(e) par votre métier et que vous souhaitez rejoindre une équipe dynamique, n'hésitez pas à postuler dès maintenant !

jobs.title: Responsable Support IT H/F
jobs.description:
L'ENTREPRISE ACCOMPAGNÉE ET LES MISSIONS
Notre client est une entreprise du secteur FinTech qui développe des solutions de paiement utilisées par des acteurs internationaux.
À Nantes, au sein de l'équipe Tech & Product, vous rejoindrez une équipe IT répartie sur deux sites et contribuerez au bon fonctionnement d'un parc d'environ 280 postes. Le poste offre un environnement technique varié et une vraie proximité avec les sujets infrastructure, sécurité et workplace.
Les missions
Vous serez le point de référence technique de l'équipe support et contribuez à garantir un service IT fiable et efficace auprès des collaborateurs. Votre quotidien s'articule autour de plusieurs sujets :
- Piloter le fonctionnement du parc informatique : postes de travail, téléphonie, périphériques et équipements réseau.
- Participer aux déploiements, installations, mises à jour et opérations de maintenance.
- Administrer les comptes, les accès et les environnements liés à l'Active Directory et à la messagerie.
- Contribuer aux sujets IAM et à l'amélioration de la gouvernance des accès.
- Prendre en charge les incidents les plus complexes et accompagner les membres de l'équipe dans leur résolution.
- Être le référent technique sur les problématiques liées aux systèmes, au hardware et au réseau.
- Veiller à la qualité du traitement des tickets et au respect des bonnes pratiques dans l'outil de support.
- Suivre le parc et le cycle de vie des équipements.
- Participer au suivi des indicateurs de performance du support.
- Garantir l'application des standards de sécurité sur les postes de travail et contribuer aux audits.
- Identifier les améliorations possibles dans les processus et les outils du support.
- Formaliser les procédures et enrichir la documentation technique afin de faciliter le partage de connaissances.
- Accompagner la montée en compétence de l'équipe et favoriser la diffusion des bonnes pratiques.
- L'environnement technique
- Systèmes : Linux (Ubuntu / Debian), macOS; Réseau : Cisco; Identités & collaboration : Active Directory, Google Workspace; Sécurité : ESET Protect
- Gestion du parc : GLPI, OCS, Patch management : NinjaOne; Ticketing : Jira
Pourquoi les rejoindre ?
Les enjeux de disponibilité, de sécurité et de fiabilité des systèmes sont particulièrement importants.
Le poste permet surtout de sortir d'un rôle de support réactif : vous aurez un rôle dans l'amélioration du fonctionnement du support, la structuration des pratiques et la montée en compétence de l'équipe.
Vous évoluerez également dans un environnement technique diversifié, avec des problématiques allant du poste de travail au réseau, en passant par les systèmes, les accès et la sécurité.


PROFIL
Le profil recherché
- Vous disposez d'une expérience confirmée dans le support IT, l'administration systèmes ou l'infrastructure, avec une appétence particulière pour les environnements poste de travail.
- Vous avez une solide maîtrise de Linux, idéalement sur Ubuntu ou Debian, et êtes également à l'aise dans des environnements Windows et macOS.
- Vous savez intervenir sur des problématiques hardware et réseau, analyser rapidement un incident et identifier le bon niveau de priorité.
- Vous êtes également à l'aise avec la documentation technique et avez le réflexe de formaliser les solutions et les bonnes pratiques.
- Votre sens du service, votre pédagogie et votre capacité à communiquer avec des interlocuteurs variés seront essentiels dans ce poste.
Au-delà de votre expertise technique, vous avez envie de jouer un rôle de référent auprès d'une équipe : partager vos connaissances, faire progresser les pratiques et accompagner vos collègues dans la résolution des problématiques complexes.
Enfin, vous appréciez les environnements où l'on attend de vous de l'autonomie, de la proactivité et une démarche d'amélioration continue.


AVANTAGES
Vos conditions de travail
- Rémunération : 50 000€ brut annuel
- Localisation : Ile de Nantes
- Remote 2 jours par semaine
- Process de recrutement
- Un entretien avec un consultant Externatic
- Un rendez-vous RH
- Un deuxième échange avec le lead tech

jobs.description:
DESCRIPTION

Rattaché au Responsable SAV, vous prenez en charge la préparation et la réalisation des interventions techniques. Vous analysez les dysfonctionnements, établissez les diagnostics nécessaires et mettez en œuvre les actions correctives adaptées afin de garantir le bon fonctionnement des installations de sécurité.
Vos principales missions comprennent notamment :

- L'accompagnement des clients grâce à des conseils techniques et à la formation sur les systèmes installés.
- En complément de vos missions techniques, vous intervenez en appui du Responsable SAV sur les dossiers et chantiers complexes. Vous participez au suivi des interventions en termes de qualité, de coûts et de délais et assurez la continuité de l'activité en prenant le relais lors de ses absences.
- Vous êtes également impliqué dans le suivi administratif de l'activité à travers la rédaction des bons d'intervention, l'établissement de devis techniques et la transmission régulière des documents nécessaires au bon fonctionnement du service.


EXIGENCES
Notre client recherche un candidat disposant d'une expérience professionnelle de 3 à 4 ans dans un poste similaire et titulaire d'une formation de niveau Bac à Bac+2.
Vous possédez de solides connaissances techniques dans le domaine de la sécurité électronique et êtes capable d'intervenir avec autonomie sur des installations variées. Votre maîtrise des équipements et votre capacité à résoudre des problématiques techniques constituent des atouts essentiels pour réussir dans cette fonction.
Les compétences recherchées incluent notamment :
- Une maîtrise technique des systèmes de sécurité électronique et des métiers associés.
- Des connaissances en électronique, en réseaux et en informatique.
- La capacité à diagnostiquer efficacement les pannes et à proposer des solutions adaptées.
- La maîtrise des opérations de paramétrage, de programmation et de mise en service des équipements.
- Au-delà des compétences techniques, nous recherchons une personne sérieuse, organisée et rigoureuse, dotée d'un excellent sens de la relation client. Votre capacité d'analyse, votre sens de la communication et votre aptitude à travailler en équipe seront déterminants pour accompagner les clients et soutenir efficacement le Responsable SAV.
- Le poste implique des déplacements dans le cadre d'une mobilité départementale.


AVANTAGES
Notre client propose un contrat à durée indéterminée (CDI) au sein d'une structure reconnue pour son expertise dans les domaines de la sécurité électronique et de la sécurité incendie.
Ce poste offre l'opportunité de rejoindre un environnement technique stimulant, au sein duquel vous pourrez mettre à profit vos compétences tout en développant progressivement votre niveau de responsabilité au sein du service après-vente.
- Rémunération : 2 570 € bruts mensuels.

- Prime d'astreinte de 150€ brut Max
- Indemnité repas
- % sur vente si vente lors d'une intervention
- Temps de travail : 39 heures par semaine.
- Mise à disposition des moyens nécessaires à l'exercice des missions : ordinateur, téléphone, véhicule, outillage et documentation technique.
- Participation active à des projets variés dans un secteur en constante évolution.

- Sablage / microbillage
- 3. Finition et conformité esthétique

- Peinture au pistolet

- Bonne maîtrise des outillages de contrôle dimensionnel

jobs.title: Ingénieur / Ingénieure d'étude et développement informatique (H/F)
jobs.description:
Chez Thales, nous sommes fiers de travailler ensemble pour imaginer des solutions innovantes qui contribuent à construire un avenir plus sûr, plus vert et plus inclusif. Un avenir de confiance. Mais ces technologies ne viennent pas de nulle part. L'intelligence humaine est le moteur derrière la technologie qui fait la renommée de Thales. Les projets que nous conduisons sont complexes et nos clients exigeants. Pour répondre aux besoins actuels et futurs de nos clients, nous maîtrisons plus d'une centaine de disciplines, de l'optique à la physique quantique, du traitement du signal à la connectivité et à l'intelligence artificielle. Rejoindre Thales, c'est repousser les limites de la technologie et la mettre au service du progrès et du développement durable de nos sociétés. C'est donc être au cœur d'une formidable aventure technique. Une attention portée à l'équilibre des collaborateurs au service de leur réussite. C'est pourquoi, notamment, nous nous efforçons de créer un environnement de travail accueillant et d'accorder la flexibilité nécessaire à l'équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie personnelle. Nous savons que cet équilibre est essentiel à votre épanouissement et à la réussite des projets que nous vous confierons. Des parcours professionnels riches. Chez Thales, nous jouons collectif. Ce qui signifie travailler en équipe, côtoyer des experts et donc apprendre et développer ses compétences en permanence tout en faisant bénéficier le Groupe de son savoir-faire. C'est aussi la possibilité d'évoluer, de changer de fonction ou d'activité, voire de pays.

    Lieu : Carquefou, France

    Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance

    Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d'activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l'environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d'euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l'innovation tels que l'IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays.  

    Nos engagements, vos avantages

     * Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée
     * Un package de rémunération attractif
     * Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes
     * Un environnement inclusif, bienveillant et respectant l'équilibre des collaborateurs
     * Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu

    Votre quotidien

    En nous rejoignant à Carquefou, à proximité de Nantes, vous intégrez un site dynamique regroupant nos activités de services numériques permettant d'opérer les systèmes d'informations critiques de nos clients et de les accompagner dans leur transformation numérique sécurisée.

    De formation Bac +5 en informatique ou développement logiciel (école d'ingénieur, Master ou équivalent), vous justifiez d'une expérience réussie dans le domaine du DevOps.

    Vous maîtrisez les outils de Build & Release (Git, Maven, Gradle, Jenkins, Nexus, SonarQube) et êtes à l'aise avec les principaux cloud providers (Google Cloud, AWS et Azure), aussi bien sur les instances que sur les services managés.

    Vous êtes également capable de justifier vos choix de solutions cloud sur les volets opérationnels et financiers.

    Des connaissances en Ansible et Kubernetes seraient un plus.

    Pour réussir dans cette fonction, vous êtes rigoureux(se), doté(e) d'un bon relationnel et appréciez le travail en équipe.

    Vous avez le sens de l'engagement ?
    Vous êtes force de proposition ?
    

    Le poste d'Ingénieur DevOps Cloud (H/F) est fait pour vous !

    CE QUE NOUS POUVONS ACCOMPLIR ENSEMBLE

    Au sein du centre de compétences de Nantes, vous intervenez sur des projets innovants et concevez les automatismes du système d'information : intégration, tests automatisés et déploiement continu.

jobs.title: Senior Consultant - Transformation & Business Analytics (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Du möchtest komplexe Transformationsprojekte nicht nur verwalten, sondern inhaltlich voranbringen und ihre Ergebnisse sichtbar mitgestalten?

Novemcore ist eine spezialisierte, wachsende Unternehmensberatung an der Schnittstelle von Finance, Data und Automation. Wir unterstützen Unternehmen dabei, Prozesse und Daten transparent zu machen, die Unternehmenssteuerung zu verbessern und anspruchsvolle Transformationen erfolgreich umzusetzen.

Für unsere Kundenprojekte suchen wir einen erfahrenen Senior Consultant (m/w/d), der strukturierte Projektsteuerung mit analytischer Stärke und einem guten Verständnis für Prozesse, Kennzahlen und digitale Lösungen verbindet. Zu Beginn arbeitest du insbesondere an einem unternehmensweiten Transformationsprojekt bei einem führenden Logistikunternehmen und übernimmst dort frühzeitig sichtbare Verantwortung.

Aufgaben

Bei uns übernimmst du eine vielseitige Rolle mit direktem Kundenkontakt und echtem Gestaltungsspielraum:

  • Du steuerst anspruchsvolle Transformationsprojekte und koordinierst Arbeitspakete, Meilensteine, Abhängigkeiten, Risiken und Entscheidungsbedarfe.
  • Du begleitest die Konsolidierung von Daten, Prozessen, Systemen und Verantwortlichkeiten.
  • Du bereitest Projekt- und Steering-Termine vor, entwickelst belastbare Entscheidungsvorlagen und hältst vereinbarte Maßnahmen konsequent nach.
  • Du analysierst operative und kaufmännische Prozesse und leitest konkrete Verbesserungsmaßnahmen ab.
  • Du entwickelst KPI-Frameworks und definierst Kennzahlen einschließlich Berechnungslogik, Datenquellen, Verantwortlichkeiten und Zielwerten.
  • Du erhebst und strukturierst fachliche Anforderungen und übersetzt sie in klare Prozesse, User Stories und Lösungskonzepte.
  • Du konzipierst Power-BI-Dashboards – von der Managementfrage und KPI-Definition über Mock-ups und Drill-down-Logiken bis zur fachlichen Abnahme.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit Management, Fachbereichen sowie Data- und IT-Teams zusammen und sorgst für eine klare Kommunikation zwischen den Beteiligten.
  • Du bereitest Analyseergebnisse adressatengerecht auf und entwickelst daraus konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen.

PMO bedeutet bei uns nicht reine Administration: Du schaffst Struktur, treibst Entscheidungen voran und arbeitest gleichzeitig inhaltlich an den zentralen Fragestellungen des Projekts mit.

Qualifikation

Wir suchen eine analytisch starke und umsetzungsorientierte Persönlichkeit, die auch in komplexen Projektumfeldern den Überblick behält und Themen selbstständig voranbringt.

Das solltest du mitbringen:

  • Mindestens vier Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung, idealerweise in einer Unternehmensberatung, Big-Four-Gesellschaft, Inhouse-Beratung oder vergleichbaren Transformationsfunktion
  • Erfahrung in der Steuerung eigener Workstreams mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern
  • Sehr gutes Verständnis von Geschäftsprozessen, Business Analytics, KPI-Systemen und datenbasierter Unternehmenssteuerung
  • Erfahrung in der strukturierten Erhebung und Übersetzung fachlicher Anforderungen
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Excel und PowerPoint
  • Erfahrung mit Power BI – mindestens in der fachlichen Konzeption, idealerweise auch in der Umsetzung
  • Eine ausgesprochen strukturierte, zuverlässige und selbstständige Arbeitsweise
  • Souveränes Auftreten und die Fähigkeit, komplexe Sachverhalte sowohl auf operativer Ebene als auch gegenüber dem Management verständlich zu vermitteln
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse
  • Hohe Einsatzbereitschaft und Bereitschaft zu regelmäßiger Reisetätigkeit

Besonders freuen wir uns über Erfahrung in Logistik, Operations oder Supply Chain sowie Kenntnisse in Stammdatenmanagement, Data Governance, SAP oder Salesforce. Diese Punkte sind jedoch keine zwingende Voraussetzung.

Benefits

Was dich bei Novemcore erwartet:

  • Verantwortung ab dem ersten Tag und sichtbarer Einfluss auf konkrete Projektergebnisse
  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit Entscheidern und Führungskräften unserer Kunden
  • Anspruchsvolle und abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben an der Schnittstelle von Transformation, Prozessen, Daten und Technologie
  • Viel Gestaltungsspielraum in einem kleinen, wachsenden Unternehmen
  • Die Möglichkeit, neben Kundenprojekten auch die weitere Entwicklung von Novemcore aktiv mitzugestalten
  • Kurze Entscheidungswege, direkter Austausch und Zusammenarbeit ohne starre Hierarchien
  • Eine steile fachliche und persönliche Entwicklung durch unmittelbare Kundennähe und vielfältige Verantwortungsbereiche
  • Flexible Arbeitsgestaltung außerhalb notwendiger Vor-Ort-Termine und Kundenworkshops
  • Die Perspektive, schrittweise Verantwortung für eigene Projekte, Kundenbeziehungen und Teammitglieder zu übernehmen

Wir suchen niemanden, der lediglich Aufgaben verwaltet oder vorgegebene Analysen abarbeitet. Wir suchen eine Persönlichkeit, die mitdenkt, Verantwortung übernimmt und gemeinsam mit uns und unseren Kunden anspruchsvolle Themen voranbringt.

Du musst nicht jeden einzelnen Pluspunkt bereits erfüllen. Entscheidend sind für uns dein analytischer Anspruch, deine Fähigkeit zur strukturierten Projektarbeit und dein Wille, sichtbare Ergebnisse zu schaffen.

Wenn du diese Haltung mitbringst und Lust darauf hast, in einem kleinen Unternehmen wirklich etwas mitzugestalten, freuen wir uns auf deinen Lebenslauf und einige kurze Sätze zu deiner Motivation. Bitte nenne uns außerdem deinen frühestmöglichen Starttermin und deine Gehaltsvorstellung.

jobs.title: Team Support
jobs.description:
Help shape the everyday experience of Supercell’s growing London office. This is a hands-on role for someone who loves making things happen, supporting great teams, and taking real ownership in an environment where no two days look quite the same.

Supercell is looking for a Team Support professional to join our London office. As Team Support, you’ll take ownership of the day-to-day support of the office, from travel and team events to the countless practical details that keep things running smoothly.

You’ll be the only Team Support based in London, so this is a role with plenty of independence and responsibility. But you won’t be doing it alone. You’ll be part of an experienced, caring Team Support team across Supercell, with colleagues to learn from and collaborate with. You’ll have the freedom to shape how support works locally, while staying closely connected with your colleagues in Helsinki and collaborating also with other people working with London operations.

At Supercell, independent teams and trust are at the heart of how we work. The same applies to Team Support: you’ll have real ownership of your area and the freedom to decide how best to support the people around you. Most importantly, you’ll have the opportunity to make a visible difference to the experience of everyone working in our London office.

If you enjoy helping people and figuring things out without needing a playbook for everything, you’ll probably feel at home here. Send your CV as well as your application / motivational letter before the application deadline (Thursday, September 17th 2026 9:00 pm BST).

What You'll Be Doing

  • Own the day-to-day administrative support for our London office.

  • Coordinate travel arrangements, including flights, accommodation, ground transportation, and the details in between.

  • Plan and organise team days, offsites, internal events, and other moments that bring people together.

  • Help colleagues navigate everyday practical questions, from benefits to general team support.

  • Work closely with Team Support colleagues in Helsinki and with teams operating across London and Helsinki, including our live game teams Clash of Clans and Hay Day.

  • Be a trusted local point of contact for colleagues, leads, and other stakeholders in London.

  • Spot opportunities to improve how things work and take ownership of putting better solutions in place.

What You Have

  • Strong experience (minimum of 5 years) in team support, workplace or office coordination, travel arrangements, and/or event production.

  • A service-minded approach and genuine enjoyment of helping others succeed.

  • Excellent organisational skills and close attention to detail. When you take something on, people can trust that it will get done.

  • The ability to manage several priorities at once and make good calls about what needs attention first.

  • Confidence working independently and taking responsibility, including in situations where there isn’t an existing process or obvious answer.

  • Strong communication skills in English and the ability to build trusted relationships with people across teams, disciplines, and locations.

  • A collaborative and humble way of working, with a willingness to ask for input, share context, and step in where you can help.

  • Enthusiasm and preferably also previous experience for working in an international environment with colleagues across multiple countries or offices.

  • You're actively using AI tools in your day-to-day work, and excited about experimenting with new ways AI can improve how we work.

Would Be Nice if You Also Have

  • Experience supporting a growing office or building support practices in an environment that is still evolving.

  • Experience coordinating complex international travel.

Where You'll Be

This role is based in our London studio and is a full-time, permanent position.

Because this role is all about supporting the people and everyday life in the office, we expect you to spend most of your working time onsite in our London office. You’ll also work closely with our Helsinki-based Team Support colleagues and teams whose members are split across London and Helsinki, so expect some travel also between our offices.

–––

That's it about the role! Below, we've gathered some things we feel are important for you to know. Totally optional, but a highly recommended read.

Once you're ready to apply, just send us your application through the form on the bottom of the page.

–––

About Supercell

Supercell is a games company from Helsinki, Finland, with offices also in San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, and London. You might know us as the makers of Hay Day, Clash of Clans, Boom Beach, Clash Royale, and Brawl Stars. Our mission is to create great games that as many people as possible play for years and that are remembered forever.

So, how do we make great games? By putting together the best teams and giving them the freedom and independence to succeed. And by taking risks, failing, sharing learnings, and killing lots of projects.

Hey, You Might Love It Here!

Independent cells and trust are at the core of our culture. But it takes more than that to make great games. We take good care of our people, providing them with the compensation, work environment, and resources they need to succeed while having fun along the way.

You Are Not Your Job Title ™

Here, you won’t need to focus on chasing titles or climbing ladders. Internally, our job titles don’t include prefixes like Senior, Junior, Principal, or Director. Recognition isn’t tied to your title, as it doesn't define the impact you can have around here.

Benefits and Compensation

Luring you in with glitter, glamour, and gems isn't what we're about. We want you to enjoy your time here fully, so we structure our compensation and benefits with that in mind. It starts with perceiving you as a human being, not a resource.

Not Sure if You Should Apply?

Many candidates with great skills and experience second-guess themselves. The bar is high, but if this role excites you, apply! We’re here to help you succeed. Also, we're happy to learn about any specific accommodations you may need to fully engage in our recruitment process.

Wishing you all the best,
The Supercell Recruitment team

jobs.title: Senior Customer Success Manager - Financial Services
jobs.description:
Senior Customer Success Manager - Financial Services

WHO WE ARE

At Trustly, we're building a smarter, faster, and more secure financial future by revolutionizing the world of payments. As a global leader in Open Banking Payments, we are establishing Pay by Bank as the new standard at checkout, providing unparalleled freedom, speed, and ease to millions of consumers and merchants worldwide.

Our Ambition: To build the world’s most disruptive payment network and redefine what the payment experience should feel like.

Trustly is a global team of innovators, collaborators, and doers. If you are driven by a strong sense of purpose and thrive in a dynamic, entrepreneurial, and high-growth environment, join us and be part of a team that’s transforming the way the world pays.


About the team

The Customer Success Team helps merchants get the most value out of Trustly, driving adoption of our products among their end users. We take a proactive, consultative approach, understanding each merchant's technology and strategy in order to drive mutual success.


About the role
The Senior Customer Success Manager will own a portfolio of Trustly's most strategic financial services merchants, with a strong focus on continuously optimising how these merchants use Trustly's products to maximize performance and value.

Financial services merchants operate in a demanding environment: high transaction volumes, tight margins, complex regulatory requirements, and end users who expect seamless, reliable payment experiences. This role is about going beyond maintaining the relationship, proactively identifying where performance can be improved, benchmarking merchants against peers and potential, and driving the changes needed to unlock that value.

The role demands a strong combination of technical and commercial skills, and close collaboration with Sales, Account Management, and Product.

This role is based in either our London or Stockholm office.


What you’ll do

  • Owning end-to-end optimization of a portfolio of strategic financial services merchants, continuously identifying opportunities to improve their performance on Trustly

  • Conducting rigorous, ongoing data analysis to benchmark merchant performance against peers, historical trends, and potential, and pinpointing where value is being left on the table

  • Translating analysis into clear, prioritised recommendations — and owning implementation through to measurable improvement, not just reporting the findings

  • Engaging with new and existing merchants to fully understand their needs and constraints, and designing tailored solutions that reflect the regulatory and operational realities of financial services

  • Leading technical onboarding for new merchants end to end, including complex, high-value implementations and ramping beyond go-live

  • Acting as a point of escalation and technical/commercial authority for complex merchant issues within the financial services vertical

  • Partnering closely with Sales, Account Management, and Product to feed merchant and performance insights back into the roadmap

 

Who you are

jobs.title: Senior Analyst - MENA focus
jobs.description:
About ExTrac

ExTrac is a decision intelligence company used by governments, defence organisations, financial institutions, and corporates operating in complex, fast-moving environments. Our capabilities fuse curated data sources, domain-specific AI, and deep human expertise to transform information overload into clear, actionable foresight.

The Middle East and North Africa (MENA) is a core region for ExTrac's intelligence coverage, spanning the political and security dynamics, actors, movements, and online ecosystems that shape risk across the region and beyond it. We are the analytical backbone for decision-making when geopolitical uncertainty becomes an opportunity or a strategic risk. More at extrac.ai.

The Role

As a Senior Analyst covering the MENA region, you will help ExTrac understand and anticipate political and security developments across the region, including the activities of state and non-state actors, violent extremist organisations (VEOs), and the online ecosystems in which they operate. Working in Arabic every day, across standard and dialectal material, you will turn what you find into timely reporting that feeds ExTrac's intelligence products and data platform.

What the job involves

Intelligence collection and analysis

  • Monitor and assess political, security, and socio-economic developments across MENA, including regional diplomacy, state and non-state actors, and geopolitical risk, with the ability to contribute to wider global coverage when required.

  • Conduct daily monitoring of Arabic- and English-language media, including news outlets, social media platforms, official statements, and other open-source information environments.

  • Track VEO and non-state armed group activity, including organisational developments, propaganda and communications activity, governance dynamics, operational activity, and regional linkages.

  • Identify new narratives, actors, platforms, and threats appearing across online ecosystems.

  • Apply structured analytical techniques to assess complex information and identify patterns and relationships.

Intelligence production

  • Lead and contribute to daily, weekly, monthly, flash, and deep-dive analytical reporting, with a particular focus on MENA and VEOs.

  • Translate and assess Arabic-language documents and other source material.

  • Contribute to client-facing discussions, briefings, and ad hoc research requests as required.

  • Develop and maintain subject-matter expertise across designated countries, actors, organisations, and thematic areas.

Data curation

  • Lead and contribute to source coverage for the region, identifying and proposing new actors, entities, channels, and outlets for inclusion in ExTrac's research ecosystem.

  • Verify and assess sources in the original language prior to inclusion.

  • Maintain coverage against intelligence requirements, identifying where it should expand or deepen.

  • Contribute to the taxonomy and tagging decisions that structure MENA and violent extremism data.

  • Work with the wider research and data teams to translate analytical judgement into structured data that others can rely on without further verification.

Leadership and collaboration

  • Support the Team Lead with the reviewing, and quality assurance of analytical outputs.

  • Mentor junior analysts on research methodology, analytical standards, and source validation.

  • Support other teams across ExTrac on projects and deliverables when required.

Innovation and capability development

  • Help develop research methodologies, monitoring frameworks, and analytical processes to improve team efficiency and product quality.

  • Integrate AI systems and AI-assisted workflows into analytical practice where they create genuine improvements.

You should apply if

  • MENA is the region you already follow closely, across its politics, security dynamics, and the violent extremist movements and online ecosystems operating within it. This is the region you want to go deeper on rather than a rotation on the way to something else.

  • You work in Arabic, not just alongside it. You read Modern Standard Arabic and dialect comfortably, you notice when slang is doing something new, and you can tell the difference between a shift in language and a shift in intent.

  • Writing is one of your strengths. You can turn a fast-moving, ambiguous picture into a concise, evidence-based assessment under deadline, and you take pride in doing it well.

  • You care about the quality of the underlying data as much as the quality of the analysis built on it, and you hold both to the same standard.

  • You want to keep producing analysis at volume and take on more alongside it. Reviewing others' work, helping set priorities for a small team, and mentoring junior analysts appeal to you as additions to the writing, not a step away from it.

  • You thrive on operational tempo. Daily and flash reporting alongside longer deep dives suits how you like to work, and the pace energises rather than drains you.

  • You are already using AI in your workflow and are interested in what it changes about analytical craft.

Where this role can take you

  • Build recognised subject-matter expertise across your assigned countries, actors, and thematic areas, and take on broader analytical scope as it deepens.

  • Build leadership experience through mentoring junior analysts, quality-assuring their work, and supporting prioritisation across a small team.

  • Support the development of the monitoring frameworks and analytical methodologies used across the team.

  • Shape how AI changes intelligence work itself, championing new tools and methodologies across the Research & Analysis team and influencing how the whole function operates.

Requirements

  • At least five years of professional experience in intelligence analysis, geopolitical risk, disinformation analysis, strategic communications, international security, international relations, or a related field.

  • Strong subject-matter knowledge of the MENA region, including its key political and security actors and regional dynamics.

  • A working understanding of VEOs, their online ecosystems, communications strategies, narratives, and operational activity, built through direct analytical experience.

  • Fluency in written Arabic, across both Modern Standard Arabic and local dialects, including knowledge of slang, with the ability to monitor, analyse, and translate Arabic-language content from a range of sources.

  • Demonstrable experience applying structured analytical methodologies to complex information environments and online ecosystems, including OSINT, network analysis, narrative analysis, sentiment analysis, or other quantitative and qualitative approaches.

  • Strong written communication skills, with a track record of producing concise, high-quality, policy-relevant intelligence and analytical outputs under tight deadlines.

  • Hands-on experience curating source coverage: identifying and verifying online sources, assessing their affiliation, and maintaining structured datasets to a defined standard.

  • Experience proofreading, editing, and quality-assuring analytical products.

  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to work independently while managing multiple concurrent workstreams and competing priorities.

  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to distinguish meaningful developments from high-volume information flows.

  • Able to communicate complex political, security, and extremist-related developments clearly to both specialist and non-specialist audiences.

  • Comfortable integrating AI systems into your workflow to improve outputs and efficiency.

  • A strong understanding of the legal and ethical considerations surrounding intelligence collection, open-source research, and data handling, including responsible use of publicly available information.

Desirable

  • Experience leading analysis on international security, violent extremism, terrorism, or state- and non-state-aligned influence and disinformation ecosystems.

  • Demonstrable experience researching VEOs and extremist online activity, including monitoring affiliated media operations, narratives, actors, and various platforms, such as Telegram, Facebook, Instagram, RocketChat, TikTok, and others.

  • Experience with data science, AI-enabled research tools, or advanced OSINT platforms.

  • Proficiency in one or more additional relevant languages, such as French, Farsi, Turkish, Kurdish, or Russian.

  • Familiarity with the PHIA Yardstick.

  • Experience developing analytical methodologies, research frameworks, monitoring requirements, or data schemas and taxonomies.

  • Experience mentoring junior analysts, reviewing analytical outputs, or leading small analytical projects.

Interview Process

We aim to ensure that each person who interviews with our team has the opportunity to showcase their experience and strengths, and to have honest conversations about whether ExTrac and the role align with their career aspirations. The process for this role is as follows:

  • Initial interview with the hiring manager – 30 minutes

  • Technical craft assessment – two tasks covering analytical writing and source curation, returned within 24 hours

  • Competency-based interview – 45 minutes

  • Senior Executive interview – 45 minutes

Benefits

  • Competitive salary based on skills and experience.

  • A generous benefits package, including Private Medical Health Insurance and an enhanced pension package

  • £500/year education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.

  • 33 days of leave across the year inclusive of bank holidays.

  • A role that combines mission-driven purpose with cutting-edge technology in a fast-growing company.

We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

ExTrac AI is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We confirm that this advertisement is for an active, existing open role within our organisation. Please be advised that we may use artificial intelligence-driven tools to assist our recruitment team in screening, assessing, and selecting candidates for this position but all hiring decisions will be made by a member of our team.

  • credibility through the conversation itself rather than a logo slide.

  • A track record of pushing through setbacks and coming back stronger, and of actively seeking out the harder, less familiar deals rather than waiting to be asked.

  • Genuinely bright and inquisitive: you ask sharp questions, pick things up fast, and enjoy getting to the

  • bottom of a problem, whether that's a prospect's business or how Cytix's product works under the hood.

  • Drawn to a business where new challenges show up daily; you take ownership of them and lean in, rather than waiting for someone else to sort it out.

  • Comfortable taking yourself out of your comfort zone: new deal types, new buyer personas, situations you haven't fully rehearsed.

  • Octopus car scheme - Drive electric through salary sacrifice

About Cytix

  • Software never stops changing. Teams ship new code every day, through tickets, pull requests, releases, and increasingly with AI in the mix, but the way security keeps up with all that change hasn't really moved on. That's the problem we're solving. Cytix helps organisations understand which software changes actually matter, what should happen next, and how to prove the right call was made. Security understood, in other words.

    We're a small team with big plans, so every person we hire genuinely shapes what Cytix becomes. That's why we're upfront about our five values: we interview for all of them, and they matter to us more than a perfect CV. They're things you do, not things you are, so have a read and see if they sound like you.

     

    Make the first move. When the goal is clear but the path isn't, you get moving rather than waiting for perfect instructions. If you're blocked, you make a sensible call, say what you're assuming, and explain how you'd course-correct. We'd rather you act and be slightly wrong than sit still.

     

    Find the smarter path. You ask why before how. You dig into what the real problem is instead of just building what the spec says, and you're happy to question 'that's how it's always been done' when the reason behind it has gone stale.

     

    See it through. When something's yours, it lands. No loose ends, no surprises for whoever picks it up next. You keep people posted when things change, and if something falls between roles, you catch it.

     

    Raise the bar. You do the best job possible in the time you've got, whether that's a day or a month. Sometimes that means deep craft; sometimes the smartest move is quick and scrappy. It's about good judgement, and we hold each other to it without blame or politics.

     

    Play to win. You care about the mission but don't take yourself too seriously. You say 'I' when things go wrong and 'we' when they go right, trust teammates to do things their own way, and bring a bit of humour when the pressure's on.

Job Overview:

We're looking for an experienced, strategic CRM Manager to lead the next phase of our customer lifecycle and email marketing strategy. As CRM becomes increasingly central to how we engage, retain, and grow our customer base, you'll own the development of a sophisticated strategy that moves beyond campaign-based email to data-driven customer journeys across the full lifecycle.

You'll shape how we communicate with customers from onboarding and activation through engagement, retention, renewal, and win-back — using segmentation, automation, and experimentation to ensure the right message reaches the right customer at the right moment.   • Own and develop the CRM and lifecycle marketing strategy, with a focus on engagement, retention, and churn reduction.

  • Design automated lifecycle programs and triggered communications that drive activation, adoption, and retention.
  • Partner with Product, Marketing, Customer Success, and Data to deliver a cohesive customer experience.
  • Run a structured testing program across messaging, cadence, timing, segmentation, offers, and journeys.
  • Use customer and product data to identify churn signals and opportunities for targeted communication.
  • Define and track CRM metrics: activation, engagement, conversion, retention, churn, reactivation, and customer lifetime value.
  • Build reporting that connects CRM activity to measurable business outcomes.
  • Improve CRM processes, technology, automation, and data capabilities to support growth.
  • Ensure customer communications meet privacy, consent, and data protection requirements, including GDPR.

Requirements

What You Bring To This Role:

  • Significant experience in CRM, lifecycle, or retention marketing, ideally within a SaaS or subscription business.
  • Track record of building CRM strategy — not just executing email campaigns.
  • Strong understanding of subscription lifecycles and CRM's role in retention and churn reduction.
  • Experience building automated journeys, behavioral triggers, and customer segmentation.
  • Strong grasp of email strategy: deliverability, personalization, experimentation, and optimization.
  • Comfortable using customer, behavioral, and product data to inform decisions.
  • Experience with CRM, marketing automation, and customer engagement platforms.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn performance data into actionable recommendations.
  • Experience collaborating across Product, Customer Success, Marketing, and Data.
  • Commercial mindset — understands how CRM drives retention, lifetime value, and growth.
  • Strong knowledge of GDPR and best practices for customer communications in the UK and Europe.
  • Excellent communication, project management, and stakeholder management skills.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in a SaaS or technology company operating a recurring subscription model.

  • Experience with product-led growth, customer activation, or usage-based lifecycle marketing.
  • Experience designing churn-prevention and win-back strategies.
  • Familiarity with CRM platforms and data ecosystems that enable advanced segmentation, personalization, and automation.
  • Experience helping build or mature a CRM/lifecycle function as a company scales.

What Success Looks Like

You'll turn CRM into a strategic growth and retention channel — building a clear lifecycle strategy, more sophisticated segmentation and automation, more relevant customer communications, and measurable programs that increase engagement, strengthen retention, and reduce churn.

Most importantly, you'll help define the next era of customer communication for the business: a CRM approach that is scalable, data-driven, customer-centric, and closely connected to commercial outcomes.

jobs.title: Azure Cloud Engineer
jobs.description:
Location : Bruxelles
Business model : Freelance or Employee
Duration : Long term
Start date : Idealy September
Remote : Hybrid

Azure Cloud Engineer

Our client is looking for an experienced Azure Cloud Engineer to strengthen its Application Engineering Team and support the expansion of its Azure cloud capabilities. The team currently consists of cloud engineers, architects, a Product Owner, and a Team Lead, and plays a key role within the IT Foundation organization.The successful candidate will contribute to the design, implementation, operation, and optimization of secure and scalable Azure cloud environments while promoting Infrastructure as Code, automation, and cloud best practices.

Key responsibilities

  • Cloud engineering:
    • Design, implement, and maintain Azure-based cloud solutions
    • Support cloud-native applications and infrastructure deployments
    • Ensure platform availability, performance, scalability, and cost efficiency
  • Infrastructure as code (IaC):
    • Develop and maintain reusable Infrastructure as Code solutions using Bicep and TerraForm
    • Contribute to automation initiatives and CI/CD integration
    • Promote standardization through modular and maintainable deployments
  • Networking & Security:
    • Manage and optimize Azure networking components, including Virtual Networks, Nsgs, Private Endpoints, Firewalls, Gateways, and Load Balancers
    • Implement and maintain cloud security best practices
    • Support Identity & Access Management using Entra ID, RBAC, and PIM
    • Contribute to Zero Trust and Azure Policy implementations
  • Operations & continuous improvement:
    • Monitor cloud environments and optimize performance and costs
    • Troubleshoot complex infrastructure and application issues
    • Improve operational maturity, reliability, and governance practices
    • Collaborate closely with architects, developers, security teams, and business stakeholders
  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure
  • Expertise in Infrastructure as Code (TerraForm and/or Bicep)
  • Solid understanding of Azure networking and cloud security
  • Experience with Azure Container Apps (ACA) and containerized workloads
  • Experience with Azure API Management (APIM)
  • Knowledge of CI/CD tools such as Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions
  • Experience with Azure Monitor and Log Analytics
  • Preferred qualifications
    • Experience with Azure Verified Modules
    • Experience with container orchestration and management
    • Azure certifications such as AZ-104, AZ-305, AZ-400, or security-related certifications
  • Soft skills
    • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
    • Proactive and solution-oriented mindset
    • High level of ownership and accountability
    • Team player with a collaborative approach
    • Ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences
  • Success factors
    • Deliver secure, scalable, and reliable Azure solutions
    • Maintain high-quality and reusable IaC assets
    • Foster collaboration between IT, development, and business teams
    • Build trust through transparency, consistency, and proactive communication

Kokenut sähköasentaja Vaasan alueelle

Etsimme asiakasyrityksellemme kokenutta ja ammattitaitoista sähköasentajaa pitkäaikaiseen työsuhteeseen Vaasan alueelle. Rekrytointi suoritetaan yhteistyössä asiakasyrityksemme ja Wulff Worksin kanssa, mutta hakemukset ja mahdolliset yhteydenotot käsittelee Wulff Works. Tässä roolissa pääset hyödyntämään vankkaa osaamistasi vaativissa teollisuuden sähköasennuksissa. Työkenttäsi kattaa kohteita Pohjanmaalla noin 100 kilometrin säteellä Vaasasta (Närpiö–Pietarsaari -akselilla).

Tarjoamme sinulle pitkäaikaisen työsuhteen, vaihtuvan ja mielenkiintoisen teollisuustyöympäristön sekä laadukkaat työvälineet. Wulff Worksilla huolehdimme tekijöistämme ja meille on tärkeää tarjota työpaikkoja, joissa ammattitaitoasi todella arvostetaan.

Määräytyy kokemuksen ja osaamisen mukaan. Liitä hakemukseen mukaan palkkatoiveesi.

jobs.title: Dietist till Ronna Rehab - ett arbete med frihet och flexibilitet
jobs.description:
Vill du ha större möjlighet att påverka hur, när och i vilken omfattning du arbetar?

Välkommen till Ronna Rehab – den lilla mottagningen med det stora hjärtat!

Vi söker en dietist som vill bli en del av vårt team i Södertälje. Hos oss får du stor frihet att forma din arbetsvardag och möjlighet att påverka både schema, arbetstider och tjänstgöringsgrad. Vi erbjuder flextid och möjlighet till hemarbete när arbetsuppgifterna tillåter det.

Vi är en mindre mottagning där vi känner varandra väl, hjälps åt och tycker att det ska kännas bra att komma till jobbet. Här får du friheten att arbeta självständigt, samtidigt som du har kollegor nära till hands för stöd, samarbete och erfarenhetsutbyte.

Ditt arbete hos oss

Som dietist får du ett självständigt och varierat arbete inom primärvårdsrehabilitering. Du träffar patienter både på mottagningen och inom hemrehabilitering och samarbetar med andra professioner utifrån patientens behov.

Vi tycker om egna initiativ och vill att du ska kunna påverka och utveckla ditt arbete utifrån din kompetens och dina intressen.

Vilka blir dina kollegor?

På Ronna Rehab arbetar ett engagerat och erfaret team av dietister, arbetsterapeuter, fysioterapeuter, kiropraktor och naprapater. Vi är en mindre arbetsplats där det är nära till kollegialt stöd och där vi hjälps åt i vardagen.

För oss är det viktigt att du både trivs på jobbet och får möjlighet att utvecklas i din profession.

Vem hoppas vi få som kollega?

Vi söker dig som är legitimerad dietist och som tycker om mötet med människor. Du tar ansvar för ditt arbete och trivs med att arbeta självständigt, samtidigt som du uppskattar att vara en del av ett team.

För oss är ett gott bemötande, engagemang och samarbetsförmåga minst lika viktigt som lång erfarenhet. Därför är du lika välkommen att söka om du har arbetat som dietist i många år som om du är i början av din karriär.

Hos oss får du

    stor möjlighet att påverka ditt schema och dina arbetstider
    flextid
    möjlighet till hemarbete när arbetsuppgifterna tillåter
    flexibilitet kring tjänstgöringsgrad
    stor frihet att planera och utveckla ditt arbete
    möjlighet till kompetensutveckling
    friskvårdsbidrag
    möjlighet att använda mottagningens gym
    nära samarbete med kollegor från flera olika professioner
    möjlighet att vara delaktig och påverka verksamhetens utveckling

Vi hoppas att du som börjar hos oss ska få det bästa av två världar – stor frihet och självständighet i ditt arbete, med tryggheten och gemenskapen i ett team nära till hands.

Kanske är du vår nästa kollega?

Hör gärna av dig och berätta lite om dig själv. Vi ser fram emot att få lära känna dig!

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan till Ronna Rehab!

jobs.title: 💚 Vil du bidra til å gjøre en forskjell – og gi litt lys inn i mørket?
jobs.description:
Jeg søker BPA-er som ønsker å bidra til en tryggere, enklere og litt bedre hverdag.


Om meg
Jeg er en kvinne på 40 år som bor alene i leilighet. Jeg har svært alvorlig ME og er 100 % sengeliggende, og trenger hjelp til det meste i hverdagen.
Jeg er ekstremt lyd- og lyssensitiv og ligger derfor for det meste i et mørkt og skjermet rom. Jeg er veldig glad i dyr, natur, frisk luft, organisering og rydding, og håper at jeg på sikt kan få mulighet til å gjøre mer av dette igjen.
Med riktig hjelp og tilrettelegging håper jeg å kunne bruke den lille energien jeg har på å leve – ikke bare eksistere.

Som BPA kan du bidra til å legge til rette for bedring og gi litt lys inn i en hverdag som ofte er veldig begrenset.


Hva er viktig i jobben?


BPA handler ikke bare om å gjøre oppgavene som står på lista. Minst like viktig er det å forebygge belastning og bidra til ro, skjerming, forutsigbarhet og avlastning.
Det betyr blant annet å bevege seg rolig, unngå unødvendig lyd og stress, være oppmerksom på omgivelsene og se hva som kan gjøres for å gjøre hverdagen enklere – også før jeg trenger å be om det.


Jeg ser etter deg som er:
- omsorgsfull og empatisk
- varm, trygg og ærlig
- selvstendig og selvgående
- ser hva som bør gjøres uten at alt står på en liste
- ansvarsfull og løsningsorientert
- har respekt for behovet for ro og skjerming
- virkelig ønsker å hjelpe og gjøre hverdagen enklere og bedre
- gjerne er en person som gir det lille ekstra


Arbeidsoppgaver
Arbeidsoppgavene varierer etter behov, men kan blant annet være:
- personlig hygiene og stell
- matlaging og bistand ved måltider
- holde oversikt over husholdningen
- fylle dosett
- rengjøring og sengeskift
- klesvask
- handling og andre ærender
- legge til rette for besøk og aktiviteter


Det er viktig at du kan følge rutiner og informasjon i Trello, samtidig som du kan bruke eget initiativ og se hva som trengs.


Arbeidstid
Som regel:
Hverdager: 10–14 + 18–21
Lørdag og søndag: 11–18


Det er stort behov for fleksibilitet ved sykefravær, ferier og høytider, særlig jul. Jeg setter stor pris på BPA-er som av og til har mulighet til å strekke seg litt ekstra. Ved akutte situasjoner kan det for eksempel være svært verdifullt om du har mulighet til å ta 1–2 timer ekstra, dersom du ikke har anledning til å ta en hel vakt.


Høres dette ut som deg?
Da håper jeg du tar kontakt! 💚
For meg handler BPA ikke bare om praktisk hjelp. Det handler om å ha mennesker rundt meg som bidrar til trygghet, ro og livskvalitet – og som ønsker å gjøre en reell forskjell i hverdagen.

 


Medvind Assistanse AS er et norskeid selskap som leverer likestillingsverktøyet BPA for mennesker med funksjonsvariasjon. For funksjonsvarierte skal BPA bidra til å til å gi mulighet til å leve et aktivt og selvstendig liv med fokus på selvrealisering og samfunnsdeltakelse. BPA handler like mye om friheten til å kunne velge hvilket liv man vil leve, og hvem man vil være. Med BPA skal man i størst mulig grad kunne ivareta plikter, interesser, behov og ønsker som alle andre samfunnsborgere. Medvind Assistanse AS ble stiftet i 2020 og har lokale kontorer i store deler av landet.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Payments
jobs.description:
About ThriveCart:

ThriveCart is a powerful platform used by over 50,000 people worldwide to generate over $5B in sales. Included within the ThriveCart platform is a learning management system (LMS), affiliate management, cart and checkout functionality, making it a top solution for creators, coaches, consultants, and other businesses.

We integrate with everything you use and have a simple, clean UI with numerous features that allow customers to build income from existing traffic and we are the highest-converting cart for online businesses. Our business is growing, profitable, and backed by LTV SaaS Growth Funds, and we are looking to expand our footprint amongst online businesses.

Location:

Remote (Europe)

Job Overview:

We’re looking for a strategic and execution-focused Product Manager – Payments to lead the development, optimization, and scale of our global payments infrastructure. In this role, you’ll be responsible for driving core payment functionality, expanding payment method options, improving checkout experiences, and ensuring reliability, security, and compliance across the payments stack.

You’ll work cross-functionally with engineering, design, compliance, operations, and customer success to ensure our merchants have a seamless and trusted payment experience—whether they’re selling digital products, subscriptions, or services.

Tasks

What Your Work Will Entail:

  • Own and execute the end-to-end product strategy and roadmap for ThriveCart’s payments ecosystem (e.g., checkout, payment gateways, transaction routing, fraud, refunds, treasury, and reconciliation).
  • Define, prioritize, and deliver features that improve conversion rates, reduce friction, and support global scalability.
  • Partner with engineering and design to deliver high-quality user experiences and robust back-end systems.
  • Integrate and maintain third-party payment providers (e.g., Stripe, PayPal, Authorize. net) and explore new options (e.g., local payment methods, wallets, and bank debits).
  • Ensure all payment solutions meet regulatory requirements (PCI, PSD2, SCA, etc.).
  • Monitor performance, adoption, and reliability of payment systems using data and user feedback.
  • Collaborate with customer success and support to identify and resolve user pain points related to payments.
  • Stay informed about global payment trends, technologies, and fintech regulations, and bring ideas forward that align with ThriveCart’s growth.

Requirements

What You Bring To This Role:

  • Proven track record of building and scaling payments systems in a SaaS, fintech, or eCommerce environment.
  • Deep understanding of payment infrastructure, including gateway integrations, card networks, fraud prevention, settlements, and chargebacks.
  • Strong technical fluency—comfortable working closely with engineers and interpreting API documentation.
  • Excellent communication, prioritization, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Strong data-driven mindset—you understand what to track, how to measure it, and how to use insights to iterate quickly.
  • 3–5+ years of experience as a Product Manager, ideally with direct ownership over payment products or platforms.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Business, Finance, Economics, or related discipline) preferred but not required.
  • Equivalent practical experience in product management, payments, or fintech may substitute for formal education.
  • Certifications in product management (e.g., Pragmatic, AIPMM, or CSPO) or fintech/payments (e.g., ETA CPP) are a plus but not mandatory.
  • Experience working in agile, cross-functional teams with a focus on delivering customer-centric solutions.
  • Experience with global payment methods, subscriptions, recurring billing, or tax compliance tools.
  • Experience with payments orchestration systems and/or treasury systems is considered a plus.
  • Experience of using AI Agents and implementing and building AI tools and Agents

Learn More About ThriveCart:

Our Values are:

  • Commit to Excellence
  • Find a Way
  • Help Each Other
  • Keep Growing
  • Data First

Our team and product are growing rapidly- we achieved YoY growth of 64% from 2022-2023, and we’re just getting started. We believe in open communication, clear goal setting, and that people do best when they have a growth mindset and want to get things done. Our team comes from diverse backgrounds and companies like Shopify, Salesforce, and BigCommerce, and we are running like an independent SaaS company within a PE fund.

jobs.title: Senior Software Entwickler / Tech Lead – Java, Spring & Jakarta EE*

Was dich erwartet

  • Fullstack-Entwicklung: Du entwickelst anspruchsvolle Java- und Webanwendungen im Front- und Backend – sowohl in modernen Spring-Umgebungen als auch im Jakarta EE Umfeld. Dabei bringst du deine Erfahrung aktiv in Kundenprojekte ein und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden passende, nachhaltige Lösungen.
  • Brückenbauer zwischen alter und neuer Java-Welt: Du kennst sowohl gewachsene Enterprise-Anwendungslandschaften und klassische Jakarta EE Architekturen als auch moderne Spring-, Cloud- und Microservice-Architekturen. Du verstehst die Stärken und Herausforderungen beider Welten und kannst bestehende Anwendungen und Architekturen schrittweise in moderne, zukunftsfähige Lösungen überführen.
  • Architektur & Modernisierung: Du denkst nicht nur in Technologien, sondern in nachhaltigen Architekturen. Du analysierst bestehende Systeme, erkennst Modernisierungspotenziale und entwickelst Strategien, wie sich gewachsene Anwendungen sinnvoll weiterentwickeln lassen – ohne dabei funktionierende Lösungen unnötig über Bord zu werfen.
  • Qualität & Engineering: Clean Code, Test Driven Development und DevOps gehören für dich zum professionellen Software Engineering und sind fester Bestandteil deiner täglichen Arbeit.
  • Technologie & Innovation: Du interessierst dich für aktuelle Technologien, Architekturen und Trends und bewertest deren sinnvollen Einsatz. Gleichzeitig weißt du, dass moderne Softwareentwicklung im Enterprise-Umfeld häufig auf bestehenden Systemen aufbaut und nicht jede Lösung bei null beginnt.
  • Problemlösung: Du analysierst komplexe technische Herausforderungen, optimierst bestehende Lösungen und findest pragmatische Wege, Legacy-Systeme mit modernen Technologien zu verbinden.
  • Kollaboration: Du arbeitest eng mit Kollegen und anderen Teams zusammen und bringst dein technisches Know-how aktiv ein, um gemeinsam die bestmögliche Lösung für unsere Kunden zu entwickeln.
  • Beraterrolle: Du bist nicht nur Entwickler, sondern auch technischer Berater. Du verstehst die Anforderungen unserer Kunden, hinterfragst bestehende Ansätze und unterstützt sie dabei, ihre Anwendungen und Architekturen nachhaltig weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Weiterentwicklung: Du hast die Möglichkeit, dich durch praxisorientierte Trainings – insbesondere in Softwarearchitektur, Modernisierung und Cloud-Technologien – sowie durch den regelmäßigen Erfahrungsaustausch in unseren Gilden fachlich und persönlich weiterzuentwickeln.

Was du mitbringst

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About ThriveCart:

ThriveCart is a powerful platform used by over 50,000 people worldwide to generate over $5B in sales. Included within the ThriveCart platform is a learning management system (LMS), affiliate management, cart and checkout functionality, making it a top solution for creators, coaches, consultants, and other businesses.

We integrate with everything you use and have a simple, clean UI with numerous features that allow customers to build income from existing traffic and we are the highest-converting cart for online businesses. Our business is growing, profitable, and backed by LTV SaaS Growth Funds, and we are looking to expand our footprint amongst online businesses.

Location:

Remote (Europe / LATAM)

Job Overview:

Full-ownership software engineer responsible for building a new system in TypeScript that will replace our existing PHP system, while maintaining the current PHP system throughout the transition. This is not a hand-off role — you take a problem from requirement to production and own it there. You'll work across both stacks, make technical decisions, and be accountable for what you ship.

We expect you to use AI coding tools as a core part of how you work. Not occasionally — daily. Your velocity, code quality, and problem-solving should reflect effective AI tool use. What we care about is judgment: understanding what you ship, making the right decisions, and knowing when to push back on AI output.

This description applies across experience levels (L1–L4). Interview depth and expectations are calibrated to your level.

Tasks

What You'll Own:

  • Features from requirements to production: you break them down, build them, ship them, monitor them
  • Technical decisions within your scope, with clear trade-off reasoning
  • Quality of your code and the areas you touch
  • Responding to incidents and dev-escalations in your domain
  • Building the new TypeScript system that will replace the legacy PHP platform
  • Maintaining and supporting the existing PHP system throughout the transition

What Your Work Will Entail:

1. Feature Development

  • Take feature requests, break them into tasks, estimate, and deliver independently
  • Build the new TypeScript-based system designed to replace our existing PHP platform
  • Maintain and support the current PHP system in parallel, until the new system is fully migrated
  • Write clean, tested, production-ready code that meets team standards
  • Make technical decisions for features and explain trade-offs clearly
  • Monitor your features in production — logs, metrics, alerts
  • Leave the codebase better than you found it (refactor, document, reduce debt)

2. Production Ownership & Incident Response

  • Respond to dev-escalations with urgency — investigate issues, communicate findings, contribute to resolution
  • Participate in incident response: at all levels, you are expected to show up, help investigate, and support resolution
  • L4+: Drive incident response for your domain — coordinate investigation, delegate tasks, communicate status to stakeholders, and ensure post-mortems happen
  • Write runbooks and keep documentation current as you build
  • Share on-call rotation after ramp-up period

3. Code Quality & Testing

  • Write unit and integration tests as part of feature work, not as an afterthought
  • Participate actively in code reviews — give thoughtful feedback, act on feedback you receive
  • Identify edge cases and risks during planning, not after deployment

4. AI-Augmented Development (Expected, Not Optional)

  • Use AI coding tools daily: code generation, debugging, test writing, exploring unfamiliar parts of the codebase, code review acceleration
  • Your output should be measurably faster because of AI tools
  • You understand everything you ship — AI is an accelerator, not a replacement for judgment
  • L3+: Help teammates develop effective AI workflows; contribute to team standards for AI tool use
  • L4+: Set team standards for AI tool usage — evaluate what delivers real value, ensure quality isn't sacrificed for speed

5. Collaboration

  • Work closely with Product, Design, QA, and other engineers
  • Contribute meaningfully to sprint planning and technical discussions
  • L3+: Mentor L1/L2 engineers through code reviews, pairing, and sharing knowledge

Requirements

What You Bring To This Role:

Technical Environment

  • Primary stack: TypeScript/Node.js for the new system you'll build, and PHP 7.4/8+ with Laravel for the existing system you'll maintain during the transition.
  • Infrastructure: MariaDB, Redis, AWS (EC2, RDS, CloudWatch, SQS, S3), Docker, GitHub Actions CI/CD

This role requires active, hands-on TypeScript experience and past professional experience with PHP. Hands-on experience integrating payment platforms such as Stripe and PayPal is required.

Expectations by Level:

  • L1: Works on well-scoped tickets with guidance. Learning the codebase and practices. Uses AI tools to learn faster and ship more.
  • L2: Independently owns features. Minimal guidance needed on implementation. Noticeably faster because of AI tool usage.
  • L3: Leads small projects. Mentors L1/L2. Improves the codebase proactively. Teaches effective AI workflows.
  • L4: Technical authority for a domain. Drives cross-team projects. Sets team AI standards. Drives incident response.

Success Metrics:

Early on, you'll ship your first feature to production, understand the core architecture, and get your local development environment set up. From there, you'll be independently shipping features end-to-end and contributing to code reviews. As you grow further, you'll contribute meaningfully to technical discussions and handle dev-escalations in your area.

On-Call:

Shared rotation (~1 week/month after ramp-up). Critical: 15 min. High: 1 hour.

Learn More About ThriveCart:

Our Values are:

  • Commit to Excellence
  • Find a Way
  • Help Each Other
  • Keep Growing
  • Data First

Our team and product are growing rapidly- we achieved YoY growth of 64% from 2022-2023, and we’re just getting started. We believe in open communication, clear goal setting, and that people do best when they have a growth mindset and want to get things done. Our team comes from diverse backgrounds and companies like Shopify, Salesforce, and BigCommerce, and we are running like an independent SaaS company within a PE fund.

jobs.description:
Vi ser etter deg med erfaring fra bransjen og som liker å jobbe med ungdom.

Kjelle videregående skole har ledig 40 % vikariat som fagarbeider på bygg- og anleggsteknikk fra og med 1.10.2026 og ut skoleåret. 

Bygg- og anleggsteknikk på Kjelle vgs består av tre klasser på Vg1, to klasser Vg2 tømrer, en klasse Vg2 anleggsgartner, og en klasse på fleksibel yrkesutdanning. 

Kjelle vgs ligger på Bjørkelangen og har 250 elever og nesten 100 medarbeidere. Skolen har ordinær opplæring innen naturbruk og bygg- og anleggsteknikk, inkludert Vg3 studieforberedende naturbruk. Skolens medarbeidere forplikter seg til å jobbe etter en felles pedagogikk som heter konsekvenspedagpogikk. Skolen vil vektlegge at erfaringer vi gjør oss i fellesskap, gir grunnlag for videreutvikling av den pedagogiske praksisen. Tannhelsetjenesten i Akershus er organisert i tre områder; Asker og Bærum, Øvre Romerike og Follo, og Nedre Romerike.

Virksomhetens målsetting er at tannhelsetjenester er tilgjengelige for alle som bor eller oppholder seg i fylket. Vi jobber for å fremme tannhelse og utjevne helseforskjeller. For å nå våre mål er tannhelsetjenesten avhengig av et godt samarbeid med andre aktører innenfor helse, omsorg og oppvekst. Våre medarbeidere deltar aktivt i veiledning av elever og studenter. Tannhelsetjenesten i Akershus har som mål å være en attraktiv arbeidsgiver. Ansatte skal oppleve mestring, ha et godt psykososialt arbeidsmiljø og være en viktig bidragsyter i kunnskapsdeling i og utenfor organisasjonen.

Område Øvre Romerike og Follo har følgende klinikker: Nannestad. Årnes, Jessheim, Eidsvoll, Jevnaker, Ås, Oppegård, Ski og Nesodden.

Nesodden tannklinikk har 4 behandlingsrom og 9 ansatte. Stillingen rapporterer til klinikkleder som har personalansvar for de ansatte.

Du må oppgi ditt HPR-nummer i søknaden og vedlegge dine arbeidsattester i søknaden

For mer informasjon se vår hjemmeside www.afk.no

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • varierte oppgaver i forbindelse med behandling av alle typer pasienter innen de lovpålagte gruppene
  • assistere tannleger og tannpleiere
  • administrative oppgaver
  • viktig ressurs i klinikkens smittevernarbeid

Kvalifikasjoner

  • norsk autorisasjon som tannhelsesekretær. Kandidater med erfaring som klinikkassistent ved tannlegekontor/tannklinikk kan vurderes
  • gode og relevante datakunnskaper
  • relevant klinisk erfaring
  • god kjennskap til tannhelsetjenestens samfunnsoppdrag 
  • du må kunne uttrykke deg godt, både muntlig og skriftlig, på norsk eller et annet skandinavisk språk

Personlige egenskaper

  • ønsker å være med å utvikle tannhelsetjenesten i Akershus
  • liker å jobbe med mennesker 
  • er positiv og serviceinnstilt
  • gode kommunikasjonsegenskaper
  • arbeider selvstendig
  • gode samarbeidsegenskaper
  • bidra til et godt arbeidsmiljø

Personlig egnethet vektlegges.

Vi tilbyr

  • en raus organisasjonskultur hvor vi vil hverandre vel og bidrar til fellesskapet
  • faglig utfordrende og varierte arbeidsoppgaver
  • gode utviklingsmuligheter
  • moderne og godt utstyrte tannklinikker
  • lønn og arbeidsvilkår fastsatt i lov og avtaleverk
  • medlemskap i Pensjonskassen for fylkene

Vi ser frem til å motta din søknad!

Ansettelsesform: Fast ansettelse.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Akershus fylkeskommune ønsker medarbeidere som tar en aktiv, engasjert, reflektert og ansvarlig rolle i organisasjonen vår. Hos oss møtes mennesker med ulik kompetanse- og utdanningsbakgrunn for å skape gode tjenester til våre innbyggere. Akershus fylkeskommune er en stor arbeidsgiver, og har ansvar for viktige samfunnsoppgaver som videregående opplæring, kollektivtransport og fylkesveier, tannhelsetjenester, regional planlegging, kultur og kulturminner.

Vi mener at inkludering og mangfold er en styrke. Akershus fylkeskommune jobber for et inkluderende arbeidsliv, der våre ansatte i størst mulig grad gjenspeiler mangfoldet i samfunnet. Vi tilrettelegger slik at alle ansatte kan utføre sitt arbeid på best mulig måte.
Vi oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke, uavhengig av alder, kjønnsidentitet, funksjonsevne, seksuell orientering, religion eller etnisk bakgrunn. Dette gjelder også dersom du har hatt opphold i arbeidslivet (hull i CV-en).

For ansettelse i skole og tannhelse kreves det politiattest av kandidater som får tilbud om stilling. Dersom det fremkommer av din søknad at du ønsker konfidensiell behandling, gjør vi oppmerksom på følgende: Opplysninger om søker kan gjøres offentlig selv om søker har bedt om konfidensiell behandling. Søker vil da få tilsendt informasjon om dette jf. offentleglova § 25.

jobs.title: Er du klar for å lede, utvikle og levere resultater? Vi søker etter en butikkleder til Gullfunn City Nord i Bodø.
jobs.description:
Gullfunn sin visjon er å skape magiske minner gjennom generasjoner. Vi møter daglig mennesker som skal feire eller være en del av en spesiell anledning, enten det er bryllup, fødsel eller konfirmasjon. Vi vet at kunden viser oss tillit ved å dele disse anledningene med oss. For oss som jobber i Gullfunn skal vi være nysgjerrige, vise og kjenne lidenskap og skape tillit. Du som blir en del av oss, kjenner på disse verdiene og vet at det å være en leder er noe du elsker gjennom å motivere, engasjere og utvikle deg og de du jobber sammen med. 
Samtidig tror vi på at et godt lederskap skapes ved å stille krav, være trygg og tydelig - og dele erfaringer. Det å gi ansvar til andre er viktig for at du og teamet skal kjenne eierskap og samtidig skape god trivsel og gode resultater.

Dette er ikke stillingen for deg som bare vil “jobbe i butikk”. Dette er for deg som vil drive butikk.

Som butikkleder i Gullfunn har du totalansvar for drift, utvikling og resultater. Du leder mennesker – men også tall, struktur, vareflyt og tempo. Du tar eierskap, setter retning og følger opp. Hver dag.

Dette er jobben:

Du har ansvaret for at butikken leverer på budsjett, kampanjer og kundeløfte. Det betyr kontroll på drift, lager, varehåndtering, sikkerhet og visuell standard – samtidig som du utvikler teamet ditt og skaper prestasjonskultur.

Du bruker tall aktivt, følger opp avvik, tar grep tidlig og justerer kurs når det trengs. Du er operativ når det er nødvendig – og leder når det er viktig.

Dette er en rolle for deg som:

– liker å ha oversikt

– tåler ansvar

– tar beslutninger

– og står stødig også når tempoet er høyt

Vi ser etter deg som faktisk vil lede:

Du har erfaring med ansvar – gjerne fra butikk, service eller retail – og er komfortabel med å være den som har siste ord. Du forstår at trivsel og resultater henger sammen, men vet også at struktur, tydelighet og forventninger er avgjørende.

Du kjenner deg igjen i flere av disse:

– Du tar eierskap til tall og mål

– Du følger rutiner fordi du vet hvorfor de finnes

– Du utvikler folk gjennom tydelig ledelse – ikke bare hyggelig stemning

– Du liker at hverdagen er variert, krevende og aldri helt lik

Viktig å vite: Dette er en rolle med tydelige krav til sikkerhet, etterlevelse og nulltoleranserutiner. Det forventes at du følger opp dette konsekvent – også når det er krevende. Til gjengjeld får du støtte, opplæring og et system rundt deg som vil at du skal lykkes.

Opplever du dette som spennende, men litt krevende – er du sannsynligvis akkurat den vi ser etter.

Hvis du kjenner deg igjen i dette og har lyst til å bidra i et engasjert team, håper vi du sender oss en søknad.

jobs.title: Pedagogisk leder
jobs.description:
Vi søker etter deg som er ambisiøs på vegne av barna, handlekraftig, omsetter teori til praksis, og som virkelig ønsker å skape en god barnehage til det beste for barnet og familien!  

Norlandia Nyhavn søker Barnehagelærer – og kanskje er det deg?

Vi leter etter en trygg medarbeider som vet hvor stor forskjell én god relasjon kan gjøre. En som har hjertet på rett sted, hodet fullt av fag, og som drives av å gjøre barnas verden rikere – gjennom omsorg, utforsking og engasjement. Som vi sier i våre verdier: En som er kompetent og nyskapende med et stort hjerte til det beste for barnet.

Hva kan du forvente hos oss? Du får bli en del av et lag med høy faglig puls og et stort hjerte. Vi gir deg:

Et varmt og inkluderende kollegafellesskap

  • Veiledning og faglig utvikling fra første dag

  • Et arbeidsmiljø som tar forskning på alvor og setter kunnskap ut i livet

  • Nettverk med 3000 Norlandia

  • Kolleger over hele landet

  • Anstendig lønn og pensjon og eget fordelsprogram

  • Samt ekstra støtte til nyutdannede

  • En hverdag fylt med variasjon, lek og ekte øyeblikk

Vi tror du lykkes hos oss hvis du:

  • Brenner for å skape trygge relasjoner og god barndom

  • Liker å være tilgjengelig for barna, responsiv og deltakende

  • Villig til å omsette pedagogisk teori til praksis bygget på systematikk

  • Ser betydningen av kvalitet og omsetter observasjon og refleksjon over egen praksis til trening og handling

  • Støtter barns lek og læring med sensitivitet og varme

  • Bidrar til et alderstilpasset pedagogisk innhold med fokus på tidlig stimulering, lek og læring

  • Faglig engasjert, profesjonell og setter barnets beste først

Hvem er vi i Norlandia Barnehagene?

Vi er en barnehagekjede som tør å tenke nytt. Vi jobber systematisk med kvalitet, og bruker CLASS som verktøy for å styrke relasjonen mellom barn og voksne. Vi er kunnskapsdrevne, varme og opptatt av at alle barn – uansett bakgrunn – skal få en barndom preget av mestring, trygghet og glede.

Formelle kvalifikasjonskrav

• Treårig høgskoleutdanning som barnehagelærer eller bachelor/master som barnevernspedagog, spesialpedagog, psykolog, musikkpedagog, idrettspedagog eller tilsvarende. 

• Godkjent utdanning fra Utdanningsdirektoratet

• Utenlandske søkere må ha Bergenstest/B2 og godkjent utdanning fra Direktoratet for høyere utdanning og kompetanse - https://hkdir.no/utdanning-frautlandet

• Godkjent politiattest (ikke eldre enn 3 måneder) må vises ved tiltredelse (ref. barnehageloven §30)

Aktuelle kandidater vil bli intervjuet fortløpende, og vi gjør oppmerksom på at stillingen kan bli besatt før annonsen utløper.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

I Norlandia Barnehagene er vårt mål er at alle barn skal ha et likeverdig tilbud og gå i en høykvalitetsbarnehage. Nøkkelen til det er kompetente ansatte som er omsorgsfulle og utviklingsorienterte, derfor deler vi kunnskap med hverandre og er stolte av arbeidsplassen vår.

Vi baserer vårt arbeid på kunnskap og innovasjon, som omhandler at vår praksis utvikler seg i tråd med ny forskning og erfaring. God ledelse, felles kultur og standard, samt et rikt leke- og læringsmiljø er viktig for barna, og for oss.

Derfor har vi valgt ut noen felles satsningsområder som vi vet har stor betydning for barns utvikling og progresjon. Vi jobber helthetlig og systematisk med intern kompetanseutvikling og ekstern barnehagevurdering med blant annet CLASS som verktøy.
