jobs.title: Product Manager, Crypto Asset Management
jobs.description:
About MoonPay

MoonPay is for builders with something to prove.

This isn't a "work on cool crypto stuff" company. It's a high-standards, high-velocity, high-accountability company building the operating system for value movement. If the internet moves information, we move value: crypto, stablecoins, tokenized assets, and whatever comes next. Four offerings make that real: fund, tokenize, trade, and spend. 30M+ customers and 500+ ecosystem partners run on us. Licensed in the U.S. Regulated across the UK, EU, Canada, and Australia.

AI is the default operating mode here. It's woven into every role, and we expect you to use it daily. It handles the manual work so you can deliver on what actually matters.

You'll thrive here if outcomes excite you more than process, if impact motivates you more than titles, and if you want hard problems, real ownership, and teammates who love winning, building, and doing it together.

The bar is high. The pace is real. We're building for what's next, for humans and agents.

Recent recognition:


Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers 2026 .
2nd in Crypto Services on Fortune's inaugural Crypto 100
The Sunday Times Best Places to Work two years running

Research has shown that women are less likely than men to apply for this role if they do not have experience in 100% of these areas. Please know that this list is indicative, and that we would still love to hear from you even if you feel that you are only a 75% match. Skills can be learned, diversity cannot.


About the Opportunity

In this role, you will join MoonPay’s Crypto Asset Management team as a Product Manager, helping us build and scale the liquidity and asset infrastructure that supports products across MoonPay.

The team is responsible for how liquidity is sourced and distributed across our platform, supporting high-value crypto transaction volumes across multiple assets, venues, and blockchains. As our remit expands across products including Ramps, Swaps, and Enterprise, the volume and complexity of product work is growing with it.

You will take ownership of day-to-day product execution across our on-chain and off-chain workstreams, helping turn business and technical requirements into clearly defined, prioritised, and executable work.

Working closely with the Principal Product Manager, Engineering, Operations, Compliance, Finance, Treasury, and commercial teams, you will support initiatives including liquidity-provider integrations, asset availability, routing and best-execution capabilities, custody and wallet infrastructure, and the broader on-chain services required to operate reliably at scale.

Your work will help the team move faster, improve the efficiency and resilience of our liquidity infrastructure, and enable MoonPay to support significantly more products and transaction volume as the business grows.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys solving complex problems, wants to deepen their understanding of crypto and financial infrastructure, and is excited to develop their product craft in a fast-moving, high-impact environment.

What You Will Do

  • Own day-to-day product execution across Crypto Asset Management initiatives, translating business, technical, operational, and compliance requirements into clear product requirements, user stories, project plans, and delivery milestones.

  • Support integrations with new liquidity sources, including centralised exchanges, OTC trading desks, and decentralised services, helping expand MoonPay’s liquidity network and improve sourcing efficiency, reliability, and execution.

  • Coordinate asset availability and infrastructure initiatives across Engineering, Operations, Compliance, Finance, Treasury, Commercial, and other Product teams, ensuring dependencies, decisions, risks, and requirements are understood and tracked through delivery.

  • Support the setup and evolution of technical infrastructure across areas such as wallets, gas sponsorship, transaction broadcasting, and other on-chain infrastructure services, working closely with engineering and operational teams to translate requirements into scalable product solutions.

  • Support roadmap development and prioritisation, using data, commercial value, operational requirements, customer impact, risk, and engineering constraints to help determine which initiatives should be addressed first.

  • Contribute to the evolution of our liquidity and asset-management infrastructure, including custody and wallet capabilities, liquidity routing, best execution, settlement efficiency, monitoring, and risk-management tooling.

  • Use data to evaluate product performance and opportunities, identifying friction, operational inefficiencies, or areas where product and infrastructure improvements can create measurable value for MoonPay and its customers.

 

 

About You

Must-have experience and skills

  • You have experience working in product management, product operations, treasury, finance, business analysis, technical programme delivery, or a similar role, and can take a problem from initial requirements through to structured execution.

  • You are comfortable working across cross-functional teams, particularly with Engineering, Operations, Compliance, Finance, Treasury, or Commercial stakeholders, and can turn complex or ambiguous requirements into clear actions and priorities.

  • You have strong product thinking and analytical skills, with the ability to understand trade-offs, use data to support decisions, and prioritise work based on business and customer impact.

  • You have a genuine interest in crypto, fintech, or financial infrastructure and are motivated to build a deeper understanding of areas such as blockchain networks, liquidity, exchanges, custody, wallets, and digital-asset infrastructure.

Nice-to-have experience

  • Previous exposure to crypto or fintech infrastructure, particularly liquidity management, exchange or OTC integrations, stablecoins, custody, wallets, or DeFi protocols.

Bonus Points

  • Familiarity with regulated financial products, crypto compliance requirements, blockchain infrastructure, or products handling high-value financial transactions.

Benefits & Perks 💡

  • 💰 Competitive salary package

  • 🤝 Equity package: financial freedom starts with our employees, so all employees have ownership at MoonPay

  • 📈 Pay-for-performance equity bonus: those who drive outsized outcomes receive outsized rewards

jobs.title: Sähköasentaja Kajaaniin
jobs.description:
Sähköasentaja Kajaaniin
Etsimme ammattitaitoista sähköasentajaa vakituiseen työsuhteeseen Kajaaniin. Tarjolla on monipuolinen tehtävä paikallisessa ja kehittyvässä talotekniikka-alan yrityksessä, jossa pääset työskentelemään vaihtelevissa asiakaskohteissa ja ottamaan vastuuta omasta tekemisestäsi. Työpäivät vievät sinut erilaisiin ympäristöihin liiketiloista ja tuotantokiinteistöistä taloyhtiöihin sekä yksityisasiakkaiden kohteisiin. Etsimme joukkoon asentajaa, jolla on jo kokemusta kiinteistöjen sähköasennuksista ja joka pystyy hoitamaan työtehtäviä itsenäisellä ja ammattimaisella otteella. Tässä tehtävässä arvostetaan osaamisen lisäksi hyvää asennetta. Toivomme löytävämme tekijän, joka pitää laadukkaasta työnjäljestä, palvelee asiakkaita luontevasti ja haluaa sitoutua mukaan kasvavan yrityksen toimintaan pidemmäksi aikaa.
 
Työtehtävät:
Sähköasentajana työskentelet monipuolisten sähköasennus-, huolto- ja muutostöiden parissa eri puolilla Kajaanin aluetta. Päivän aikana vastaan voi tulla niin suunniteltuja asennuksia kuin erilaisia huolto- ja vikatehtäviäkin. Työhösi voi kuulua esimerkiksi kiinteistöjen sähköistyksiä ja tilamuutoksia, valaistusratkaisujen uusimista sekä sähköautojen latauspisteiden ja -järjestelmien asennuksia. Kohteet vaihtelevat kaupan ja muiden liiketilojen kiinteistöistä tuotantoympäristöihin, taloyhtiöihin ja yksityiskoteihin.
Työskentelet paljon itsenäisesti ja vastaat siitä, että sinulle annetut tehtävät tulevat hoidetuiksi sovitusti ja hyvällä ammattitaidolla. Keikkaluonteisissa töissä käytössäsi on huoltoauto sekä tehtävissä tarvittavat työkalut ja välineet.
 
Odotamme:
Sinulla on sähköalan osaaminen sekä vähintään kahden vuoden käytännön kokemus kiinteistöjen sähköasennuksista. Erilaiset huolto-, keikka- ja muutostyöt ovat sinulle tuttuja ja pystyt viemään saamasi työtehtävät itsenäisesti alusta valmiiseen lopputulokseen. Teknisen osaamisen lisäksi tehtävässä tarvitaan hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja. Työskentelet asiakkaiden tiloissa ja kohtaat työpäiviesi aikana erilaisia ihmisiä, joten asiallinen ja palveluhenkinen toimintatapa on tärkeä osa asentajan työtä.
Arvostamme oma-aloitteista ja vastuullista työskentelytapaa sekä ammattiylpeyttä omasta tekemisestä. Meille on tärkeää, että olet luotettava työkaveri ja jätät myös asiakkaalle hyvän kuvan tehdystä työstä ja palvelusta. B-ajokortti on tehtävässä välttämätön. Kokemus sähköautojen latausratkaisujen parista on plussaa. Myös hyvät tietotekniset valmiudet ovat hyödyksi, sillä erilaiset digitaaliset työkalut, järjestelmät ja sovellukset ovat nykyisin kiinteä osa sähköasentajan arkea.
 
Tarjoamme:
Saat vakinaisen työpaikan ja vaihtelevan tehtäväkentän, jossa pääset hyödyntämään sähköalan osaamistasi erilaisissa kiinteistöissä ja asiakaskohteissa. Työ tarjoaa sopivasti itsenäisyyttä ja vastuuta ilman, että jäät haastavissa tilanteissa yksin.
Saat käyttöösi tehtävien hoitamiseen asianmukaiset työvälineet sekä keikkatöissä huoltoauton. Taustallasi toimii osaava työporukka, jolta saat tarvittaessa apua ja tukea. Kasvavassa paikallisessa yrityksessä sinulla on myös mahdollisuus kehittää osaamistasi ja rakentaa rooliasi tulevaisuutta ajatellen. Kokemuksen ja oman kiinnostuksesi mukaan voit päästä ottamaan myöhemmin enemmän vastuuta ja kasvamaan yrityksen mukana.
 
Palkkaus:
Palkka määräytyy sähköistys- ja sähköasennusalan TES:n mukaan. Lopullinen palkka sovitaan osaamisen, kokemuksen ja tehtävän vaativuuden perusteella. Palkkataso sijoittuu noin 15,50-21,35 €/h välille.
 
Hakeminen:
Mikäli koet olevasi tähän tehtävään sopiva henkilö, niin hae paikkaa heti, koska käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana. Olemme Wulff Worksillä halunneet tehdä työnhaun mahdollisimman helpoksi, joten jos sinulla on jo valmis CV, voit antaa tekoälyapurimme täyttää tiedot siitä puolestasi klikkaamalla tätä linkkiä  . Kelan työkokeiluvalmennus:

Harrasteryhmän ohjaaja:

Ohjaajan työt sijoittuvat Etelä-Savon alueelle. Tehtävä sisältää liikkumista pääasiallisesti Savonlinnan alueella ja tarvittaessa muualla Etelä-Savossa.

**Hakijalta edellytämme**

Hakijalta edellytämme jotakin seuraavista koulutuksista:

sosionomi (AMK)

toimintaterapeutti (AMK)

kuntoutuksen ohjaaja (AMK)

itseohjautuvuutta, aloitekykyisyyttä ja kehittämismyönteistä työotetta

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Fellow in Robotics and Computer Vision
jobs.description:
The European Spallation Source (ESS) is one of the largest science and technology infrastructure projects being built today. ESS will soon be the world’s most powerful source of neutrons, providing researchers with unique opportunities to explore the structure of materials at the atomic level. Neutron scattering at ESS will address critical questions in physics, chemistry, geology, materials science and life science.

ESS is now inviting applications for a Postdoctoral Fellow or Research Engineer in robotics and computer vision to work within the ASTRIND project to conduct research on, develop, and integrate an automated sample alignment system based on robotics and computer vision for the BEER instrument at ESS.

About the ASTRIND project:

Funded by the Röntgen-Ångström Cluster, this German-Swedish collaboration aims to enhance strain and texture measurements at ESS’s BEER diffractometer by transferring and extending robotic, vision, and simulation technologies developed at STRESS-SPEC (MLZ Munich). The project will improve alignment, motion planning, and sample exchange through multi-view camera tracking, integrated robot and hexapod control, and a BEER digital twin for calibration, collision-aware trajectory planning, and workflow validation. Additional tools for 3D-based measurement-point selection and in-situ digital image correlation will support advanced experiments. Cross-facility demonstrations between BEER and STRESS-SPEC will establish reproducible, standardized, and higher-throughput engineering diffraction workflows with improved data quality and industrial relevance.

About the role:

This position combines robotics, computer vision, software development, and moderate amount of experimental work with neutron diffraction technique to support the development and deployment of advanced sample alignment systems for the BEER instrument.

Your key responsibilities will include:

    Designing the system architecture (robot, cameras, auxiliary equipment) and propose hardware specifications, balancing performance requirements against the ASTRIND budget.
    Leading the integration of the sample robot, cameras, and auxiliary systems with the site-wide integrated control system (EPICS) and the neutron scattering control system (NICOS).
    Defining the data handling and user interfaces required for routine use of automated alignment during experiments.
    Planning and carrying out testing, commissioning, and validation of the system.
    Writing technical documentation

Depending on who we appoint into this position, you may also be:

    Conducting research and supervising master’s students on robotics and computer vision methods for automated sample alignment in neutron scattering applications.
    Publishing these research results in peer-reviewed journals and at conferences to strengthen the scientific output of the project.

This is a grant funded, fixed-term position for a period of three years. The role also requires the flexibility for occasional travel, including visits to project partners in Munich.

About you:

To succeed in this role, you need a strong background in robotics, mechatronics, automatic control, computer vision, or a very closely related field. This must be supported by either a PhD or an engineering degree together with relevant professional experience. You are motivated by the opportunity to work at the intersection of advanced instrumentation, software integration, and experimental science within a large-scale international research facility.

You bring solid hands-on experience in robotics and computer vision, including system integration, motion control, sensor or camera systems, and software development for automated or semi-automated platforms. You are comfortable working across both hardware and software layers and enjoy turning complex technical requirements into reliable operational systems.

You have strong programming and software engineering skills, particularly in Python and C/C++, and are confident working in Linux environments, using version control systems such as Git, and developing within frameworks such as ROS. Experience with CAD software and mechanical system design is also expected.

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be an advantage:

    Integration of robotic systems with scientific or industrial control systems.
    Machine vision, calibration, or multi-camera tracking systems.
    Motion planning, simulation, or digital twin environments.
    Experimental automation in research or large-scale infrastructure environments.
    EPICS, NICOS, neutron or synchrotron instrumentation, or similar scientific facilities.

For candidates applying at the postdoctoral level, experience of publishing research results and contributing to scientific projects is highly valued. Experience supervising students or mentoring junior colleagues would also be beneficial.

As a person, you are collaborative, proactive, and curious, with a strong interest in learning and developing new skills. You communicate clearly and work effectively with engineers, scientists, software developers, and technical staff from different disciplines and cultural backgrounds. You are comfortable working both independently and as part of an international team, and you have excellent written and spoken English skills.

To apply:

A career at ESS gives you the opportunity to contribute to the future discoveries within neutron science at a stunning, brand-new workplace filled with innovative minds and brilliant people from across the globe. We offer individualised compensation which is differentiated according to role, responsibilities, individual skills, abilities and achievements as well as monthly pension contributions on top of your salary.

If you see yourself in what we’re looking for, please provide your CV and motivation letter in English by clicking on “apply” and following the instructions. Please be aware that we can only accept direct applications made via the ESS website.

This role might require enhanced security screening processes, which will be performed during the recruitment process if needed.

For further information about the project please contact Gergely Németh, mailto:gergely.nemeth@ess.eu or Karin Rathsman, mailto:karin.rathsman@ess.eu.

For trade union information, please contact Unionen representative Nerusha Naicker on mailto:erusha.Naicker@ess.eu or SACO/Swedish Association of Graduate Engineers representative Marc Kickulies at mailto:marc.kickulies@ess.eu

Disse samarbeider tett med et tverrfaglig hverdagsrehabiliteringsteam bestående av en ergoterapeut, fysioterapeut og direkte ut mot pasienter. Foruten disse fagpersonene består vår virksomhet at ergoterapeuter, fysioterapeuter, demens- og kreftkoordinator, AKS-sykepleiere, dagsentre og praktisk bistand. 

Du vil i denne stillingen ha ansvar for kartlegging, målsetting, oppfølging og evaluering av tiltak, samt sikre god samhandling på tvers av tjenester. Det jobbes ut ifra prinsippet “hva er viktig for deg?” 

Vi har ledig følgende stilling: 

  • Sykepleier i hverdagsrehabilitering - 100 % fast dagstilling, 37,5 t/uke 

Vi søker en engasjert og faglig trygg sykepleier til stillingen. 

Ledig fra: 01.09.2026 

Arbeidsoppgaver:

  • Bidra til å styrke brukers egne ressurser for å ivareta eget liv og egen helse
  • Ansvar for at hverdagsmestring og hverdagsrehabilitering utføres i tjenesten, i samarbeid med virksomhetene og hverdagsrehabiliteringsteamet
  • Delta aktivt i arbeidsgrupper
  • Gjøre kliniske vurderinger og fortløpende observere brukers helhetlige tilstand
  • Samarbeid med bruker, pårørende, andre faggrupper og kommunens hverdagsrehabiliteringsteam
  • Brukermedvirkning og “hva er viktig for deg” er sentralt 

Kvalifikasjoner:

  • Autorisert sykepleier
  • Ønske om spesialisering, eller videreutdanning innen rehabilitering, geriatri eller demens
  • Erfaring fra kommunehelsetjeneste, gjerne med rehabilitering
  • Opptatt av mestring, brukermedvirkning og helhetlige pasientforløp
  • Gode norskkunnskaper både muntlig og skriftlig
  • Førerkort klasse B 

Personlige egenskaper:

  • Du ser muligheter og brukernes ressurser
  • Du er ikke er avhengig av faste rutiner, men trives med det uforutsigbare.
  • Evne til å planlegge selvstendig og ta raske avgjørelser
  • Tverrfaglig forståelse, sammen med hverandre gir vi de beste tjenestene.
  • Strukturert, selvstendig og har gode samarbeidsevner 

Vi tilbyr:

  • Gode forsikrings- og pensjonsordninger.
  • Godt arbeidsmiljø og hyggelige kollegaer. 

Personlig egnethet blir vektlagt ved alle ansettelser.

Politiattest må framlegges før tiltredelse.

Vår visjon er muligheter, miljø og mangfold. Sammen gjør vi det umulige mulig, velger grønt først og lar ulikhetene forme vår felles fremtid. Vi har et ansvar for fortid, nåtid og skaper et samfunn i takt med sin samtid, og vi legger til rette for at Aurskog-Høland er et godt sted å leve, bo og arbeide. 

Våre verdier som ligger til grunn for alt arbeid som skjer i kommunen er; Åpenhet, Tillit og Samhandling. 

Vår kommune har fokus på et inkluderende arbeidsliv og er opptatt av at arbeidsstyrken skal gjenspeile mangfoldet i samfunnet. Likeverd, likestilling og mangfold er en del av kulturen vår, og vi har nulltoleranse for diskriminerende praksis og oppførsel.   

Etter søknadsfristen vil det bli utarbeidet en offentlig søkerliste, i samsvar med Offentleglova § 25. Vi gjør oppmerksom på at opplysninger om søkeren kan bli offentliggjort selv om søkeren har bedt om ikke å bli oppført på den offentlige søkerlisten. Søkere vil bli varslet i forkant dersom anmodning om unntak fra offentlighet ikke tas til følge. 

Alle attester/tjenestebevis og vitnemål må lastes opp sammen med søknad og CV i rekrutteringsportalen, EasyCruit innen søknadsfristen. Har du utdanning fra utlandet legger du ved godkjenning fra HK-dir. https://hkdir.no/utdanning-fra-utlandet. 

Ønskes ytterligere opplysninger om stillingen, ta gjerne kontakt med virksomhetsleder, Kristin Kollerud Bjerke, e-post: kristin.kollerud.bjerke@ahk.no, eller på telefon: 907 29 127. 

Jeg gleder meg til å høre fra deg!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Kommunen ligger under en time fra Oslo, Gardermoen og Charlottenberg, og kun 30 minutter fra Lillestrøm og store deler av Romerike. Vi er Oslos nærmeste villmark med et rikt dyreliv og et flott kulturlandskap, og med flere tettsteder der Bjørkelangen er kommunesenteret. Aurskog-Høland kommune er en fremtidsrettet organisasjon der medarbeiderne er den viktigste ressursen for at vi skal lykkes i å skape det mangfoldige og gode liv for våre innbyggere og gjester. Det gjør vi best sammen, og som ansatt er vi opptatt av å gi deg ansvar og spennende arbeidsoppgaver, samtidig som vi legger til rette for faglig utvikling. Aurskog-Høland ble som én av tre kommuner nominert som Årets kulturkommune 2023-2024, ligger på første plass på Romerike i saksbehandling av byggesaker, og havnet i 2022 på 14. plass over landets best styrte kommuner. Vi ønsker oss flere initiativrike og dyktige medarbeidere som setter pris på å bli utfordret og som aktivt bidrar i løsningen av kommunens oppgaver. Vi er en kommune i vekst. Det gir oss mange muligheter i tiden fremover. Vi kan tilby spennende og utviklende oppgaver.

jobs.title: Research Engineer in Robotics and Computer Vision
jobs.description:
The European Spallation Source (ESS) is one of the largest science and technology infrastructure projects being built today. ESS will soon be the world’s most powerful source of neutrons, providing researchers with unique opportunities to explore the structure of materials at the atomic level. Neutron scattering at ESS will address critical questions in physics, chemistry, geology, materials science and life science.

ESS is now inviting applications for a Postdoctoral Fellow or Research Engineer in robotics and computer vision to work within the ASTRIND project to conduct research on, develop, and integrate an automated sample alignment system based on robotics and computer vision for the BEER instrument at ESS.

About the ASTRIND project:

Funded by the Röntgen-Ångström Cluster, this German-Swedish collaboration aims to enhance strain and texture measurements at ESS’s BEER diffractometer by transferring and extending robotic, vision, and simulation technologies developed at STRESS-SPEC (MLZ Munich). The project will improve alignment, motion planning, and sample exchange through multi-view camera tracking, integrated robot and hexapod control, and a BEER digital twin for calibration, collision-aware trajectory planning, and workflow validation. Additional tools for 3D-based measurement-point selection and in-situ digital image correlation will support advanced experiments. Cross-facility demonstrations between BEER and STRESS-SPEC will establish reproducible, standardized, and higher-throughput engineering diffraction workflows with improved data quality and industrial relevance.

About the role:

This position combines robotics, computer vision, software development, and moderate amount of experimental work with neutron diffraction technique to support the development and deployment of advanced sample alignment systems for the BEER instrument.

Your key responsibilities will include:

    Designing the system architecture (robot, cameras, auxiliary equipment) and propose hardware specifications, balancing performance requirements against the ASTRIND budget.
    Leading the integration of the sample robot, cameras, and auxiliary systems with the site-wide integrated control system (EPICS) and the neutron scattering control system (NICOS).
    Defining the data handling and user interfaces required for routine use of automated alignment during experiments.
    Planning and carrying out testing, commissioning, and validation of the system.
    Writing technical documentation

Depending on who we appoint into this position, you may also be:

    Conducting research and supervising master’s students on robotics and computer vision methods for automated sample alignment in neutron scattering applications.
    Publishing these research results in peer-reviewed journals and at conferences to strengthen the scientific output of the project.

The role also requires the flexibility for occasional travel, including visits to project partners in Munich.

About you:

To succeed in this role, you need a strong background in robotics, mechatronics, automatic control, computer vision, or a very closely related field. This must be supported by either a PhD or an engineering degree together with relevant professional experience. You are motivated by the opportunity to work at the intersection of advanced instrumentation, software integration, and experimental science within a large-scale international research facility.

You bring solid hands-on experience in robotics and computer vision, including system integration, motion control, sensor or camera systems, and software development for automated or semi-automated platforms. You are comfortable working across both hardware and software layers and enjoy turning complex technical requirements into reliable operational systems.

You have strong programming and software engineering skills, particularly in Python and C/C++, and are confident working in Linux environments, using version control systems such as Git, and developing within frameworks such as ROS. Experience with CAD software and mechanical system design is also expected.

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be an advantage:

    Integration of robotic systems with scientific or industrial control systems.
    Machine vision, calibration, or multi-camera tracking systems.
    Motion planning, simulation, or digital twin environments.
    Experimental automation in research or large-scale infrastructure environments.
    EPICS, NICOS, neutron or synchrotron instrumentation, or similar scientific facilities.

For candidates applying at the postdoctoral level, experience of publishing research results and contributing to scientific projects is highly valued. Experience supervising students or mentoring junior colleagues would also be beneficial.

As a person, you are collaborative, proactive, and curious, with a strong interest in learning and developing new skills. You communicate clearly and work effectively with engineers, scientists, software developers, and technical staff from different disciplines and cultural backgrounds. You are comfortable working both independently and as part of an international team, and you have excellent written and spoken English skills.

To apply:

A career at ESS gives you the opportunity to contribute to the future discoveries within neutron science at a stunning, brand-new workplace filled with innovative minds and brilliant people from across the globe. We offer individualised compensation which is differentiated according to role, responsibilities, individual skills, abilities and achievements as well as monthly pension contributions on top of your salary.

If you see yourself in what we’re looking for, please provide your CV and motivation letter in English by clicking on “apply” and following the instructions. Please be aware that we can only accept direct applications made via the ESS website.

This role might require enhanced security screening processes, which will be performed during the recruitment process if needed.

For further information about the project please contact Gergely Németh, gergely.nemeth@ess.eu or Karin Rathsman, karin.rathsman@ess.eu.

For trade union information, please contact Unionen representative Nerusha Naicker on Nerusha.Naicker@ess.eu or SACO/Swedish Association of Graduate Engineers representative Marc Kickulies at marc.kickulies@ess.eu

Nice to have

    Familiarity with maritime software platforms, noon reporting, emissions reporting, or fleet performance tools.

What we offer

    The opportunity to combine maritime expertise, customer interaction, and technology in practical daily operations.
    Close collaboration with experienced colleagues from OrbitMI and Gale Force.
    The opportunity to influence how our Client Operations and managed services continue to develop.
    A supportive working environment with room to learn, take responsibility, and grow.
    A role that contributes to bringing OrbitMI and Gale Force together as one organisation.

  

Interested in joining us?

We would be pleased to hear from you.

Please submit your application and CV. We look forward to learning more about your experience and interest in the role.

Du må være motivert for å gi alle barn gode og likeverdige oppvekstforhold. Som støtteressurs vil du bidra til at barn opplever mestring, utvikling og et inkluderende barnehagemiljø. Vi har behov for tilkallingsvikarer, med mulighet for mer varig engasjement.

Vi erfarer at et bredt spekter av medarbeidere gjør at vi får nye tanker og perspektiver og kan løse oppgavene våre enda bedre. Vi søker derfor medarbeidere som har ulik erfaring og bakgrunn.

Støtteressurs har sitt arbeidssted ute i bydelens barnehager, både kommunale og private, og du må være fleksibel i bytte av barnehager ved behov.

Samtidig må vi bruke det pedagogiske blikket for å vurdere og reflektere over hva barna har behov for i øyeblikket. Dette krever tilstedeværende voksne som er sammen med barna der de er.

jobs.title: Occupational Health & Safety Coordinator - Fitness Centre
jobs.description:
Position purpose

The Occupational Health & Safety Coordinator is responsible for maintaining a safe, healthy, clean and well-organised environment for customers, employees and visitors of the fitness centre. The role combines occupational health and safety coordination, facility cleanliness and hygiene, safety administration, and customer support. The position also has particular responsibility for welcoming, advising and guiding international and non-Finnish-speaking customers.

Key responsibilities

Coordinate the fitness centre's occupational health and safety activities and support compliance with applicable workplace health and safety requirements.

Conduct regular workplace and facility inspections, hazard identification and risk assessments, identify potential safety risks, and coordinate corrective and preventive actions.

Maintain safety documentation, including risk assessments, inspection records, incident reports, safety instructions, training records and other relevant OHS documentation.

Support incident investigation and follow-up, report safety concerns, and help implement measures to prevent recurrence.

Coordinate and maintain practical emergency preparedness, first-aid and fire-safety arrangements and provide safety guidance to employees when required.

Monitor the cleanliness, hygiene and general condition of the fitness centre, including training areas, changing rooms, sanitary facilities, reception and other customer areas.

Perform and coordinate routine cleaning duties and ensure that cleaning materials, hygiene products, first-aid supplies and other essential facility supplies are adequately maintained.

Identify safety, cleanliness, hygiene or facility deficiencies and ensure that they are reported and addressed promptly.

Welcome and assist international and non-Finnish-speaking customers, provide orientation to the fitness centre and explain facilities, access procedures, safety practices, rules and appropriate use of the premises.

Support reception and front-of-house operations when required, including customer check-in, visitor management, answering enquiries, telephone communication and general administrative record keeping.

Promote a proactive safety culture and contribute to a professional, welcoming and well-organised customer environment.

Requirements

NEBOSH certificate completed within 5 years (or alternatively, NEBOSH course active with graduation before the commencement of the work).

Professional OHS certifications: Hazard Identification & Risk Assessment (HIRA), Basic Fire Fighting, Basic First Aid, Incident Investigation and Legal Liability.

Excellent command of English, both spoken and written, enabling professional customer service, safety communication, guidance and documentation in an international environment.

Relevant occupational health and safety competence and the ability to conduct workplace inspections, identify hazards and maintain safety documentation.

Strong customer-service, communication, organisational and administrative skills.

Relevant competence

The role utilises competence in occupational health and safety, SHE representation, workplace inspections, hazard identification and risk assessment, safety documentation, incident investigation, first aid, fire safety, administration and front-desk customer service.

Company description:

Scandinavian Airlines System SAS

Job description:   Procurement Professionals  

As SAS continues to strengthen and expand its Procurement organization, we are looking for several Sourcing Managers/Catagory Managers to join our team. Working within Operations, Commercial or Indirect Procurement, depending on your background and business needs, you will lead sourcing initiatives, develop supplier partnerships and collaborate with stakeholders across the business to improve commercial outcomes, operational performance and supplier value. The core of this role is to lead sourcing projects that improve cost efficiency, supplier performance and business outcomes through structured procurement processes, including RFx, negotiations and contracting.  Success in this role requires a broad business perspective, strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to balance competing priorities to achieve the best outcome for SAS.

     Challenges you will work on:  

•    Lead end-to-end sourcing projects, from opportunity assessment and business case development through RFx, negotiation, contracting and implementation. •    Build and develop strong supplier and stakeholder relationships. •    Navigate a dynamic environment where priorities, requirements and business needs can change quickly.

     The Team  

You will join a high-performing team that values collaboration, accountability, curiosity and continuous improvement. Great results are achieved through teamwork, where ownership, trust and stakeholder collaboration are key to success. We are looking for a colleague who takes ownership, collaborates effectively across functions and contributes to both team success and business results.

     To be successful we believe you have  

•    A university degree in business, engineering or equivalent experience. •    3-5+ years of experience within sourcing, procurement, supplier management or a similar commercial role. •    Proven experience leading RFx processes, supplier negotiations and contract implementation that deliver measurable business results. •    Proven ability to align stakeholders, manage conflicting priorities and drive decisions in complex organizational environments. •    A collaborative mindset combined with a strong sense of ownership, accountability and the ability to drive initiatives independently. •    Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. •    Fluency in English.  Meriting experience  •    Experience from aviation, transportation, logistics or other operationally complex industries. •    Experience within commercial, operational or indirect procurement environments. •    Experience driving change, process improvements or transformation initiatives.

     Why SAS?  

At SAS, we offer opportunities for professional development in an international, fast-paced working environment. We are dedicated to the continuous growth of our employees. Working with us comes with a variety of benefits, including:  •    Travel Perks: Enjoy discounted travel opportunities around the world with SAS.  •    Health & Wellness: Access to health and wellness benefits, including a newly renovated gym with complimentary classes such as CrossFit and yoga.  •    Discounts: Receive discounts from a wide range of brands, as well as on transportation to and from airports, airport shops, hotels, and car rentals.  •    Work Environment: Our office location in Frösundavik offers a vibrant workspace with a restaurant, café, and easy access to outdoor activities in Hagaparken and Brunnsviken. Engage in running, tennis, outdoor gym sessions, kayaking, and stand-up paddling with equipment available free of charge.  •    Convenient Commute: Benefit from a non-stop bus service connecting our office to Solna station, and commuter trains, alongside a network of cycle paths.

At VARD, we create innovative and sustainable solutions for the global maritime industry. Through strong engineering expertise, cutting-edge technology, and close collaboration, we design and build some of the world’s most advanced vessels.

At the same time, we believe our people are our greatest strength. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment where talent can grow, ideas are valued, and individuals are empowered to make a difference.

jobs.description:
Teamet på Princess Flå søker etter en ny kollega - er det deg?

Vi har en ledig 29% stilling, med mulighet for ekstra ved sykdom, ferie og høytider.

Tiltredelse: 1 okotber, eller etter avtale, det viktigste er at vi finner riktig person.

I Princess er det kunden som er i fokus. Vi lever av lojale kunder. Vi søker derfor motiverte, engasjerte og hyggelige medarbeidere som leverer dag etter dag.

Arbeidsoppgaver:

  • Yte kundeservice på et høyt nivå
  • Få hver kunde til å føle seg velkommen til oss
  • Varemottak, vareplassering og varepåfyll
  • Klargjøring til kampanjer og annet forefallende butikkarbeid
  • Sørge for at butikken ser ren og innbydende ut

Vi ser etter deg som:

  • Har lyst til å jobbe i butikk
  • Er lærevilling
  • Liker kunder og kundemøter
  • Er initiativrik, engasjert, målrettet og strukturert
  • Er imøtekommende og serviceinnstilt med evne til å hjelpe kunden og finne deres behov
  • Er fleksibel og kan stille på kort varsel dersom noen av dine kollegaer blir syk
  • Liker å jobbe i team og mot et tydelig salgsmål
  • Er over 18 år.

Hva kan vi tilby?

  • God opplæring, både fysisk i butikk og i vår opplæringsapp, Princessakademiet
  • Et godt arbeidsmiljø
  • En variert hverdag
  • En jobb hos en trygg og forutsigbar arbeidsgiver
  • Lønn etter tariff og bonusordning
  • Gode rabatter for fast ansatte

NB! Kun søknader som sendes via vår rekrutteringsportal vil bli vurdert. Send oss CV og en personlig søknad. Vi vil vite hvorfor nettopp du er den rette for jobben, og hva du kan bidra med! For mer informasjon kontakt butikkleder Tiril Havikhagen. Telefon: 96092717

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Princess er opptatt av kundeservice, høy kompetanse og godt humør!
Princess er en av Norges største aktører innen interiør og hjemmetekstil, og er en landsdekkende kjede med 150 butikker, i tillegg til en stor nettbutikk. Vi er i stadig vekst, opererer i en spennende bransje, og jobber hver dag for å tilby våre kunder flotte kvalitetsvarer til en god pris. Vi har fokus på miljø og trygge produkter for hele familien. Hos oss finner du et stort utvalg av gardiner, sengetøy og interiørprodukter som lys, pynt, puter og pledd. Vi tilbyr også søm og solskjerming på mål, vi har alt du trenger for å skape et levende hjem med særpreg og atmosfære.

jobs.title: Assistant Workplace lead
jobs.description:
CBRE Global Workplace Solutions is a leading global provider of integrated facilities and corporate real estate management. We are recruiting for an Assistant Workplace Lead to join our team in Stockholm. This is a great opportunity for an experienced and enthusiastic candidate to join a global account team.

As Assistant Workplace Lead you will deputize to the Workplace Operations Lead, providing strategic support and operational leadership across campus. This role drives operational excellence, leads improvement projects, and supports governance and reporting activities to ensure high-quality service delivery and customer satisfaction.

Acting as a trusted partner to the Workplace Operations Lead, this role ensures continuity of leadership, drives operational initiatives, and maintains strong relationships with stakeholders and service partners. The Assistant Lead plays a critical role in translating strategic vision into operational execution, supporting the team to deliver consistent, efficient, and customer-focused facilities services across all sites within the geographical scope.

What You'll Do:

Client relationship and stakeholder engagement


    Build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders across campus and act a senior point of contact

    Represent CBRE interests and teams while aligning with the client's needs and expectations

    Support in client engagement activities and service review meetings with senior stakeholders

    Communicate operational updates, changes, and improvements to stakeholders in both English and Swedish

    Foster collaborative relationships with service providers and suppliers


Finance, governance and reporting


    Be well-versed in CBRE's contractual commitments, including financial, commercial and performance models and ensure operational compliance with contractual obligations

    Collate, prepare and analyse performance and governance reports to enable client sign off

    Collaborate with Workplace operations- lead, managers and Finance teams to prepare accurate forecasts, financial performance reviews and budget drafts

    Develop and maintain operational reports, dashboards, and performance metrics to help the team and client to better understand the operational output

    Prepare analysis and presentations on operational performance, key performance indicators, customer satisfaction and trends and make recommendations for improvements and service adjustments


Leadership and team support


    Support the Workplace Operations Lead in team leadership and management

    Provide guidance, coaching, and support to Workplace Operations Managers

    Foster a culture focused on service excellence, proactiveness and continuous improvement

    Support performance management activities, succession planning and team development initiatives

    Drive the one team and service first mindset across campus alongside the client

    Review and sign off on annual leave and other resource planning activities


Operational leadership and site management


    Support the Workplace Operations Lead in overseeing facilities operations and service delivery

    Good understanding of CBRE's contractual commitments, including statement of work, matrix of responsibility and service level agreements in order to translate these into effective deliverables for the teams in collaboration with the Workplace operations lead

    Act as deputy to the Workplace Operations Lead, providing leadership continuity in their absence

    Monitor service delivery performance and identify areas requiring attention or improvement and coordinate with Workplace operations managers to resolve challenges and implement improvements

    Working closely with QHSE- and operational teams to ensure sites are fully compliant with the client's and CBRE's QHSE standards

    Ensure health and safety policies and observations are logged to minimize risk exposure and enable a safe workplace environment

    Review and sign off all campus applicable risk assessments together with the Workplace Operations Manager


Improvement projects and strategic initiatives


    Lead and manage improvement projects to enhance operational efficiency and service quality

    Identify opportunities for process improvements and implement solutions

    Drive continuous improvement initiatives across campus operations

    Be an active participant in our vendor care program, working closely with strategically important service partners across the contract

    Support implementation of transformational change programs, including the Evolve program

    Analyse operational data and trends to inform strategic decision-making

    Program manage key projects, acting as a conduit between the client and CBRE's operational and project teams


Working hours and location

This position is based at the client's premises in Kista, Stockholm. This role requires onsite presence Monday to Friday, 08:00 to 17:00, depending on business needs. Occasional travel to other locations may be required.

jobs.title: Plant HSE Officer-OCI Nitrogen
jobs.description:
Grensarbeid zoekt voor CHILL een Plant HSE Officer

OCI Nitrogen is een van de marktleiders op het gebied van stikstofmeststoffen in Europa en een van de grootste producenten van melamine wereldwijd. Daarnaast is OCI momenteel een van de weinige producenten van hernieuwbare (groene) ammoniak.

Wanneer je bij OCI aan de slag gaat, krijg je de kans om iedere dag het verschil te maken terwijl je aan je carrière bouwt. Bij OCI draag je bovendien bij aan een duurzame leefomgeving. Onze meststoffen zorgen er dagelijks voor dat er voedsel op tafel komt. Met onze melamine maken we duurzame producten mogelijk zoals tafels, stoelen, laminaat en auto’s. Je komt onze producten dagelijks tegen in het dagelijks leven, vaak zonder dat je het doorhebt!

Dat wij duurzaamheid belangrijk vinden, zie je ook terug in onze emissies. Wij investeren continu in de best beschikbare technieken om onze emissies waar mogelijk te minimaliseren. Dankzij deze investeringen behoren onze emissies tot de laagste in vergelijking met onze wereldwijde concurrenten. Recent hebben we ook AdBlue aan ons productportfolio toegevoegd. AdBlue is een oplossing die wordt gebruikt in dieselmotoren om schadelijke uitstoot van stikstofoxiden (NOx) te verminderen.

Wat ga je doen als Plant HSE Officer?

Als HSE Officer bij OCI Nitrogen ben je verantwoordelijk voor het opzetten van en adviseren over het beleid op het gebied van (proces)veiligheid, arbeidsomstandigheden en milieu. Je bent een belangrijke schakel in de ontwikkeling, implementatie en borging van het HSE-beleid en draagt actief bij aan de continue verbetering van de HSE-cultuur.

In deze zelfstandige functie houd je je bezig met het creëren van bewustzijn rondom veilig werken binnen de organisatie, zowel op het gebied van persoonlijke veiligheid als procesveiligheid. Je voert risicoanalyses uit, identificeert potentiële gevaren en ontwikkelt procedures om deze risico’s te minimaliseren. Daarnaast ben je betrokken bij het opstellen en verzorgen van trainingen voor medewerkers op het gebied van veiligheid en gezondheid.

Je fungeert als eerste aanspreekpunt voor HSE-gerelateerde vraagstukken en ziet erop toe dat wordt voldaan aan alle relevante wet- en regelgeving.

In deze veelzijdige dagdienstfunctie maak je deel uit van een HSEQ-team dat ondersteuning biedt aan drie plant units. Je rapporteert rechtstreeks aan de HSEQ Manager.

Jij herkent jezelf in het volgende

  • Een afgeronde hbo-opleiding in een relevante richting, zoals HVK, Milieukunde, Veiligheidskunde of Chemische Technologie

  • Bij voorkeur ervaring als operator binnen een chemische productieomgeving

  • Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring in een vergelijkbare functie, bij voorkeur binnen de chemische industrie

  • Grondige kennis van relevante wet- en regelgeving op het gebied van veiligheid, gezondheid en milieu

  • Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om effectief samen te werken

  • Sterke analytische vaardigheden en oog voor detail

jobs.title: Avelsrådgivare och dossäljare Värmland
jobs.description:
Växa är ett ledande kunskapsföretag för lantbrukare med mjölk-, köttproduktion och växtodling. Genom den rådgivning och service vi säljer bidrar vi med ökad konkurrenskraft för svenskt lantbruk. Vår omsättning är drygt 560 miljoner kronor och vi har cirka 500 medarbetare fördelade på 27 driftsplatser över hela landet. Hållbarhet är centralt för oss, och våra kunder och Växa står för klimatsmart produktion och god djurhälsa.

Hos Växa får du utveckling - bra förmåner och engagerade kollegor. Tillsammans gör vi skillnad för våra kunder och medlemmar, och det märks!

About the Workplace

Växa is a leading knowledge-based company serving farmers within dairy, meat production, and crop cultivation. Through the advisory services and support we provide, we contribute to strengthening the competitiveness of Swedish agriculture. Our annual turnover exceeds SEK 560 million, and we employ approximately 500 people across 27 operational locations throughout the country. Sustainability is central to our mission, and together with our customers, Växa promotes climate‑smart production and high standards of animal health.

At Växa, you will find opportunities for development, attractive benefits, and dedicated colleagues. Together, we make a meaningful difference for our customers and members — and it truly shows.

1 plats(er).


Avelsrådgivare och dossäljare Kil, Värmland

Vill du vara med att utveckla framtidens mjölkkor i Sverige? Gillar du att skapa relationer med mjölk- och köttproducenter? Hos oss har du chansen att hitta ett roligt och utvecklande arbete! Vi söker en person som tycker om och vill arbeta med avel, kor, rådgivning, service och sälj. Är det du? Sök redan idag!

Tjänsten består av två delar, dels avelsrådgivning till våra befintliga och nya kunder, dels dossäljare. Som avelsrådgivare arbetar du tillsammans med kunderna med avelsstrategi och avelsplanering utifrån gårdens målsättningar.  Dossäljare innebär att du hanterar och tar in beställningar av doser som du levererar till gård var åttonde vecka då du även fyller på kväve i djurägarkärlen.

Du har ett lokalt team att luta dig mot men vi förväntar oss att du tar egna initiativ, har ett sinne för ordning och reda och kan arbeta självständigt.

Vi säljer VikingGenetics avelsmaterial och rådgivning till våra kunder. Blir du en av oss kommer du att vara en del i att utveckla framtidens hållbara kor och arbeta för att utveckla svensk animalieproduktion i nära samarbete med lantbrukare och våra andra rådgivare.

Vi söker dig som  

    Är Lantmästare, Agronom, Agrotekniker eller har skaffat erfarenhet av nötkreatur på annat sätt.
    Intresse för sälj och problemlösning på gård.
    Har god kommunikationsförmåga
    Har goda kunskaper i svenska, tal och skrift
    Har B-körkort och gillar att köra bil

Vi lägger stor vikt vid din personliga drivkraft och söker personer med stort engagemang och förmåga att möta människor. Som person är du öppen och lyhörd med tydligt affärs-, kund- och lösningsfokus. Du har lätt för att skapa goda relationer och tycker om att samarbeta i team.

Det är ett extra plus om du har

    Praktisk erfarenhet från lantbruk/djurproduktion
    Intresse och kunskap om avel

Omfattning och placeringsort

Heltid med placering på Växas driftsplats i Kil

Vi erbjuder
En spännande tjänst. Lön enligt överenskommelse.

Möjlighet att arbeta i ett dynamiskt team där vi tillsammans driver utvecklingen framåt.

    Ett flexibelt arbetsliv
    Kompetenta och engagerade kollegor
    Individuellt anpassad kompetensutveckling
    Sjukvårdsförsäkring
    Friskvårdsbidrag

För mer information om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta
Regionchef avel Sara Wiklert Petersson 010 - 4710702


Ansökan senast 2026-10-01
Skicka in din ansökan omgående. Urval kommer ske löpande. Tillträde efter överenskommelse.

jobs.title: Customer Support Agent
jobs.description:
We're looking for Customer Support Agents to join our team at our Gothenburg office on flexible on-call contracts of approximately 8 hours a week, including evenings and weekends. The estimated start date is October. You will be the voice of Axel Arigato across chat, email, and social, sorting out orders and answering the questions our customers care about. Our ambition is to optimize the end‑to‑end customer journey and to be seen as proactive rather than reactive in everything we do. Looking for something flexible alongside studies, freelance work, or another job? Come join us.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

This role suits someone who has a flexible schedule and is looking for extra hours that fit around it. You write well, you think before you reply, and you problem-solve with a warm tone. Shifts run across days, evenings, and weekends, and they change with business needs, so you are organized and reliable about your own availability. If you are curious about how a fashion brand runs behind the scenes, you will see plenty of it here.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

    

Handle customer requests in Zendesk and across Instagram, Facebook, X, WhatsApp, email, and live chat.

    

Keep a calm, warm, and professional tone with every customer, on every channel.

    

Stay current on our products and services so the answers you give are accurate.

    

Monitor order flows and step in early when a delivery looks like it will go wrong.

    

Point customers toward our self-service options when they are the faster route.

    

Gather what you need from the customer, escalate to the right team, and follow up until it is closed.

    

Log reasons for contact and customer feedback, and share the patterns with the teams who can act on them.

    

Track your daily KPIs and handle the routine admin that keeps the queue moving.

ARE YOU THE ONE?

We seek people with most of the following:

    

Studying, freelancing, or building something of your own, and looking for extra hours alongside it.

    

Clear, quick, and accurate in written Swedish and English (additional languages are a plus).

    

Confident representing a brand people care about.

    

Calm under pressure, and able to solve a problem before passing it on.

    

Comfortable working with people across teams.

    

Curious about how things run, and happy to suggest better ways.

    

Available for around 8 hours a week, including evenings and weekends.

HERE'S HOW TO APPLY

If this sounds like the right thing to have on the side, we would love to hear from you.

Apply by submitting your CV in English. Please do not include a photo or date of birth with your application; our recruitment process is competency-based.

We review applications continuously, and the position may be filled before the closing date.

CONTRACT TYPE & START DATE

Contract type: Temporary (on-call). Around 8 hours a week depending on business needs, including evenings and weekends. Location: Gothenburg office. Estimated starting date: October.

A BIT ABOUT AXEL ARIGATO

Founded in Sweden in 2014 by Albin Johansson and Max Svärdh, Axel Arigato was born with a disruptive mindset – modernising and democratising the sneaker landscape through a blend of style, quality, community and a digital-first approach.

Grounded in Scandinavian minimalism and elevated with playful, intentional details, every piece is designed with care: crafted to move globally, worn with individuality.

What began online expanded into physical spaces built for energetic cultural exchange - stores and experiences where conversations, performances and unexpected activations dissolve the boundaries between brand and culture.

Today, Axel Arigato continues to evolve with purpose via a people-powered approach. It shows up where culture happens: on streets, at events and across cities.

Built on curiosity. Driven by connection

OUR VALUES: DROP Diversity, Respect, Openness and Passion are our values that we live and breathe. They are the foundation for our current state and what we will always bring with us to the future.

jobs.title: Työnjohtaja/varaosamyyjä veneiden pariin (Tampere)
jobs.description:
Löytyykö sinulta kokemusta veneistä ja niiden toiminnasta sekä omaat hyvät myyntitaidot? Tervetuloa tiimiin!

Etsimme nyt asiakasyrityksellemme TYÖNJOHTAJAA/VARAOSAMYYJÄÄ vakituiseen työtehtävään. Yritys on monipuolisiin venehuoltoihin erikoistunut yritys, joilta onnistuu niin huollot, korjaukset kuin varustelutkin. Yrityksellä on myymälä Tampereella sekä verkkokauppa.

Tehtävässä toimit työnjohtajana eli organisoit huollon tehtäviä ja vastaanotat huoltoja. Lisäksi työtehtäviisi kuuluu erilaisten varaosien myynti. Hoidat myös tilauksia sekä huolehdit varaston ja verkkokaupan ylläpidosta. Iso osa työnkuvaa on asiakaspalvelu. Työkuvasi on monipuolinen ja pääset kehittymään ammattitaitoisessa tiimissä. Tärkeää on, että hektisissä päivissä pystyt tarvittaessa auttamaan huollon puolta ja taas toisessa hetkessä myymään asiakkaalle varaosia. Työnkuva vaatii siis paineensietokykyä muuttuviin tilanteisiin. Töitä tehdään ma-pe sovitusti myymälän aukioloaikojen puitteissa (klo 9.00-17.00). Yrityksen parhainta sesonkia on kesäaika, joten silloin kaivataan joustavuutta tekemiseen. Palkkaus tehtävään sovitusti ja kokemus huomioiden.

Toivomme hakijalta:

\- Kokemus/harrastuneisuus veneistä ja moottoritekniikasta

\- Innokasta ja motivoitunutta asennetta

\- Hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja

\- Myyntihenkisyyttä

\- Tietoteknistä osaamista

Eduksi katsotaan:

\- Kokemus autopuolelta vastaavasta tehtävästä voi olla hyvä pohja tehtävään

\- Varaosatuntemus ja korjaamokirjojen lukutaito

\- Halu kehittää korjaamon toimintaa toimivaksi ja organisoiduksi

Tarjoamme hakijalle:

\- Monipuoliset työtehtävät ja vastuullisen roolin

\- Mahdollisuuden kehittyä alan ammattilaisena

\- Mukavan ja yhteistyöhaluisen tiimin

jobs.title: Bli min BPA‑assistent – og bli med på en aktiv hverdag full av svømming, kreativitet og gode øyeblikk
jobs.description:
Jeg ser etter én fast og tilkallingsassistenter som vil være med på en variert, sosial og meningsfull hverdag. Hvis du liker å være aktiv, bidra til mestring og skape god stemning – da kan dette være jobben for deg.

Hvem er jeg

Jeg er en aktiv og livsglad kvinne på 33 år som bor i Lillestrøm sammen med hunden min, som er en viktig del av livet mitt. Jeg har redusert muskelstyrke i armer og bein, og trenger derfor praktisk assistanse i hverdagen – spesielt til svømming, trening, reiser og aktiviteter i hjemmet.

Jeg jobber med gaming og streaming, og har stor interesse for alt som skjer i den digitale verden. Før dette jobbet jeg med klesdesign i Sør‑Korea, hvor jeg bodde i fem år – en tid som fortsatt inspirerer meg hver eneste dag.

Jeg er positiv, motivert og full av stå-på-vilje, og ser etter fleksible og pålitelige assistenter som er glad i livet, liker å trene og setter pris på en god latter. 

Om stillingen

Jeg søker både én fast assistent på 15 timer i uken og tilkallingsassistenter. 

Arbeidstiden er hovedsakelig på dagtid, men arbeid kan også forekomme kveld, helg og helligdager etter behov. 

Arbeidsoppgaver

Jeg søker en personlig assistent som vil bli med meg på varierte og meningsfulle oppgaver. Hos meg vil du få en aktiv, spennende og givende arbeidshverdag hvor vi blant annet skal:

  • Dra på svømmetrening
  • Reise på jobboppdrag og delta på sosiale arrangementer
  • Handle inn mat og lage gode måltider 
  • Skape trivsel hjemme med husarbeid og praktiske oppgaver
  • Bidra med enkle, administrative oppgaver
  • Være komfortabel med at hunden min er en naturlig del av hverdagen

Hvem er du

Er du en positiv og engasjert person som liker å gjøre en forskjell i hverdagen? Da kan det være nettopp deg jeg leter etter!

For å trives i rollen ser jeg for meg at du:

  • Har fylt 18 år
  • Er ærlig, ansvarsbevisst og omsorgsfull
  • Er fleksibel og kan stille opp ved behov 
  • Er selvstendig, ryddig og trygg på deg selv
  • Er kreativ, liker å være aktiv og trives ute i frisk luft
  • Har plettfri vandel (politiattest må fremlegges)

Erfaring med BPA eller arbeid med mennesker er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Personlig egnethet betyr mest.

Kvinner oppfordres til å søke på grunn av arbeidets art.

Hva tilbyr vi

  • God opplæring og tett oppfølging
  • En variert og meningsfull jobb
  • En aktiv og sosial arbeidshverdag
  • Et trygt og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø
  • Gode lønnsbetingelser

Du blir ansatt hos Brageva, som står for kontrakt, lønn, pensjon, forsikringer og generell opplæring. Jeg står for opplæringen i selve jobben og blir din nærmeste arbeidsleder.

Hvis dette høres ut som noe for deg, håper jeg du sender en kort søknad og forteller litt om hvem du er og hvorfor du ønsker å jobbe som assistent.

Jeg gleder meg til å høre fra deg!


Om arbeidsgiverBrageva har vært formell arbeidsgiver for assistenter siden 2016. Vi har spesialisert oss på tjenesten BPA (brukerstyrt personlig assistanse) og leverer i dag denne tjenesten i hele Norge. Vi har konsesjon for å levere BPA i over 120 kommuner.

Vi elsker for øvrig frigjøringsverktøyet BPA som gir mennesker med funksjonsnedsettelser muligheter til å leve selvstendige liv og bidra på alle områder i samfunnet.

Vi er en liten aktør i BPA-bransjen og har derfor korte beslutningsveier, som kommer både våre ansatte og våre arbeidsledere til gode. Vår administrasjon sitter i Trondheim og består av en herlig gjeng med ulik bakgrunn, kunnskap og personligheter. Vi er den lille BPA-leverandøren med det store hjertet.

Les mer om oss på https://brageva.no/

Om oss Vang høyrer til Valdres prosti i Hamar bispedømme. Vang er den vestlegaste av kommunane i Valdres, på grensa mot Sogn, og dermed midt mellom Oslo og Bergen. Me har ca. 1650 innbyggarar, med kulturskule, korps og kor, i tillegg til eit vidt spekter av anna frivillig arbeid. Kyrkja i Vang har 4 sokn; Heensåsen, Høre, Vang og Øye, med 6 kyrkjer - deriblant 2 stavkyrkjer og ei økumenisk fjellkyrkje.

Staben består av sokneprest, kyrkjeverje, kontormedarbeidar, kyrkjegardsarbeidar, organist og kyrkjelydsarbeider. I tillegg har me kyrkjetenarar, klokkarar og reinhaldarar tilknytta kyrkjene.

Vang kommune – ei flott kommune å bu i:

  • Ei storstilt satsing på barn og unge!
  • Ein kombinert barne - og ungdomsskule, med ca 200 elever. Nyrenovert med heilt ny fleirbrukshall med klatrevegg, basseng etc. Tolærarsystem, slik at det nesten alltid er to lærarar tilstades i klasserommet. Skulen nyttar Vang sin flotte natur mykje, både ved uteskule, faget FRI-NAT (friluftsliv og natur), og spanande utflukter. I Vang er SFO gratis for alle barn!
  • Vang kommune har to barnehagar, Høre og Fredheim, begge har småbarns og storbarnsavdeling. I Vang er det løpande barnehageopptak (start når det passar dykk!)
  • Helse og omsorgstenester av god kvalitet
  • Byggeklare tomter fleire stadar i kommunen, alle med fantastisk utsikt!
  • I Vang finn du 2 solide kontorfellesskap, gjer som fleire andre og ta med deg arbeidet til Vang!
  • Både i Vang og resten av Valdres finn du eit yrande kulturliv, der tradisjon står i høgsete, med blant anna tradisjonsmat, tradisjonsmusikk, tradisjonshandverk og aktiv stølsdrift. Vang kommune har også ein god kulturskule med stort utval av tradisjonelle og moderne aktivitetar
  • I Vang står lag, foreiningar og idrett sterkt, her finn du aktivitetar for ein kvar smak!
  • Vang har ein storarta natur som innbyr til friluftsliv sommar som vinter, er du glad i turar, ski, jakt og fiske så er dette staden for deg! Vang blir sagt å ha "vestlandsfjell med austlandsklima", og er ei bygd med landbruk, grundarar, turisme og næringsliv i eit levande og inkluderande bygdesamfunn.

I Vang finn du også store delar av Jotunheimen og ikkje minst festivalen Vinjerock

  • I Vang har dei fleste kort avstand mellom arbeid, barnehage og skule. Her kan du leve eit så roleg eller så aktivt liv som du sjølv ynskjer, i ei distriktskommune med positiv folketalsutvikling
  • Meir info om korleis det er å bu i Vang og kva som skjer i Vang finn du på nettsida; vangivaldres.no
  • Meir info om arbeids - og bumarkedet i Valdres finn du på nettsida; valdres.no/velgvaldres
