jobs.title: PhD Fellow in Distributed Acoustic Sensing for Arctic Railway Infrastructure Monitoring
jobs.employer: UNIVERSITETET I TROMSØ - NORGES ARKTISKE UNIVERSITET UIT CAMPUS NARVIK
jobs.description:
The position

A PhD position is available at the Department of Electrical Engineering (IET), Faculty of Engineering Sciences and Technology, UiT The Arctic University of Norway. The position is within the field of distributed fibre-optic sensing for railway infrastructure monitoring, with particular emphasis on the use of Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) for monitoring railway infrastructure and natural hazards along the Ofoten Line.

The position is for a period of four years. The nominal length of the PhD programme is three years. The fourth year is distributed as 25 % each year and will consist of teaching and other duties. The objective of the position is to complete research training to the level of a doctoral degree. Admission to the PhD programme is a prerequisite for employment, and the programme period starts on commencement of the position.

The workplace is at UiT in Narvik. You must be able to start in the position within a reasonable time after receiving the offer.


The position’s field of research

The position is associated with a new research initiative at UiT on intelligent monitoring and resilience of railway and transport infrastructure in Arctic environments that aims to address how distributed sensing, fibre-optic monitoring, environmental observations, drone- and satellite-based data, operational infrastructure datasets, and/or machine learning can be used to support real-time monitoring, predictive maintenance, geohazard detection, and safer railway operations. The initiative is a collaboration between the Department of Electrical Engineering, the Department of Computer Science and Computational Engineering, and the Department of Geosciences.
Research infrastructure is provided via existing data, sensor networks, and established field sites along the Ofoten Line and new initiatives associated with the Arctic Test Arena project.

Railway infrastructure in Arctic and Nordic regions is increasingly exposed to harsh weather, heavy traffic loads, climate-related hazards, and growing operational demands. Current railway monitoring systems still rely largely on manual inspections and periodic measurements. This makes it challenging to detect early signs of infrastructure degradation, vibration-related damage, geohazards, snow avalanches, rockfalls, landslides, track irregularities, wheel defects, bearing faults, and people and animals on the track.

The PhD project will investigate how existing fibre-optic cable infrastructure along the Ofoten line railway, one of Norway’s most strategically important and climate-exposed railways, can be used as a distributed sensor network for continuous infrastructure monitoring. Standard optical fibres will be used as dense arrays of vibration sensors, making it possible to measure dynamic strain and acoustic disturbances along many kilometres of fibre with down to metre-scale spatial resolution – a technique coined Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS). The long-term ambition is to enable high-resolution, real-time warning and decision support for railway operations and maintenance.

The successful candidate will work on developing, testing, modelling, and validating methods for DAS-based monitoring of railway infrastructure and surrounding terrain. The work can include physics-based modelling of e.g., various events and wave propagation through different media, signal processing, large-scale data analysis, algorithm development and potentially also field work.

The applicants must present a description outlining the academic basis of the PhD project. The project description shall not exceed 2 pages, including reference lists/figures/tables if relevant. It must include a description of the topic, research question(s) and a reasoning of the choices. It should also indicate the methodologies to be used. The final project description will be developed in cooperation with the supervisor.


Qualifications

This position requires a master’s degree or equivalent in applied mathematics, signal processing, physics, geophysics, civil engineering (electrical, geotechnical, structural, environmental, transportation, construction, computer etc.), data/computer science or similar. If you are near completion of your master’s degree, you may still apply.

Applicants must document good English skills and be able to work in an international environment. Nordic applicants can document their English capabilities by attaching their high school diploma.

The candidate should have expertise in data analysis and be able to implement data analysis tools in a suitable programming language. It is also advantageous with knowledge and/or capabilities in one or more of the following topics:

  • Signal processing
  • Physical/geophysical modelling
  • Computer science
  • Geohazards
  • Waves and fields
  • Material science

In the assessment, the emphasis is on the applicant's potential to complete a research education based on the master's thesis or equivalent, and any other scientific work. Evaluation of the candidate is not only based on the candidates track record in education, but other experiences that can be relevant for the PhD work. This includes teaching, practical experience with e.g., railway infrastructure and/or other relevant work or activities. The project description will also be considered. In addition, professional experience and other experience of significance for the completion of the doctoral programme will be taken into consideration.

We will also emphasize motivation and personal suitability for the position. We are looking for candidates who:

  • Have good communication and interaction with colleagues and students
  • Can contribute to a positive and productive working environment
  • Are able to work both independently and in groups on defined research topics
  • Have good work ethics

As many people as possible should have the opportunity to undertake organized research training. If you already hold a PhD or have equivalent competence, we will not appoint you to this position.


Admission to the PhD programme 

For employment in the PhD position, you must be qualified for admission to the PhD programme at the Faculty of Engineering Science and Technology and participate in organized doctoral studies within the employment period.

Admission normally requires:  

  • A bachelor's degree of 180 ECTS and a master's degree of 120 ECTS, or an integrated master's degree of 300 ECTS. 
  • A master's thesis with a scope corresponding to at least 30 ECTS for a master's degree of 120 ECTS. 
  • A master's thesis with a scope corresponding to at least 20 ECTS for an integrated master's degree of 300 ECTS. 

 

In order to gain admission to the programme, applicants with a background from a Norwegian institution should have a minimum grade of C on their master thesis and a weighted grade average of 3.0 for the last two years of their master programme. A more detailed description of admission requirements can be found here. 

If you are employed in the position, you will be provisionally admitted to the PhD programme. Application for final admission must be submitted no later than two months after taking up the position. 

Applicants with a foreign education will be subjected to an evaluation of whether the educational background is equal to Norwegian higher education, following national guidelines from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills. Depending on which country the education is from, one or two additional years of university education may be required to fulfil admission requirements, e.g. a 4-year bachelor's degree and a 2-year master's degree. UiT normally accepts higher education from countries that are part of the Lisbon Recognition Convention.


Inclusion and diversity

UiT The Arctic University of Norway is working actively to promote equality, gender balance and diversity among employees and students, and to create an inclusive and safe working environment. We believe that inclusion and diversity are a strength, and we want employees with different competencies, professional experience, life experience and perspectives.

If you have a disability, a gap in your CV or immigrant background, we encourage you to tick the box for this in your application. If there are qualified applicants, we invite at least one in each group for an interview. If you get the job, we will adapt the working conditions if you need it. Apart from selecting the right candidates, we will only use the information for anonymous statistics.


We offer
  • A dynamic and expanding research environment 
  • Good career opportunities 
  • A supportive academic community with committed colleagues
  • Flexible working hours and a state collective pay agreement  
  • Pension scheme through the state pension fund 
  • PhD Fellows are normally given a salary of 580 000 NOK/year with a 3% yearly increase

Norwegian health policy aims to ensure that everyone, irrespective of their personal finances and where they live, has access to good health and care services of equal standard. As an employee you will become member of the National Insurance Scheme which also include health care services.

More practical information about working and living in Norway can be found here: https://uit.no/staffmobility


Application 

Please note that the application will only be assessed based on the information submitted by the application deadline via Jobbnorge. It is therefore important that you include all necessary documents demonstrating your qualifications for the position.

Your application must include: 

  • Cover letter explaining your motivation and research interests (max 1 page)
  • CV
  • Official diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degree in the original language 
  • Official transcripts of grades/academic record for Bachelor's and Master's degree in the original language
  • Official translation of diplomas and transcripts of records (ToR) to English or a Scandinavian language, if applicable
  • Explanation of the grading system for foreign education (Diploma Supplement if available)
  • Documentation of English proficiency
  • 2-3 references with contact information
  • Master’s thesis, and any other academic works
  • Project description  (max 2 pages references included)

Qualification with a master’s degree is required before commencement in the position. If you are near completion of your master’s degree, you may still apply and submit a draft version of the thesis and a statement from your supervisor or institution indicating when the degree will be obtained. You must still submit your transcript of grades for the master’s degree with your application.

All documentation to be considered must be in a Scandinavian language or English. If your diplomas and transcripts are written in a different language, you must upload both an English/Scandinavian translation and the originals. If English proficiency is not documented in the application, it must be documented before starting in the position. Applications and supporting documentation are only accepted via Jobbnorge and must be submitted within the application deadline.


Assessment 

The applicants will be assessed by an expert committee. The committee's mandate is to undertake an assessment of the applicants' qualifications based on the written material presented by the applicants, and the detailed description draw up for the position. A copy of the assessment report will be sent to all applicants. 

The applicants who are assessed as best qualified will be called to an interview. The interview should among other things, aim to clarify the applicant’s motivation and personal suitability for the position. 


General information 

The appointment is made in accordance with State regulations and guidelines at UiT. At our website, you will find more information for applicants. 

The engagement is to be made in accordance with the acts relating to Control of the Export of Strategic Goods, Services and Technology. Candidates who by assessment of the application and attachment are seen to conflict with the criteria in the latter law will be prohibited from recruitment. After the appointment you must assume that there may be changes in the area of work.

Remuneration for the position of PhD Fellow is in accordance with the State salary scale code 1017. A compulsory contribution of 2 % to the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund will be deducted. You will become a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund, which gives you many benefits in addition to a lifelong pension: You may be entitled to financial support if you become ill or disabled, your family may be entitled to financial support when you die, you become insured against occupational injury or occupational disease, and you can get good terms on a mortgage. Read more about your employee benefits at: spk.no.

A shorter period of appointment may be decided when the PhD Fellow has already completed parts of their research training programme or when the appointment is based on a previous qualifying position PhD Fellow, research assistant, or the like in such a way that the total time used for research training amounts to three years. 

We process personal data given in an application or CV in accordance with the Personal Data Act (Offentleglova). According to the Personal Data Act information about the applicant may be included in the public applicant list, also in cases where the applicant has requested non-disclosure. You will receive advance notification in the event of such publication, if you have requested non-disclosure. 


Om arbeidsgiveren:

UiT The Arctic University of Norway is an internationally leading broad-based university. Our vision is to be a driving force in the North. The Northern Sami term eallju, which means diligence, sets the tone for UiT's drive. Together with students, staff, and society at large, we will utilize our location in Northern Norway and Sápmi, our academic breadth, and interdisciplinary advantages to shape the future.

UiT has approximately 18,000 students, more than 4,000 employees, and is established across four main campuses and seven additional study locations in Northern Norway and on Svalbard. Our largest campuses are Tromsø, Alta, Narvik, and Harstad. UiT has seven faculties, 40 departments and centers, and leading research environments in various fields. The university offers 269 study programs and focuses on educational quality.

Academic freedom, scientific principles, and research ethics form the foundation of all UiT's activities. Participation, co-determination, transparency, and sound processes will provide the basis for making wise and forward-looking decisions. Our students and staff will have the opportunity to develop their abilities and potential. Rooted in scientific integrity, we aim to be bold, engaged, and generous - closely connected to academia, people, and contemporary developments.

Read more about UiT's strategy towards 2030.

jobs.title: Workshop Mechanic - Gadbjerg, near Vejle, Denmark
jobs.description:
About us

We run a workshop about 15 km from Vejle in East Jutland, Denmark, in close partnership between GMT and Nordic Rebar ApS. You will be employed by Nordic Rebar ApS, which is based at the workshop.
GMT trades in used machinery for the rebar industry and is a well-known player in the industry across most of the world.
Together, we hold a large stock of used machines that continuously need to be inspected and refurbished, and we are therefore looking for a mechanic who will make the workshop his or her permanent base.

About the job

As a workshop mechanic, you will be responsible for keeping the workshop running and the machines in good order. Your tasks will include:

·         Repair and preparation of used machines for the rebar industry
·         Loading and unloading machines and accessories using a forklift truck (a valid forklift/truck licence is required)
·         General maintenance and tidiness in the workshop

The workshop has an office attached to it, so you will have good colleagues around you, and we have lunch together.

The workshop has modern facilities, including a laser cleaner for removing rust and dirt, and we place great emphasis on the work being carried out safely and properly.

In the workshop itself you will typically be the only mechanic on a daily basis, so you must be able to plan and carry out your tasks independently.
 
We expect you to

·         Have a technical/trade background, e.g. as a car or truck mechanic, industrial electrician, or mechatronics technician, with good mechanical aptitude
·         Have at least 10 years of relevant work experience
·         Hold a valid forklift/truck licence
·         Be responsible and have a can-do attitude
·         Be able to work independently and organise your own working day
·         Not be afraid of getting dirty
·         Understand and speak English
·         Be an EU citizen
 
Terms of employment

This is a permanent position with Nordic Rebar ApS, on the terms and under the rules and legislation applicable in Denmark.
·         Starting salary: EUR 25 per hour, paid monthly
·         Weekly working hours: 37 hours - overtime may occur and can possibly be compensated with time off, among other things to allow for more frequent trips home, if needed
·         Start date: as soon as possible
·         Workplace: Gadbjerg, approx. 15 km from Vejle
·         Accommodation (a smaller apartment/room) can be arranged locally - expected rent approx. DKK 4,000-5,000 per month max
 
Application

Applications should be sent by e-mail to ud@gmtaps.com.

Questions are welcome and can be directed to Ulrich Deichmann, GMT, tel. +45 20 98 94 44, or Arne Hansen, Nordic Rebar ApS, tel. +45 51 46 20 50.

jobs.title: Allround-håndværker søges til fast ansættelse/All-round tradesperson wanted for full-time position
jobs.description:
Dansk:

Vi søger en erfaren og ansvarsbevidst allround-håndværker, som har primært erfaring og gode faglige kompetencer inden for tømrer- og malerfaget.

Arbejdsopgaverne vil blandt andet omfatte tømrerarbejde og mindre renoveringsopgaver, opbygning og afretning af undergulve, lægning af klikgulve, lamelgulve og massive trægulve samt montering af lister, paneler, aflslibning af trægulve og behandling af trægulve. Derudover vil arbejdet bestå af spartling, opsætning af filt og maling af vægge, lofter og træværk.

Der kan også forekomme reparationer, vedligeholdelse og forskellige mindre håndværksopgaver, som kan berøre eller trække på andre håndværksfag.

Vi leder efter en fagligt dygtig og alsidig person med relevant brancheerfaring. Du skal kunne arbejde selvstændigt, tage ansvar for dine opgaver og levere et pænt resultat med fokus på kvalitet og detaljer.

Du skal kunne kommunikere på dansk eller engelsk. Kørekort er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Vi tilbyder fast fuldtidsansættelse med ordnede forhold, løn efter kvalifikationer og varierede opgaver i Storkøbenhavn og Nordsjælland. Du bliver en del af en virksomhed med et godt arbejdsmiljø, hvor samarbejde, ansvarlighed og høj faglig kvalitet vægtes højt.

Arbejdstiden er som udgangspunkt mandag til fredag kl. 7.00–15.00. Opstart hurtigst muligt eller efter aftale.

Hvis stillingen lyder som noget for dig, bedes du sende en kort ansøgning og dit CV til info@gp-byggeservice.dk.

English:

We are looking for an experienced and responsible all-round tradesperson with strong practical skills and experience, primarily within carpentry and painting.

The work will include carpentry and minor renovation projects, building and levelling subfloors, installing click flooring, engineered flooring and solid wooden floors, as well as fitting trims, skirting boards, floor sanding and floor coating. The position will also involve filling, installing wall lining and painting walls, ceilings and woodwork.

There may also be various repair and maintenance tasks, as well as smaller assignments involving other building trades.

We are looking for a skilled and versatile professional with relevant industry experience. You must be able to work independently, take responsibility for your assignments and deliver high-quality results with attention to detail.

You must be able to communicate in Danish or English. A valid driver’s licence is an advantage but not a requirement.

We offer permanent full-time employment with proper working conditions, salary based on qualifications and varied projects across Greater Copenhagen and North Zealand. You will join a company with a positive working environment where teamwork, responsibility and professional quality are highly valued.

Working hours are generally Monday to Friday from 7:00 to 15:00. The position is available for an immediate start or by agreement.

If this position sounds suitable for you, please send a short application and your CV to info@gp-byggeservice.dk.

jobs.title: Barnvakt sökes till familj på Lidingö - Hemfrid (Extrajobb)
jobs.description:
Hemfrid är Sveriges största företag inom hemstädning. Vi hjälper våra kunder med tjänster i hemmet såsom städning, fönsterputs och mycket annat.

Just nu söker vi en trygg och ansvarsfull barnvakt till en familj på Lidingö.

Vi söker en barnvakt som kontinuerligt kan hjälpa till med hämtning från förskolan cirka två dagar i veckan vår kund i Lidingö.

Efter hämtning kommer du att ta hand om barnet tills föräldrarna kommer hem. Arbetsuppgifterna kan bland annat innebära lek, pyssel, enklare mellanmål och att skapa en trygg och rolig stund efter förskolan.

Vi söker dig som…

    

Har minst ett års erfarenhet av barnpassning, exempelvis genom att ha tagit hand om syskon eller släktingar, eller genom arbete som privat barnvakt eller au pair.

    

Alternativt har minst 6 månaders erfarenhet av arbete i förskola eller som barnskötare för små barn.

    

Är trygg, ansvarsfull och har ett genuint intresse för barn.

    

Talar och förstår svenska flytande.

    

Kan arbeta cirka två eftermiddagar i veckan på Lidingö.

    

Söker ett långsiktigt extrajobb och vill bygga en trygg relation med familjen.

Vi erbjuder

    

Ett flexibelt extrajobb, perfekt för dig som studerar eller vill arbeta deltid.

    

Timanställning med OB-tillägg (kvällar, helger och storhelger).

    

Kollektivavtal och goda anställningsvillkor.

    

Ett meningsfullt arbete där du får göra skillnad i ett barns vardag.

Vill du bli en del av Hemfrid? Välkommen med din ansökan!

Kontakta oss gärna på HR@hemfrid.se om du har några frågor om tjänsten eller vår rekryteringsprocess. Vi genomför alltid en bakgrundskontroll innan anställning.

jobs.title: Senior Service Engineer, High Voltage; DK - Esbjerg
jobs.description:
Do you have a passion for renewable energy and a sharp eye for technical details? Are you excited about managing projects from start to finish but also want to use your technical skillset and knowhow hands-on offshore? If so, we want to hear from you!

Your position 

As our new Senior Service Engineer in the Renewable division, you will be a valuable member of the Medium and High Voltage Service team, whose mission is to execute medium- and high-voltage service projects across disciplines for offshore assets, e.g. OSS, rigs, and WTGs. You will have the chance to drive all aspects of the project process, from initial client inquiries to final execution. Moreover, this role provides an exciting opportunity for you to make a lasting impact on the projects you work on and advance your professional development.

At Semco Maritime, safety is a core value, and in this role, you will contribute to maintaining and promoting a strong safety culture while delivering innovative solutions. Above all, your work will make a real difference to the global energy sector.

Your place of work will be our Global HQ in Esbjerg, and you should live within daily driving distance of Esbjerg. The position is full-time, and up to 90 travel days per year should be expected.
“You will be part of a team of fantastic and competent colleagues who prioritise teamwork and a ‘winning as a team’ mentality. Our team values a flexible work atmosphere with an emphasis on balancing work and personal life, as well as opportunities for professional growth. In this role, you will have great opportunities to bring your own ideas to the table and play a key role in shaping our projects and services.”                                                              – Christian Poulsen, Head of MV & HV Service

Your tasks & responsibilities 

As a Senior Service Engineer, you will be responsible for managing and executing MV & HV Service projects from a technical perspective in collaboration with cross-functional teams, external partners, and customers. Moreover, you will apply your expertise hands-on by using your specialist knowledge to execute the service. You will be responsible from the initiation and tendering of the project through to delivering a solution and finally executing it offshore. This will involve collaborating with various teams across the organisation and externally.

Your tasks will include but are not limited to:
  • You will have end-to-end technical responsibility for specific projects in the MV & HV Service team, from tendering, clarification, and planning to execution.
  • Provide technical assistance and calculations to support projects across the organisation.
  • Perform hands-on offshore special technical testing and troubleshooting.
  • Coordinate and plan work packages for execution, both on- and offshore.

Your profile & qualifications

As a person, you enjoy having a lot of responsibility and thrive in an environment where you communicate daily with many stakeholders. You are driven by completing tasks to the best of your ability and remain in control, even in fast-paced situations. You have a safety-focused mindset and never compromise when it comes to safety on the job. Additionally, you are service-minded and greatly enjoy collaborating with your colleagues.

To succeed in this position, we imagine that you have:

  • An engineering degree or similar qualification within electrical systems.
  • Broad know-how of MV and HV systems and technologies from the offshore wind industry.
  • In-depth knowledge of electrical systems.
  • A proven track record of servicing protection systems for both low voltage and high voltage.
  • Broad knowledge of electrical systems: high, medium, and low voltage.
  • Desire and willingness to travel and perform hands-on onsite work.
  • Fluency in English, written and verbal.

Welcome to Semco Maritime 
At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape. 

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in. 

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future. 
So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.  

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.   

Care to join the movement? 

Change. With us. 

We conduct our interviews on an ongoing basis, so if you are interested, you must submit your application as soon as possible via the link on the page.
If you have any questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Christian Poulsen, Head of MV & HV Service at +45 2294 4199.

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

jobs.title: Myyntitiimin Päällikkö
jobs.description:
Haemme nyt vastuullista ja motivoitunutta myyntipäällikköä rakentamaan oma kymmenen henkilön myynti/asiakaspalvelu ryhmä.
Monipuolisessa tehtävänkuvassa työskentelet itse rekrytoijana, valmentajana, esimiehenä ja myynnin kehittäjänä. Osallistut myös uusien projektien myynnin lanseeraukseen ja yhteistyön kehittämiseen.
Pääset siis aitiopaikalle vaikuttamaan alusta saakka oman tiimisi menestykseen ja saat yhtiöltämme kaikki mahdolliset välineet sekä tuen tehtävässä menestymistä varten.
Työ alkaa kuukauden mittaisella trainee-jaksolla jossa tutustut yhtiömme toimintatapoihin sekä asiakkaidemme tuotteiden myyntiin ja siihen liittyviin prosesseihin. Tehtävä alkaa heti trainee-jakson jälkeen.

Hakemamme henkilö on joko jo kannuksensa tuloksekkaasta myynti tai valmennustyöstä hankkinut urallaan eteenpäin haluava ammattilainen tai sellaiseksi haluava.
Arvostamme tulevaisuuteen katsovaa määrätietoista otetta ja sitoutumista liiketoimintamme kokonaisvaltaiseen kehittämiseen. Tärkeintä on, että lähdet tehtävään oikealla asenteella ja olet valmis sitoutumaan projektiin.

Paikallistuntemus katsotaan myös eduksi. Työ on kovaa, mutta erittäin palkitsevaa!
Ansaintamahdollisuudet ovat erinomaiset.
Ansiosi kasvavat tiimisi myynnin mukana ja tähän ei ole lasikattoa. Jos olet valmis ottamaan vastuuta ja haluat että työsi tulokset näkyvät hyvinä ansioina, niin voit hyvinkin olla etsimämme henkilö!


Ota nopeasti yhteyttä sillä paikka täytetään heti oikean henkilön löydyttyä. Lähetä vapaamuotoinen hakemuksesi yhteystietoineen osoitteeseen; timo.soikkeli@doony.fi niin olen sinuun yhteydessä.

Vi i Sandvika distrikt ser etter en nye kollegaer.

I Bærum kommune er hjemmet førstevalg for innbyggerne. Dette stiller høye krav til oss, og i takt med at vi får mer avansert behandling og pleie av pasientene hjemme, blir det også mer faglig spennende å jobbe i ambulerende tjeneste. Som team møter vi fremtidens utfordringer med bred kompetanse, fokus på hverdagsmestring og satsing på velferdsteknologi. Her får du mulighet til å påvirke din egen arbeidshverdag og turnus i et godt og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø. Vi holder til sentralt i Sandvika, med god offentlig kommunikasjon (tog og buss).

Stillingene innebærer to-delt turnus med arbeid hver 3. helg. Stillingene er 100% vikariat i ett år med mulighet for forlengelse.

  • Gjøre sykepleiefaglige observasjoner, iverksette tiltak og gjennomføre oppfølging av beboere
  • Sikre forsvarlige pleie- og omsorgstjenester i tråd med kvalitetskrav og lovverk
  • Veiledning av sykepleiestudenter og kollegaer
  • Tilrettelegge og koordinere tjenesten sammen med pasientene og sikre at brukermedvirkning ivaretas
  • Samarbeide tverrfaglig med spesialisthelsetjenesten, fastleger og kommunehelsetjenesten

  • Søkere fra land utenfor Skandinavia må ha bestått norskprøve B2 eller tilsvarende
  • Fortrolig med bruk av relevante IT-verktøy
  • Kunnskap om lovverk for tjenesteområdet
  • Førerkort klasse B
Personlige egenskaper
  • Føler ansvar og tar initiativ
  • Har pågangsmot
  • Har evne til å planlegge og gjennomføre
  • Er innovativ, og våger å tenke nytt og kreativt
  • Verdsetter gode kollegaer og liker å jobbe sammen som et lag
  • Har et genuint ønske om å jobbe i kommunehelsetjenesten og være med på å utvikle morgendagens tjenester
  • Bidrar til et godt arbeidsmiljø

Personlig egnethet vil bli vektlagt

Vi tilbyr
  • Turnus med arbeid hver 3. helg
  • Et godt arbeidsmiljø
  • Variert arbeidsdag med interessante faglige utfordringer
  • Offentlig tjenestepensjon
  • Sykepleier i turnus tilbys en grunnlønn som i dag ligger kr 35 000 over garantilønn i KS-områdets tariffavtale. Ved relevant og nyttiggjort etterutdanning, minimum 30 eller 60 studiepoeng, kan det eventuelt tilbys henholdsvis ytterligere kr 15 000 eller kr 30 000 i økt grunnlønn

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Sammen skaper vi et godt og inkluderende samfunn for over 130 000 innbyggere, både i dag og i årene som kommer. Vi skaper rammer som bidrar til at de aller minste kan leke og lære og at de som trenger en hjelpende hånd får en hverdag preget av mestring, mening og verdighet. Vi gjør et bredt spekter av arbeidsoppgaver, og felles for oss alle er at vi får tillit og myndighet til å påvirke vår egen arbeidshverdag for å skape et samfunn som er godt å leve i. jobs.title: BPA-assistent søkes til aktiv småbarnsmor – en jobb med mening og variasjon
jobs.employer: PRIMA ASSISTANSE AS AVD MØRE OG ROMSDAL
jobs.description:
Jeg er en aktiv og sosial småbarnsmor som søker etter BPA-assistenter i 50% fast stilling til teamet mitt. Jeg er nå avhengig av rullestol og er til en viss grad selvhjulpen, men trenger en ekstra person ved min side for at hverdagen skal flyte litt lettere.

Hvem er jeg:

Som person er jeg åpen, kreativ og nysgjerrig. Jeg har reist mye og liker å møte nye mennesker og oppleve nye ting. Jeg er 50 år og bor på vakre Flisnes hvor jeg deler hjem med mann, barna mine (1,5 og 6 år) – og en katt – så det er en fordel om du ikke er allergisk. For meg er god kjemi viktig, og jeg legger stor vekt på å finne en person som passer godt inn i hverdagen vår.

Hva innebærer jobben som assistent?

Dagene mine er sjelden like, men går i all hovedsak til å ivareta barna. Med deg som ekstra ressurs vil jeg få være en selvstendig mamma. Det kan innebære alt fra helt vanlige hverdagsoppgaver hjemme, leke og gjøre lekser og følge til skole/ barnehage eller fritidsaktiviteter. Det er også viktig for meg å ivareta egentrening der en del av det er å være i svømmehall. Jeg liker å være aktiv og vi tilbringer mye tid ute, enten det er turer i skogen eller en ettermiddag på lekeplassen. Akkurat nå er ikke multi-tasking min sterkeste side pga. medisiner, så jeg trenger en person som kan bidra til at logistikken i hverdagen går litt smidigere.

For å trives i jobben tror jeg du:

·      Er voksen, selvstendig og trygg i deg selv

·     Er flink til å lytte

·      Ser hva som må gjøres og tar initiativ når det er naturlig

·      Har erfaring fra omgang med barn

·      Er glad i å være ute i naturen – vær og vind stopper sjelden oss

Krav til stillingen er:

·      flytende muntlig og skriftlig norsk

·      plettfri vandel

·      førerkort klasse B (manuell)

Vi tilbyr:

·      En trygg og fast stilling med tariffavtale

·      God opplæring og tett oppfølging fra vårt lokalkontor

·      En variert og selvstendig jobb

·      Hyggelig arbeidsmiljø og mulighet for faglig og personlig utvikling

 

Høres dette ut som noe for deg?

Send inn en søknad – vi vurderer fortløpende. Har du spørsmål, er du hjertelig velkommen til å ta kontakt. Jeg gleder meg til å høre fra deg!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

BPA er en forkortelse for brukerstyrt personlig assistanse. Det er i hovedsak en alternativ måte å organisere praktisk bistand på for funksjonshemmede. BPA skiller seg fra mer tradisjonelle tjenester ved at det er personen med assistansebehov som selv bestemmer hvordan assistansen skal være. BPA er et frigjørings- og likestillingsverktøy som bidrar til at den med assistansebehov får frihet til å leve et selvstendig og aktivt liv - på lik linje med andre i samfunnet. Prima Assistanse har spesialisert seg på BPA, og er i dag en betydelig leverandør i hele Norge. Vi jobber hver dag for å bidra til at funksjonshemmede får den friheten og assistansen som er nødvendig for å kunne leve et selvstendig liv. Vi er opptatt av å levere et godt konsept, kvalitet i alle ledd, å ha profesjonelle medarbeidere og gode rutiner, slik at vi sammen bidrar til en suksessfull hverdag. Nysgjerring på hvordan det er å jobbe hos oss? Les mer på vår karriereside: https://prima-assistanse.no/karriere/jobbe-som-bpa-assistent/

jobs.title: EUROSPAR Ålesund Storsenter søker tilkallingsvikar
jobs.description:
EUROSPAR Ålesund Storsenter søker tilkallingsvikar

Har du lyst på en variert jobb i butikk, liker å møte mennesker og trives når det er litt tempo? Da kan det være deg vi ser etter!

EUROSPAR Ålesund Storsenter søker en tilkallingsvikar over 18 år som kan stille opp ved behov og bli en del av laget vårt.

Hva betyr det å være tilkallingsvikar?

Som tilkallingsvikar har du ikke nødvendigvis faste vakter hver uke, men blir spurt om å jobbe når vi har behov for ekstra hjelp. Det kan for eksempel være ved sykdom, ferie, travle perioder eller når det dukker opp ledige vakter.

Vi ser derfor etter deg som er fleksibel og har mulighet til å stille opp på kort varsel. Arbeidstid kan være både dag, kveld og helg.

Arbeidsoppgavene vil blant annet være:

  • Kundebehandling og service

  • Kassearbeid

  • Varepåfylling og vareplassering

  • Holde butikken ryddig, ren og innbydende

  • Forefallende butikkarbeid

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi tror du vil trives hos oss dersom du er positiv, serviceinnstilt og liker å ta i et tak. Du jobber godt sammen med andre, men er også trygg på å jobbe selvstendig.

Det viktigste for oss er at du har lyst til å jobbe, møter opp når du skal og bidrar til et godt arbeidsmiljø. Erfaring fra butikk er en fordel, men ikke et krav – riktig innstilling og vilje til å lære betyr mye.

Du må være fylt 18 år.

Vi tilbyr:

  • En variert og aktiv arbeidshverdag

  • Et hyggelig og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø

  • God opplæring

  • Verdifull erfaring fra dagligvare og kundeservice

Høres dette ut som noe for deg? Send oss en søknad og fortell litt om hvem du er, hvorfor du ønsker å jobbe hos oss og når du har mulighet til å jobbe.

Vi gleder oss til å høre fra deg!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

SPAR og EUROSPAR-kjeden er NorgesGruppens profilkjede for lokale supermarkeder. Kjeden består av ca. 300 lokale supermarkeder spredt over hele Norge. Merkevaren SPAR forvaltes og driftes av Kjøpmannshuset Norge AS, NorgesGruppens profilhus for kjøpmannseide butikker. I SPAR legger vi vekt på å gi kunden den beste lokale handleopplevelsen og gode tilbud hver uke.

jobs.title: Breakfast Service Employee 15 hours per week
jobs.description:
Breakfast Service Employee – Front of House

ProfilHotels Copenhagen Plaza is looking for a service‑minded and welcoming Breakfast Service Employee to join our Front of House team. You will be part of delivering a warm, professional start to the day for our guests in one of Copenhagen’s most iconic hotels, located right next to Tivoli Gardens.

About the Role

As a Breakfast Service Employee, you are the face of our breakfast restaurant. You ensure that guests feel welcomed, comfortable, and well taken care of throughout their morning experience. You work closely with both the kitchen and service team to maintain a smooth, inviting and well‑organized breakfast service.

Main Responsibilities

  • Greeting guests and providing a warm, professional welcome

  • Preparing, replenishing and maintaining the breakfast buffet

  • Preparing coffee, tea and other beverages

  • Clearing tables and keeping the dining area clean and orderly

  • Ensuring high standards of hygiene and food safety

  • Collaborating with the FOH and kitchen team for seamless operations

Your Profile

  • Experience in hospitality or restaurant service is an advantage, but not required

  • Positive, structured and guest‑focused

  • Comfortable with early morning shifts

  • Good communication skills in English (Danish is a plus)

  • Enjoys working in a dynamic, international team

We Offer

  • A part‑time position in a historic hotel in the heart of Copenhagen

  • A friendly, supportive and international work environment

  • Opportunities for development within Ligula Hospitality Group

  • Staff benefits across the hotel group

  • A workplace that values quality, guest experience and teamwork

Working Hours

Morning shifts primarily between 05:30 – 13:00, including weekends according to schedule.

Start Date

As soon as possible.

Application

Submit your application and CV through our recruitment system. We review applications continuously and hire when the right candidate is found.

Ligula Hospitality Group is the parent company of a privately owned group in strong growth. We own, manage and develop brands and concepts in the hospitality industry. Since 2015, we have more than doubled the number of hotels, and the expansion continues. The group currently consists of 47 hotels in Sweden, Denmark and Germany, operated under the brands ProfilHotels, Apartments by Ligula, Motel L, Good Morning Hotels and Collection by Ligula. We normally employ approximately 800 full-time employees and have a turnover of more than SEK 1,400 million.

Primary location:
PUDASJÄRVI

LIIKENNEMYYMÄLÄTYÖNTEKIJÄ
ABC Pudasjärvi

Etsimme liikennemyymälätyöntekijäävakituiseen työsuhteeseen ABC Pudasjärvelle, työtunnein 10h viikossa. Arvostamme ruoanvalmistustaitoja ja valmiutta vuorotyöhön. Katsomme eduksi ravintola-alan koulutuksen ja hygieniapassin. Työsuhde alkaa syyskuussa 2026, mahdollisimman pian sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Tee tavallisia töitä, joilla on suuri merkitys
ABC Pudasjärvellä jokainen työvuoro on mahdollisuus tehdä asiakkaan päivästä hieman parempi. Meillä valmistetaan maukasta ruokaa, kohdataan asiakkaat aidosti ja pidetään huolta siitä, että asiointi on sujuvaa alusta loppuun. Pääset osaksi työyhteisöä, jossa onnistutaan yhdessä, autetaan toisia ja tehdään töitä yhteisten tavoitteiden eteen. Jokaisen työpanos näkyy asiakkaan kokemuksessa, ja siksi arvostamme vastuullista otetta työhön sekä halua kehittyä osana tiimiä.

Mitä tavallinen työ meillä on?
📍 lounaan, à la carten ja vitriinituotteiden valmistusta
📍 asiakaspalvelua, kassatyöskentelyä ja aktiivista myyntiä kahvilassa, ravintolassa ja myymälässä
📍 työpisteiden siisteydestä ja esillepanoista huolehtimista
📍 sujuvan asiakaskokemuksen varmistamista yhteistyössä muun tiimin kanssa

Mitä toivomme sinulta?
🎯 täysi-ikäisyyttä, kokemusta ruoanvalmistuksesta ja valmiutta vuorotyöhön
🎯 positiivista ja aitoa palveluasennetta
🎯 oma-aloitteista ja reipasta työotetta
🎯 hyviä yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja sekä halua oppia uutta

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?
💚 monipuolisen työympäristön ja työyhteisön, jossa jokainen on tärkeä osa tiimiä
💚 kattavan perehdytyksen sekä mahdollisuuden oppia ja kehittää osaamistasi
💚 työn, jossa pääset vaikuttamaan asiakkaidemme arkeen ja luomaan onnistuneita asiakaskohtaamisia
💚 Osuuskauppa Arinan ja S-ryhmän kattavat henkilöstöedut

Tervetuloa ihan tavallisiin töihin – epätavallisen mukavaan työporukkaan!
Meillä pääset tekemään työtä, jolla on merkitystä asiakkaidemme arjessa, kehittämään osaamistasi ja onnistumaan yhdessä muiden kanssa. Rakennetaan yhdessä entistä parempia asiakaskohtaamisia ABC Pudasjärvellä. 🔥Katso videolta miltä tavallinen työpäivä ABC:llä näyttää!

jobs.title: Responsable marketing (19125) (H/F)
jobs.description:
Située à 1h de Paris, X-FAB regroupe l'ensemble des métiers allant de la production à la commercialisation de nos produits.
Nous fabriquons avec passion des puces (semiconducteurs) qui contribuent à améliorer la vie des gens, à connecter les gens et à rendre les moyens de transport plus sûrs et plus respectueux de l'environnement.
Localisation : Corbeil-Essonnes (91)

Votre rôle :
Le Responsable Marketing Produit Photonique sur Silicium (f/h) contribue au développement et au positionnement de l'offre de fonderie en photonique sur silicium de X-FAB, avec un accent particulier sur X-FAB France.
Dans ce rôle, vous combinerez analyse de marché, relations clients et collaboration transverse avec les différentes fonctions de l'entreprise afin de soutenir la croissance de l'activité et de renforcer la feuille de route technologique de la société.
Vous reporterez directement au Directeur Business & Strategy de la Business Unit Microsystems & Photonics.

Vos missions :
-    Contribuer à l'élaboration et à la mise en œuvre des stratégies de X-FAB visant à accroître le chiffre d'affaires et la rentabilité dans le domaine de la photonique sur silicium.
-    Identifier et développer de nouvelles opportunités commerciales en établissant des relations avec les clients, les décideurs et les acteurs clés du secteur à l'échelle internationale.
-    Piloter les projets commerciaux liés aux opportunités de photonique sur silicium de grande envergure et spécifiques aux clients, notamment en assurant la coordination du périmètre, des priorités et l'alignement des parties prenantes.
-    Réaliser des études de marché, des analyses concurrentielles et des activités de recueil des retours clients afin de soutenir la prise de décision.
-    Traduire les besoins du marché en contributions à la définition de la feuille de route technologique et produit, en collaboration avec les équipes d'ingénierie.
-    Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Marketing, Ventes et Ingénierie d'Applications Terrain (Field Application Engineering) afin d'accompagner les clients.
-    Soutenir les activités de développement des comptes stratégiques sur les marchés ciblés de la photonique sur silicium.
-    Contribuer aux initiatives marketing en collaboration avec l'équipe Marketing Communications (présentations, webinaires, supports promotionnels, etc.).
-    Représenter X-FAB lors de conférences internationales, salons professionnels et événements du secteur.


Votre profil :
-    Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme d'ingénieur ou d'un master avec une spécialisation en électronique, physique, microélectronique ou dans un domaine connexe.
-    Vous justifiez de plusieurs années d'expérience en développement commercial, marketing produit ou dans une fonction en contact direct avec les clients au sein d'un environnement technologique de pointe.
-    Vous possédez des connaissances ou un intérêt marqué pour la photonique, les semi-conducteurs ou des technologies associées. Une expérience en photonique sur silicium constitue un atout, sans être indispensable.
-    Vous avez une bonne compréhension des stratégies de mise sur le marché (go-to-market) dans des environnements techniques.
-    Vous disposez d'une expérience dans la gestion de la relation client, des parties prenantes et des négociations.
-    Vous faites preuve de solides capacités d'analyse et savez transformer des sujets techniques en opportunités commerciales.
-    Vous démontrez d'excellentes compétences en communication et en présentation, en français comme en anglais.
-    Vous adoptez une approche de travail proactive et structurée, avec une forte capacité à collaborer efficacement au sein d'équipes internationales et pluridisciplinaires.
-    Vous êtes disponible pour effectuer des déplacements professionnels à l'international.

jobs.title: Electronics Engineer (Embedded & Quality Control)
jobs.description:
About the Job

Do you want to work in a technically advanced industrial operation within medical technology, where the focus is on electronics development, embedded systems, and quality-driven solutions for wound care and infection prevention technology? We are now looking for an Electronics Engineer with experience in embedded systems and quality control who wants to take a key role in the development, testing, and quality assurance of our electronic medical devices. Sunmedic is a Swedish medical device manufacturer focused on products such as the VivereX™ NPWT system and advanced dressings and foams.

The Role

In this role, you are responsible for developing, verifying, and quality-assuring the electronics and embedded software in Sunmedic's medical devices, with a particular focus on the VivereX™ NPWT system. You work close to the business and play a key role in ensuring reliable product performance, high quality, and compliance with medical device standards and regulations. The work is carried out in close collaboration with several functions within the organization, including production, quality, regulatory affairs, and maintenance.

The role involves both development work and hands-on engagement in testing, troubleshooting, and quality control, with significant scope to influence technical solutions, design choices, and ways of working in order to deliver safe and quality-assured products.

Responsibilities

- Develop, maintain, and improve electronics designs (hardware) and embedded software/firmware for medical devices

- Design, perform, and document verification and validation testing of electronics and embedded systems

- Be responsible for quality control of electronic components and finished products, including incoming inspection, functional testing, and non-conformance management

- Ensure that electronics development and testing are carried out in accordance with medical device requirements and standards (e.g. ISO 13485, IEC 60601, IEC 62304).

- Establish and maintain technical documentation, traceability, and design history (DHF/risk analysis)

- Provide technical support in troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and optimization of electronics-related processes in production

- Participate in supplier evaluation and quality follow-up of electronic components

- Collaborate closely with production, quality, maintenance, and technical specialists, as well as clinical and regulatory functions

Qualifications and Personal Attributes

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in electronics, electrical engineering, computer engineering, or equivalent

- Experience in electronics development and embedded systems, e.g. microcontroller-based design, firmware development (C/C++), sensors, and circuit design

- Experience in quality control, testing, and verification of electronic products, preferably within medical technology or another regulated industry

- Knowledge of medical device standards and regulations (e.g. ISO 13485, IEC 60601, IEC 62304, MDR) is highly meritorious

- Accustomed to combining analytical work with hands-on problem solving and troubleshooting

- Works in a structured, meticulous, and documentation-conscious manner with a strong focus on quality and continuous improvement

- Communicative and comfortable collaborating across organizational boundaries

- Ability to work in a regulated environment with a focus on quality, safety, and traceability

What the Role Offers

At Sunmedic, you will be a driving force in the development of advanced electronic medical devices, where technology, embedded systems, and continuous improvement are at the core. We work with world-leading product solutions for wound care and infection prevention technology, including the VivereX™ NPWT system and advanced dressings. The organization is characterized by commitment, accountability, and a strong desire to grow within medical technology.

About Sunmedic

Sunmedic is a trusted Swedish manufacturer of medical devices focused on advanced wound care solutions. Our product range includes the VivereX™ NPWT system and antimicrobial technologies, as well as dressings and foams that support faster healing and safer patient outcomes. We combine research-driven development with advanced technology to deliver effective tools for healthcare professionals. Sunmedic provides full support, from clinical guidance to after-market support, and partners worldwide to deliver the right solutions where they are needed.

jobs.title: Process Developer
jobs.description:
Job Title: Process Developer

Scania Credit Group (SCA), one of the captive Scania Financial Services entities, offers financing and insurance in the Middle East, Central Asia, and West Africa. SCA has become a leader in factoring solutions for non-captive dealers and body-builders, supporting Scania's goal to reduce CCC and offload its balance sheet. We have partnered with external credit insurers to mitigate commercial and political risks in certain transactions. SCA is expanding into new markets, particularly in the AMC region.

Based in Södertälje, the SCA Head Office and Market Support Centre provides governance, strategic development, credit risk management, contract administration, and IT support. With 50 employees, including 30 in Södertälje, we manage around 250 MEUR of assets across 10+ markets.

At SCA we value team spirit, diversity and respect. We believe that every employee should be able to be themselves at work. Our corporate culture is characterized by respect for the individual, continuous improvement and always putting the customer first.  

Role Summary

As a Process Developer, you will play a key role in ensuring our business applications remain reliable, efficient, and aligned with evolving business needs. Working within our Process & IT team, you will combine operational support with project work, helping to maintain critical business systems while contributing to new initiatives and digital improvements.

Reporting to the IT Manager, you will collaborate closely with colleagues across IT, Finance, Credit Risk, Risk & Compliance, Business Development, and external partners. You will be the link between business and technology, ensuring our applications continue to meet business needs while identifying opportunities to simplify processes and enhance the user experience.

This is a hands-on role where no two days are the same. One day you may be troubleshooting application issues, managing service requests, or supporting users; the next you could be coordinating testing, implementing system enhancements, participating in projects, or driving process improvements. If you enjoy solving problems, working closely with stakeholders, and making a tangible impact on how the business operates, this role offers an excellent opportunity to develop your skills within an international financial services organisation.

Job Responsibilities

    Provide first- and second-line support for business applications, troubleshooting issues and ensuring timely resolution of incidents and service requests.
    Support and administer View21 and Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM, including system configuration, maintenance, and enhancements.
    Coordinate application configurations and support the implementation of new products and business initiatives.
    Lead and coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT), working closely with business stakeholders to validate system changes and enhancements.
    Manage user access to business applications, ensuring compliance with internal policies and supporting IT audit activities related to access, change, and incident management.
    Collaborate with business users and vendors to analyze requirements, prioritize change requests, and implement system improvements.
    Develop and maintain user guides, process documentation, and training materials to support knowledge sharing and user adoption.
    Identify opportunities to improve business processes and workflows, driving efficiency through system enhancements and process optimisation.
    Support user onboarding and offboarding by ensuring timely application provisioning, access management, and user enablement.
    Contribute to projects and improvement initiatives across the Process & IT function, balancing operational support with the delivery of new capabilities.



Who You Are

We're looking for someone who enjoys solving problems, improving processes, and working closely with both business and IT stakeholders. You are curious, eager to learn, and comfortable taking ownership of tasks, whether it's resolving a support issue, coordinating testing, or driving a process improvement initiative.

You are structured and organised in your approach, able to balance operational responsibilities with project work while managing competing priorities. As a strong communicator, you build positive relationships across teams and are confident working in a collaborative environment.

Most importantly, you have a continuous improvement mindset, enjoy learning new systems and technologies, and are motivated by making a tangible impact on how the business operates.

For this position, we imagine that you will have:

    A relevant university degree or equivalent practical experience.
    3+ years of experience in application support, service management, process development, or a related IT/business systems role.
    Experience working with incident management, change management, service requests, and user support.
    Experience participating in system implementations, enhancements, testing (UAT), or continuous improvement initiatives.
    Experience with user access management, IT controls, compliance, or audit-related activities.
    Experience in financing, financial services, or a regulated business environment is highly preferred.
    Professional proficiency in English; Swedish is an advantage.
    Familiarity with View21 and/or Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM is an advantage.
    Knowledge of Lean methodologies or the Scania Way is beneficial.
    Experience working in an international or cross-functional environment is an advantage.



This Is Us

Our Process & IT team consists of six dedicated professionals with diverse backgrounds and expertise. We are responsible for the technology and processes that enable our business to operate efficiently - from application support and infrastructure to reporting, AI and analytics, business systems, and process optimisation. Working closely with business stakeholders, we deliver practical digital solutions that create value across the organisation and support our continued growth.

At Scania Credit, we value teamwork, diversity, and respect. We believe everyone should feel empowered to be themselves at work. Our culture is built on respect for the individual, continuous improvement, and always putting the customer first.

Are you passionate about improving business processes through technology? Do you enjoy solving problems, collaborating with stakeholders, and delivering solutions that make a real business impact? If so, we'd love to hear from you. Join Scania Credit as a Process Developer and help shape the future of our business systems and digital transformation!

Scania Credit Offers

We offer a dynamic and engaging workplace where collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. You will be part of a strong team environment that encourages knowledge sharing and close cooperation across functions.

Benefits include access to our health center in Gröndal or a wellness allowance, bonus, flexible working hours, and company car leasing. We also arrange events for employees and their families, and for those living in Stockholm, convenient commuting is supported through direct Scania Job express buses to Södertälje.

Application

We look forward to receiving your application, consisting of your CV and kindly ask you not to share a cover letter to ensure an efficient and unbiased recruitment process for all parties.

Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-09-17. We review applications on an ongoing basis and encourage interested candidates to apply as soon as possible. The posting may close before the application deadline if a high volume of applications is received. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role.

We look forward to your application!

jobs.title: Operations Manager of a mountain outdoor base in Norway.
jobs.description:
Starting in September 2026, we are looking for a long-term employee for the position of Operations Manager of a mountain outdoor base in Norway.

BRIEF DESCRIPTION OF THE COMPANY

During the summer season, we operate an outdoor activity base offering rafting, canyoning and mountain carts. In summer 2026, we welcomed 3,621 guests. The summer season runs from mid-May to mid-September.

During the winter season, we operate a small ski centre with the longest toboggan run in Norway and a ski rental service. In winter 2026, we welcomed 4,774 guests. The winter season runs from mid-December to mid-April.

During both seasons, guests can stay in our apartment or lavvo camp (maximum capacity of 49 people), and enjoy the facilities (sauna, hot tub, party lavvo and gas grill).

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Management of the employee team:

    • Summer season: reception, booking, service (cleaning, café, shopping), guide team for rafting, canyoning and mountain carts, head guide (responsible for the operation of activities), drivers and maintenance -- approximately 15 people in total

    • Winter season: reception, booking, service (cleaning, café, shopping), ski lift operators, snow groomer and maintenance -- approximately 5 people in total

  • Manual and administrative management, development and maintenance of the base

  • Practical day-to-day operation of the base and its activities

  • Administration and preparation of materials for accounting

  • Management of company assets (buildings, vehicles and activity equipment)

  • Cooperation with the Finance Director, Booking and Marketing departments

EMPLOYMENT DETAILS

Start: September 2026

Location: Dagali Fjellpark, Perstulvegen 100, 3588 Dagali, Norway

Working hours & remuneration

  • Number of working days during the winter season (mid-December -- mid-April): approximately 101

  • Number of working days during the summer season (mid-May -- mid-September): approximately 107

  • To be adjusted according to the candidate's abilities and mutual agreement.

Compensation: approximately NOK 220/hour, or alternatively a fixed salary based on the expected number of working hours, subject to agreement.

In the case of a long-term cooperation (after the trial period and with the agreement of both parties), we can discuss a fixed salary and performance-based bonus.

POSITION REQUIREMENTS

  • Management skills

  • Assertive attitude and advanced communication skills

  • Experience working in tourism

  • Positive attitude towards outdoor activities

  • Good knowledge of English

  • Willingness to stay in Dagali (Geilo) long-term and continuously from mid-December to mid-April and from mid-May to mid-September

  • Good computer skills and ability to handle administrative tasks

  • Ability to work outdoors in all weather conditions when necessary (snow, frost, wind, rain)

  • Responsibility, independence and attention to detail

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Long-term cooperation

  • Varied and interesting work

  • Working in the mountains and in a natural environment

  • Opportunity to participate in the development of the company

  • Benefits:

    • Free accommodation at the workplace during the first season; accommodation for future seasons by agreement.

    • Assistance with obtaining an ID number and tax card

    • Free rental of winter equipment for personal leisure activities

    • Free participation in our activities, subject to availability.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

Dagali Fjellpark is a professional outdoor center that offers summer activities (rafting, canyoning, mountain carts) and winter activities (ski center, toboggan run). The place has accommodation for about 40 people, and a small cafe.

jobs.title: Toma søger Servicemedarbejder til kunde i Aalborg Øst
jobs.description:
Er du serviceminded, fleksibel og god til at arbejde selvstændigt? Så er det måske dig, vi søger.

Vi søger en servicemedarbejder til en alsidig stilling hos en af vores kunder i Aalborg Øst, hvor du får en kombination af faste rengøringsopgaver og forskellige service- og ad hoc-opgaver på tværs af kundens bygninger.

Om jobbet

Du arbejder 5 timer dagligt, mandag til fredag, kl. 06.00–11.00, svarende til 25 timer om ugen.

Din arbejdsdag består af:

  • 3 timers fast rengøring i et område, som du får ansvaret for

  • 2 timer til service- og ad hoc-opgaver på tværs af kundens bygninger

Ad hoc-opgaverne kan blandt andet være ekstra rengøringsopgaver, udbedring af mangler og andre praktiske opgaver, der opstår i løbet af dagen.

Du skal derfor trives med en arbejdsdag, hvor nogle opgaver er faste, mens andre opstår løbende og kræver, at du er fleksibel og kan omstille dig.

Du får stillet en mobiltelefon til rådighed, så du kan modtage de løbende opgaver.

Vi søger dig, der

  • Er fleksibel og trives med forskellige typer opgaver

  • kan arbejde selvstændigt og struktureret

  • tager ansvar for de opgaver, du får tildelt

  • har øje for kvalitet og den gode service

Erfaring med rengøring eller facility service er en fordel, men det vigtigste er, at du har den rette indstilling og tager ansvar for dit arbejde.

Vi tilbyder

En alsidig arbejdsdag med en god kombination af faste opgaver og variation. Du får frihed under ansvar og bliver en vigtig del af den daglige service hos vores kunde.

  • Grundig oplæring

  • Gode og ordnede arbejdsforhold

  • Løn i henhold til overenskomst

  • Sundheds- og pensionsordning

Arbejdstid: Mandag–fredag kl. 06.00–11.00
Ugentligt timetal: 25 timer
Arbejdssted: Tomas kunde i Aalborg Øst
Tiltrædelse: 1. oktober 2026

Har du spørgsmål?
Kontakt Serviceleder Nina Bindner på mail: nina.breitner@toma-as.dk

Send din ansøgning med billede og CV hurtigst muligt, da vi løbende inviterer kvalificerede ansøgere til samtale.

Ansøgning sendes til: job@toma-as.dk

Toma er landsdækkende i Danmark, og vi har 750 dygtige medarbejdere.

Vi stiller krav til kvalitet, bæredygtighed, uddannelse, og arbejder seriøst med miljø og arbejdsmiljø.

Vi er medlem af Servicenormen, er ISO 9001, 14001 og 45001 certificeret, samt har certifikat på Svanemærket rengøring.

Vi investerer i vores medarbejdere både socialt og udviklingsmæssigt, og tilbyder spændende karrieremuligheder for de rette kandidater.

Vi lever for vores serviceløfte om at skabe gode service-oplevelser og give folk en bedre arbejdsdag.

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer
jobs.description:
Want to be part of transforming road freight – for good? Einride is showing the world a new way to move, based on the latest digital, electric and autonomous technologies. Through freight capacity as a service, we enable businesses around the world to accelerate towards their sustainability goals.

Founded in 2016, Einride became the first company in the world to deploy a cab-less autonomous electric vehicle on a public road (Sweden, 2019). In 2022, we were the first to successfully operate such a vehicle on a US public road. Today our award-winning technology has been launched across 8 countries (and counting). Our clients are some of the world’s biggest shippers, including Fortune 500 companies. We are also operating Sweden’s largest truck dedicated public charging network and counting.

We are now looking for a Security Engineer to join our security team!

You will:

    Build, integrate and operate our security monitoring platforms that ensure we can detect and respond to security incidents in all our environments, including user endpoints, SaaS applications, cloud infrastructure, our web platforms as well as our vehicles and charging stations.
    Be involved in security incident response when required, coordinating containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident analysis.
    Build, manage and mature the vulnerability management program (including workstations, network perimeter, containers, source code, cloud configuration, etc) and build the appropriate security metrics to help drive risk-based decisions and investments.
    Build out our application security program that allows engineers to be self-empowered when appropriate and able to get assistance when required. Participate in threat modeling sessions and provide security advice in design of new and existing features.
    Collaborate with software engineers to help them improve our products’ security posture: help patch vulnerabilities, run security audits, explain complex IAM topics, brainstorm monitoring use-cases, etc

We expect you to:

    5+ years of hands-on experience in cybersecurity or security engineering roles.
    Working experience in securing and monitoring public cloud infrastructure (e.g., ideally GCP, but any major cloud providers such as AWS or Azure work).
    Working experience in vulnerability management on multiple layers of the modern IT and software stack
    Experience with security incident management (preferably in a SOC, CDC or similar)
    Ability to code/script and automate repetitive tasks. We primarily use Go but if you have a general knack for coding, that matters more than having previous experience with a specific language.
    Great collaboration and communication skills, since you’ll be part of driving initiatives that span across the entire company.

This is a full-time position based in Stockholm or Gothenburg. You will be part of a truly diverse, high performing team with a common passion for sustainability and making things happen in an innovative way. We recommend that you submit your application as soon as possible since selection and interviews are held continually.

Please note that as part of our standard recruitment process, we conduct a background control on the final candidate for this role. This may include verification of education, employment history, any relevant professional certifications or other information that may be of our interest.

At Einride, we are innovators, building solutions the world has never seen before – but urgently needs. That’s why we take action, and it’s why we are always eager to be challenged. We know that our best innovations come from having a diverse mix of people, including those of different experiences, career paths, and walks of life. By coming together and sharing our perspectives openly – by disagreeing, discussing, and committing – we deliver greater impact.

Born autonomous. Born electric.

Since 2016, our technology has connected global communities with the things they need – and all without the emissions. We’re made up of experts in multiple fields and that’s how we’ve developed a new way to move goods. This is technology purpose-built for the industry. This is safer, cleaner, and more reliable movement.

We are Einride and this is how we build a better future.

jobs.employer: Uhanda Oy I HR Satama Finland Oy
jobs.description:
_UHANDA Oy on vuonna 2020 perustettu kotimainen majoitusalan pioneeri. Ei vain puheissa, vaan aidosti käytännössä ja arjen toimissa._

_Keväällä 2026 UHANDA täytti kuusi vuotta. Tänään matkaa jatketaan kuuden hotellin ja yli 800 kalustetun asunnon voimin 15 eri paikkakunnalla. Toimintansa alusta lähtien UHANDA on avannut alalla eniten uusia hotelleja Suomeen ja kasvattanut kalustettujen asuntojen liiketoimintaansa alan ripeintä tahtia._

**UHANDA ETSII OPERATIIVISTA PÄÄLLIKKÖÄ.**

**(Asiakas- & myyntipalvelu + siivous- ja laatuyhteistyö, 6 hotellin hotellipäällikkö)**

**Rooli lyhyesti**

**Titteli:** Operatiivinen päällikkö

**Vastuualue:** UHANDA:n hotelliportfolio: asiakas- & myyntipalvelu, kohteiden palvelullinen toimivuus ja ylläpito sekä siivous- ja laatuyhteistyö

**Onnistumisen mitta:** vieraiden ja asiakkaiden tyytyväisyys koko portfoliossa

**Tiimi:** 5 hengen asiakas- & myyntipalvelutiimi

**Raportoit:** Toimitusjohtajalle osana tulevaa johtoryhmää

**Sijainti:** Pääkonttori Tampere. Työ vaatii n. 2–3 reissupäivää kuukaudessa, ja ne ovat tyypillisesti yhdessä putkessa.

**TYÖ**

**Tiimin johtaminen**

Sinulla on täysi vastuu viiden hengen asiakas- ja myyntipalvelutiimistä: sen arjesta, ihmisistä, osaamisesta ja kehittymisestä. Resursointi, työvuorosuunnittelu, perehdytys, valmentaminen ja palvelutason varmistaminen ovat sinun käsissäsi. Onnistumista mitataan sillä, miten tiimi onnistuu, ei sillä, miten paljon itse ehdit tehdä.

**Asiakas- ja myyntipalvelun arki**

Vastaat siitä, että vieraiden ja asiakkaiden yhteydenotot hoidetaan nopeasti, laadukkaasti ja kaupallisesti järkevästi vuorokauden ja viikon jokaisessa kohdassa. Tähän kuuluvat palvelutaso ja vasteajat, tarjous- ja varauspyynnöt, poikkeustilanteet sekä palautteiden käsittely niin, että niistä myös opitaan.

Hands-on-tyylimme tarkoittaa, että iso osa työstä, arjen päällä olosta ja kehityksen suunnittelusta tapahtuu käytännön ohessa. Tarkoittaen, että kehittävää ja edistävää työtä tehdään myös asiakaspalveluvuoroissa.

**Siivous- ja laatuyhteistyö**

Vastaat siivous- ja laatuyhteistyöstä kumppaniverkostomme kanssa: yhteisistä standardeista, niiden seurannasta ja siitä, että laatu on tasalaatuista jokaisessa kohteessa. Käytännössä tämä on kumppanisuhteiden johtamista, laadun mittaamista ja poikkeamiin tarttumista siten, että ne ovat huomioituna ja ratkottuna ennen kuin nämä välittyvät vieraille.

**Systemaattinen kehittäminen**

Hyödynnämme vahvasti nykyaikaisia työkaluja ja niiden mahdollistamia toimintamalleja, ja implementoimme järjestelmäkehitystä uusien ominaisuuksien kautta arkeen systemaattisesti. Se tarkoittaa, että muutos ja kehitys ovat meillä vakio.

Tässä roolissa olet oman vastuualueesi prosessien omistaja: tunnistat kehityskohdat, määrittelet tarpeet yhdessä tiimin kanssa, jalkautat uudet ominaisuudet arkeen ja koulutat tiimin niiden käyttöön. Ylläpito ja kehitys eivät ole toistensa vastakohtia, vaan molemmat kuuluvat samaan ruutuun, josta vastaat yhdessä tiimisi kanssa.

**Odotamme sinulta**

Kokemusta ihmisten ja arjen johtamisesta ja halua kehittyä siinä edelleen

Operatiivista otetta dynaamisessa ympäristössä, ja kykyä nauttia jatkuvasti elävästä arjesta ja sen rytmistä

Kaupallista ja liiketoiminnallista ajattelutapaa. Asiakaskokemukset ovat aina keskiössä ja toimivat linkkinä jokaiseen liiketoiminnan osa-alueeseen

Aitoa kiinnostusta ohjata arkea ja päätöksiä datan kautta, johon yhdistyy inhimillinen ihmisten ymmärrys

Rohkeutta tarttua asioihin, joita kukaan ei ole vielä pyytänyt sinua tarttumaan

Emme edellytä tiettyä koulutusta tai vuosimäärää alalta. Olemme rekrytoineet monesta eri profiilista ja taustasta, ja ensisijaisen kriittistä meille on asenne ja draivi. On paljon asioita, joissa voimme tukea ja sparrata, mutta uskomme, että kaikki lähtee aina ensin yksilön omasta motivaatiosta ja tahtotilasta onnistua asiakkaidemme puolesta.

**Tarjoamme**

Tarjoamme toimenkuvan ja työpaikan, jossa pääset johtamaan valmiiksi rakennettuja, toimivaksi todettuja malleja ja kehittämään niitä eteenpäin siten, että pääset konkreettisesti näkemään oman kädenjälkesi. Sinulla on tukena organisaatio, jossa on prosesseja, toimintoja ja rooleja, jotka tarkoittavat, ettei kaikkea tarvitse itse tehdä.

Tämä on työympäristö, jossa vastuu on kaksisuuntainen ja se mahdollistaa sen, että tunnet ja näet oman työsi arvon ja olet päättämässä ja vaikuttamassa, miltä UHANDA:n seuraavat kasvuvaiheet näyttävät.

**UHANDA lukuina – vuoden 2026 näkymä**

Hotelleja: 6

Kalustettuja asuntoja: yli 800

Asiakasarviot: 8,6 / 10

Liikevaihto: n. 18 miljoonaa euroa

Kasvu: n. 90 %

**Toimitusjohtajalta**

_"Loistavan porukan ja työyhteisön lisäksi yksi arvokkaimmista asioista, joita tunnistan meidän voivan tarjota, on eväitä tulevaisuuden työelämään ja arkeen. Arjen ohjaaminen ja liiketoiminnan johtaminen ovat suuren murroksen äärellä, ja olen henkilökohtaisesti innoissani siitä, että tapa, jolla lähestymme asioita ja haastamme omaa tekemistämme, kasvattaa samalla jokaista meistä ammattilaisena._

_Jos uteliaisuus heräsi ja mietit, että vitsit kuinka mielenkiintoinen paikka voisi olla, mutta kun just nyt on kaikki kivasti. Niin muista, että joskus pitää olla valmis luopumaan hyvästä, jotta voi saavuttaa jotain loistavaa. Toivottavasti tämä voisi olla sinulle jotain loistavaa. "_

Meillä on avoinna määräaikainen kunnaninsinöörin virka, jossa pääset hyödyntämään laaja-alaisesti osaamistasi kiinteistöpuolen tehtävissä. Keskeisin tehtäväsi on osallistua päivittäiseen kiinteistöjen kunnossapitotyöhön siistijöiden ja kiinteistönhoitajien esihenkilönä ja huolehtia ennakoivasta kunnossapidosta. Kiinteistömassan hallinta ja siihen liittyvän kiinteistöstrategian laadinta sekä liikunta-alueiden ja kunnan tiealueiden kunnossapito tulee olemaan sinun vastuullasi.

Kunnaninsinööri on ennen kaikkea kuntalaisten käytettävissä ja siksi toivomme sinulta myös hyviä asiakaspalvelutaitoja.
Kunnalla on käytössä Avux-kiinteistönhallintaohjelmisto.

- Tehtävään soveltuvaa insinöörin tutkintoa (esim. talotekniikka tai rakennustekniikka) sekä kokemusta kiinteistöhoidon tehtävistä.
- kunnallisalan tuntemusta
- kykyä itsenäiseen työskentelyyn ja päätöksen tekoon
- hyviä yhteistyötaitoja
- hankintaosaamista ja kokemusta kilpailuttamisesta
- halua ja kykyä toimia kentällä käytännön hommissa ja tahtoa tarvittaessa vaikka hypätä moottorikelkan selkään latuja ajamaan.

Arvostamme myös näitä taitoja:
- kykyä oppia ja motivaatiota työskennellä kuntatoimintaympäristössä
- valmiutta kehittää uusia toimintamalleja sekä käyttää digitaalisia työkaluja
- kestävän kehityksen ja elinkaarimallin osaamista

Tarjoamme sinulle
- vastuullisen ja itsenäisen roolin organisaatiossa
- julkisen sektorin hyvät lomaedut ja selkeät työehdot (TS)
