Za prijam u radni odnos odgojitelja/ice kandidati moraju ispunjavati, osim općih uvjeta, uvjete propisane člankom 24. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (Narodne novine, br. 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22, 101/23, 145/23, 145/24, 146/25 i 22/26 ) te člankom 2. Pravilnika o odgovarajućoj vrsti i razini obrazovanja odgojno-obrazovnih i ostalih radnika u dječjem vrtiću, ustanovama te drugim pravnim i fizičkim osobama koje provode programe ranog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja („Narodne novine“ br. 145/24. i 62/25- ispravak).

Poslove odgojitelja djece od navršenih šest mjeseci života do polaska u osnovnu školu može obavljati osoba koja je završila studij odgovarajuće vrste za rad na radnome mjestu odgojitelja, a koji može biti:

a) preddiplomski sveučilišni studij,

b) preddiplomski stručni studij,

c) studij kojim je stečena viša stručna sprema u skladu s ranijim propisima,

d) diplomski sveučilišni studij,

e) specijalistički diplomski stručni studij.

Pored navedenih uvjeta kandidati moraju ispunjavati i opće uvjete za prijem u radni odnos:

1. Punoljetnost

2. Zdravstvenu sposobnost za obavljanje poslova radnog mjesta

Dokaz o zdravstvenoj sposobnosti za obavljanje poslova radnog mjesta dostavit će izabrani kandidat po dostavljenoj obavijesti o izboru.

3. Radni odnos u dječjem vrtiću ne može zasnovati osoba koja ima zapreke definirane člankom 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju.

Uz vlastoručno potpisanu pisanu zamolbu kandidati su dužni priložiti sljedeću dokumentaciju, u presliku:

  • životopis,
  • presliku dokaza o stručnoj spremi,
  • elektronički zapis od HZMO,
  • uvjerenje da se protiv kandidata ne vodi postupak za kazneno djelo navedeno u čl. 25. Zakona, ne starije od dana objave natječaja,
  • uvjerenje da se protiv kandidata ne vodi postupak za prekršaj naveden u čl. 25. Zakona, ne starije od dana objave natječaja,
  • potvrda Hrvatski zavod za socijalni rad (prema mjestu stanovanja) da kandidatu nisu izrečene mjere iz članka 25. Zakona, ne starija od dana objave natječaja,
  • izjava kandidata o nepostojanju zapreka iz čl. 25. Zakona za prijem u radni odnos (vlastoručno potpisana),
  • dokaz o državljanstvu,

U skladu sa Zakonom o ravnopravnosti spolova na natječaj se mogu javiti osobe obaju spolova koje ispunjavaju propisane uvjete.

Osobe koje prema posebnim propisima ostvaruju pravo prednosti, moraju se u prijavi pozvati na to pravo, odnosno uz prijavu priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu. Kandidat koji može ostvariti pravo prednosti kod prijma u lokalnu službu prema članku 101. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (NN 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), članku 48.f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (NN 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13 i 98/19) i članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (NN 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20), dužan se u prijavi na natječaj pozvati na to pravo te ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima.

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja u skladu s člankom 101. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i dokaze propisane člankom 103. stavkom 1. Zakona o pravima hrvatskih branitelja iz Domovinskog rata i članova njihovih obitelji, a koji su objavljeni na web-stranici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/843.

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju na temelju Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata, dužan je, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i dokaze iz članka 49. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata, a koji su objavljeni na sljedećoj poveznici: https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-u-drzavnoj-sluzbi-843/843

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja u skladu s člankom 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom uz prijavu na oglas dužan je, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i dokaz o utvrđenom statusu osobe s invaliditetom.

Urednom prijavom smatra se prijava koja sadržava sve podatke i priloge (isprave) navedene u natječaju.

Osoba koja nije podnijela pravodobnu i urednu prijavu ili ne ispunjava formalne uvjete iz oglasa,ne smatra se kandidatom prijavljenim na natječaj.

Prijave na natječaj s dokazima (ispravama) o ispunjavanju uvjeta podnose se u roku od 8 dana od dana objave natječaja na stranicama Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje, te na mrežnim stranicama Dječjeg vrtića Korčula, preporučenom poštanskom pošiljkom na adresu:

Dječji vrtić Korčula, Pelavin mir bb, 20260 Korčula, s naznakom:

“ZA NATJEČAJ-ODGOJITELJ/ICA NA ODREĐENO – NE OTVARATI

Povjerenstvo za provedbu javnog natječaja (u nastavku teksta: Povjerenstvo) imenuje Ravnateljica Dječjeg vrtića Korčula. Povjerenstvo utvrđuje popis kandidata prijavljenih na javni natječaj koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete.

Prethodnoj provjeri znanja i sposobnosti, tj. pisanom testiranju, mogu pristupiti samo kandidati koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete natječaja.

Nepotpune i/ili nepravovremene prijave neće se razmatrati.

Pisano testiranje Dječjeg vrtića Korčula će se obavljati iz sljedećih područja:

1. Državni pedagoški standard predškolskog odgoja i naobrazbe (“Narodne novine” br. 63/08 i 90/10).

2. Zakon o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (“Narodne novine” br. 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22, 101/23, 145/23, 145/24, 146/25 i 22/26

3. Nacionalni kurikulum za rani i predškolski odgoj i obrazovanje („Narodne novine“ br. 05/15.)

4. Pravilnik o obrascima i sadržaju pedagoške dokumentacije i evidencije o djeci u dječjem vrtiću („Narodne novine“ br. 83/01.)

Kandidat koji ne pristupi pisanoj provjeri znanja smatra se da je povukao prijavu za natječaj.

Na web stranici Dječjeg vrtića Korčula https://djecjivrtickorcula.com/ objavit će se popis kandidata koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete iz natječaja te vrijeme održavanja pisanih testiranja 5 dana prije održavanja provjere znanja i sposobnosti. Intervju se provodi samo s kandidatima koji su ostvarili najmanje 50% ukupnog broja bodova na pisanom testiranju.

Za svaki dio provjere znanja i sposobnosti kandidatima se dodjeljuje određeni broj bodova, od 1 do 10. Nakon prethodne provjere znanja i sposobnosti kandidata Povjerenstvo za provedbu oglasa utvrđuje rang-listu kandidata prema ukupnom broju ostvarenih bodova na pisanom testiranju i intervjuu.

Sukladno odredbama Uredbe (EU) 2016/679 Europskog parlamenta i Vijeća od 27. travnja 2016. godine te Zakona o provedbi Opće uredbe o zaštiti podataka („Narodne novine“ br. 42/18.) prijavom na natječaj smatra se da je kandidat dao privolu za obradu svih podataka iz natječajne dokumentacije, a koja će se obrađivati isključivo u svrhu provođenja natječajnog postupka.

Natječaj je objavljen dana 02. rujna i traje do 10. rujna 2026. godine

Predsjednica Upravnog vijeća

Ivana Blitvić Šain

jobs.title: Security Engineer (gn) Microsoft Modern Workplace (IT-Administrator/in)
jobs.description:
Why SoftwareOne?

SoftwareOne is a global provider of software and cloud solutions. With a presence in over 70 countries and more than 12,000 professionals, we help organizations optimize software investments, modernize applications, and unlock the value of cloud, data, and AI.

Our people are at the core of everything we do. We enable collaboration across borders, continuous learning, and opportunities to grow in a fast-evolving technology landscape. Whether your focus is on technology, customer success, or business operations, your ideas matter, and your contributions make a difference.

Join a global team where you can build your skills, work with leading technologies, and make a real impact for our customers.

Secruity Engineer (gn) Microsoft Modern Workplace

- Do you want to design modern Microsoft 365 environments holistically and advise customers on everything from collaboration strategy to security, compliance, and Copilot?
- Are you equally comfortable with technical and conceptual topics and ready to take ownership in diverse customer projects?
- Are you looking for an environment where you can work cross-functionally, help shape innovation, and create real value together with Sales, Delivery, and technology partners?

Practical information:
Location: Romandie-Switzerland | Working model: Hybrid | Seniority: Senior | Language requirements: Very good written and spoken French and English

The Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Security Engineer with strong expertise in Microsoft Security, Identity and/or Compliance and AI-enabled Modern Workplace or Cloud Services. The successful candidate will design, implement and deliver enterprise-scale security transformations across Microsoft 365, Azure and Microsoft Security technologies, helping customers strengthen their security posture while enabling productivity and innovation.

Key Responsibilities

Security & Identity

- Design and implement enterprise security architectures aligned with Zero Trust principles.
- Lead customer engagements around Identity & Access Management, Identity Governance and Privileged Access Management.
- Implement and optimize Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, MFA, Passwordless Authentication, Identity Governance, Access Reviews, Lifecycle Workflows and Privileged Identity Management.
- Support hybrid identity transformations involving Active Directory, Entra ID and federated identity providers.

Cloud Security

- Design and deploy security solutions across Azure and Microsoft cloud environments.
- Implement and optimize Microsoft Defender for Cloud capabilities, including workloads such as servers, storage, databases, containers and Kubernetes where relevant.
- Conduct cloud security posture reviews and support customers in improving governance, policy management and secure workload design.
- Threat Protection & SOC Modernization
- Design, implement and optimize Microsoft Defender for Cloud. Defender XDR solutions including Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Identity, Defender for Office 365 and Defender for Cloud Apps.
- Implement and tune Microsoft Sentinel including data onboarding, detection engineering, analytics rules, automation and SOAR use cases.
- Contribute to threat hunting, incident response readiness and security operations process improvement.

Data Security & Compliance

- Design and deploy Microsoft Purview solutions for information protection, sensitivity labels, data classification, DLP, records management and data lifecycle management.
- Support customers in meeting compliance, governance and data protection objectives.
- Translate regulatory and business requirements into practical security and compliance controls.

AI & Security Innovation

- Lead customer discussions around secure AI adoption and responsible use of Microsoft Copilot and Security Copilot.
- Deliver readiness assessments and governance frameworks for Copilot-enabled environments.
- Define controls to protect sensitive data and identities in AI-enabled collaboration and cloud scenarios.

Professional Experience

- Years of experience in enterprise security consulting, engineering or architecture.
- Proven experience delivering Microsoft security, identity, and/or compliance or cloud security projects.
- Experience working directly with enterprise customers and senior stakeholders.
- Strong consulting mindset with the ability to translate business requirements into pragmatic security solutions.
- Structured, self-reliant, solution-oriented working style with strong customer and team orientation.

Preferred Certifications

- SC-100 – Cybersecurity Architect Expert
- SC-300 – Identity and Access Administrator
- SC-200 – Security Operations Analyst
- SC-400 – Information Protection Administrator
- AZ-500 – Azure Security Engineer
- MS-102 – Microsoft 365 Administrator
- Additional Microsoft Security, Azure, Purview, Sentinel, Copilot or Security Copilot etc. certifications are a plus

Our company benefits vary based on your location, but always include:

- Global company culture: We defined our 6 core values through our company culture (https://www.softwareone.com/en/our-story/our-values)
- A mentor who supports your successful start and is at your side with advice and action
- President’s Club: Recognition awarded by leadership and your peers
- Flexible work: Do great work from anywhere but also visit local office to deliver excellence in team relationship
- Lifelong education: A variety of training and development opportunities
- Hire to Grow: We optimize our internal structures and feedback culture constantly to be your Employer of Choice, today and in future
- You can find all current benefits here: https://www.softwareone.com/de-at/karriere/dach/benefits (https://www.softwareone.com/de-at/karriere/dach/benefits)

Have we piqued your interest?

Then apply with your CV and a few clicks via our online form! No cover letter is necessary.

Do you have any questions? Then feel free to send us an email at malte.ruetten@softwareone.com.

jobs.title: ODGOJITELJ/ICA
jobs.description:
Na temelju članka 26. stavka 2. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (Narodne novine 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22, 101/23, 22/26) te članka 40. Statuta Dječjeg vrtića Vrbovec, 7. svibnja 12a, Vrbovec, Upravno vijeće Dječjeg vrtića Vrbovec donijelo je na svojoj 71. sjednici održanoj 31. kolovoza 2026. godine Odluku o raspisivanju

PONOVLJENOG NATJEČAJA

za radno mjesto: odgojitelj/ica na neodređeno puno radno vrijeme – 1 izvršitelj/ica

Uvjeti - osim općih uvjeta za zasnivanje radnog odnosa, kandidati moraju ispunjavati i posebne uvjete prema čl. 24. i 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (Narodne novine 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22, 101/23, 22/26) i Pravilniku o odgovarajućoj vrsti i razini obrazovanja odgojno-obrazovnih i ostalih radnika u dječjem vrtiću, ustanovama te drugim pravnim i fizičkim osobama koje provode programe ranog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja (NN 154/24, u daljnjem tekstu: Pravilnik): završen sveučilišni prijediplomski studij, stručni prijediplomski studij, studij kojim je stečena viša stručna sprema u skladu s prijašnjim propisima, sveučilišni diplomski studij ili stručni diplomski studij.

Na natječaj se, pod ravnopravnim uvjetima, imaju pravo javiti osobe oba spola.

Uz zamolbu potrebno je priložiti sljedeće dokumente:

  • dokaz o stručnoj spremi,
  • dokaz o državljanstvu,
  • dokaz o nepostojanju zapreka za zasnivanje radnog odnosa sukladno čl. 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (NN 10/97, 107/97, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22, 101/23, 22/26) ne starije od dana objave natječaja: Uvjerenje nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak, Uvjerenje nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata ne vodi prekršajni postupak i Potvrda Hrvatskog zavoda za socijalni rad da kandidat nema izrečenu mjeru žurnoga izdvajanja djeteta iz obitelji ili mjeru za zaštitu osobnih prava i dobrobiti djeteta u nadležnosti suda,
  • dokaz o radnom iskustvu (potvrda o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji HZMO-a),
  • životopis.
  • Opis poslova: poslovi njege, odgoja i obrazovanja, socijalne i zdravstvene zaštite te skrbi o djeci rane i predškolske dobi.

Nepravodobne i nepotpune prijave neće se razmatrati.

Izrazi navedeni u natječaju u muškom rodu neutralni su, a odnose se na osobe oba spola.

Podnošenjem prijave na natječaj pristupnici natječaja suglasni su da Dječji vrtić Vrbovec, kao voditelj zbirke osobnih podataka može prikupljati, koristiti i dalje obrađivati podatke u svrhu provedbe natječajnog postupka sukladno odredbama Opće Uredbe EU 2016/679 Europskog parlamenta i vijeća o zaštiti i pojedinca u svezi s obradom osobnih podataka i slobodnog kretanja takvih podataka od 27. travnja 2016. godine i Zakona o provedbi Opće uredbe o zaštiti podataka (NN 42/18).

Svi dokumenti dostavljeni na natječaj poslani su dobrom voljom kandidata te se smatra da je kandidat prijavom na natječaj dao privolu za obradu svih podataka koji će se obrađivati isključivo u svrhu provođenja natječajnog postupka i da daje privolu da se njegovo ime i prezime, ukoliko bude izabran za zasnivanje radnog odnosa, objavi na mrežnoj stranici Vrtića te da se o istom obavijeste kandidati prijavljeni na natječaj.

Pozivaju se osobe iz članka 102. stavak 1. – 3. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (NN 121/17, 98/19 i 84/21) da uz prijavu na natječaj dostave dokaze iz članka 103. stavak 1. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (NN 121/17, 98/19 i 84/21). Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva: https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/843, a dodatne informacije o dokazima koji su potrebni za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju, potražiti na sljedećoj poveznici:

https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje//POPIS%20DOKAZA%20ZA%20OSTVARIVANJE%20PRAVA%20PRI%20ZAPO%C5%A0LJAVANJU.pdf

Pisane prijave podnose se u roku od 8 dana od objave natječaja na oglasnoj ploči i mrežnim stanicama Dječjeg vrtića Vrbovec te na oglasnoj ploči i mrežnim stranicama Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje na adresu:

Dječji vrtić Vrbovec, 7. svibnja 12 a, 10340 Vrbovec s naznakom:

„Za natječaj za odgojitelja/icu – neodređeno vrijeme“

O rezultatima natječaja kandidati će biti obaviješteni u roku od 15 dana od dana donošenja Odluke.

U Vrbovcu, 2. rujna 2026. godine

KLASA: 112-01/25-01/03

URBROJ: 238-32-69-01-26-53

jobs.title: ODGOJITELJI/ICA
jobs.description:
Na temelju članka 26. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju („Narodne novine“, broj 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22, 101/23 i 22/26), Dječji vrtić Lojtrica, Smendrovićeva 9, Velika Mlaka na temelju odluke Upravnog vijeća od 31. kolovoza 2026. godine, objavljuje:

NATJEČAJ

za radno mjesto

ODGOJITELJ/ICA – dva (2) izvršitelja (m/ž), rad na određeno puno radno vrijeme - povećani opseg posla do 31.08.2027. godine

Uvjeti: Kandidati moraju ispunjavati uvjete prema čl. 24. i čl. 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (NN 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22, 101/23 i 22/26), te članka 2. Pravilnika o odgovarajućoj vrsti i razini obrazovanja odgojno-obrazovnih radnika u dječjem vrtiću, ustanovama te drugim pravnim i fizičkim osobama koje provode programe ranog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja (NN 145/24, 62/25).

Na natječaj mogu se prijaviti osobe oba spola koje ispunjavanju propisane uvjete.

Priložiti:

- zamolbu

- životopis

- dokaz o stručnoj spremi

- dokaz o stručnom ispitu (ukoliko ga kandidat posjeduje)

- dokaz o državljanstvu

- potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje (ne stariju od dana objave natječaja)

- uvjerenje / potvrdu nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak (ne stariju od dana objave natječaja)

- uvjerenje / potvrdu nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata ne vodi prekršajni postupak (ne stariju od dana objave natječaja)

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema pozitivnim propisima RH dužan je u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo, priložiti propisane dokaze o tom pravu te ostvaruje prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima.

Kandidat koji može ostvariti pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji („Narodne novine“ 121/2017, 98/19, 84/21 i 156/23), članku 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata („Narodne novine“ 84/21), članku 48.f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata („Narodne novine“ 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13, 98/19), članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom („Narodne novine“ 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20) dužan se u prijavi na natječaj pozvati na to pravo te ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima.

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji i člankom 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata, uz prijavu na ovaj natječaj, dužan je priložiti pored dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta i sve potrebne dokaze dostupne na stranici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/843.

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48.f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata uz prijavu na ovaj natječaj dužan je, pored dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti rješenje, odnosno potvrdu iz koje je vidljivo spomenuto pravo, te dokaz o tome na koji način je prestao radni odnos.

Pristupnik koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom uz prijavu na ovaj natječaj dužan je, pored dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i dokaz o utvrđenom statusu osobe s invaliditetom.

Prijave na natječaj s obveznom dokumentacijom dostavljaju se na adresu:

Dječji vrtić Lojtrica, Smendrovićeva 9, 10408 Velika Mlaka

uz naznaku „za natječaj – odgojitelj – povećani opseg posla“

Nepravodobne, nepotpune i prijave zaprimljene elektronskim putem neće se razmatrati.

Nepravodobne, nepotpune i prijave zaprimljene elektronskim putem neće se razmatrati.

Kandidat/kinja koji/a bude izabran/a u obvezi je prije sklapanja ugovora o radu dostaviti dokaze o ispunjenju uvjeta u originale ili ovjerenoj preslici.

Dječji vrtić Lojtrica zadržava pravo da prema potrebi provede prethodnu provjeru radne i druge (stručne, zdravstvene) sposobnosti kandidata koji zadovoljava formalne uvjete natječaja. Vrijeme i mjesto održavanja prethodne provjere bit će objavljeno na mrežnoj stranici Dječjeg vrtića Lojtrica (www.dv-lojtrica.hr), te na oglasnoj ploči Dječjeg vrtića Lojtrica, Smendrovićeva 9, Velika Mlaka, najviše pet dana prije održavanja provjere.

Kandidat koji ne pristupi prethodnoj provjeri smatra se da je povukao prijavu na natječaj i više se ne smatra kandidatom na natječaj.

Prijavom na natječaj kandidat daje privolu Dječjem vrtiću Lojtrica za prikupljanje i obradu osobnih podataka navedenih u prijavi na natječaj te dokumentaciji dostavljenoj s prijavom, u svrhu odabira kandidata, te privolu na dostavu obavijesti o rezultatima natječaja koja se objavljuje na mrežnoj stranici Dječjeg vrtića Lojtrica. Privola za prikupljanje i obradu osobnih podataka je uvjet za prijavu na natječaj.

O rezultatima natječaja kandidati će biti obaviješteni objavom obavijesti na mrežnoj stranici Dječjeg vrtića Lojtrica www.dv-lojtrica.hr. Dostava svim kandidatima smatra se obavljenom istekom osmog dana od dana objave na mrežnoj stranici Dječjeg vrtića Lojtrica.

jobs.title: VIŠI TEHNIČKI SURADNIK-VIŠI LABORANT (TIMARITELJ) (M/Ž)
jobs.description:
Sveučilište u Rijeci, Medicinski fakultet, raspisuje N A T J E Č A J za radno mjesto viši tehnički suradnik – viši laborant (timaritelj) (m/ž) na Zavodu za histologiju i embriologiju Medicinskog fakulteta u Rijeci, 1 (jedan) izvršitelj/ica, sa punim radnim vremenom, na neodređeno vrijeme. UVJETI:
  • razina 6. sveučilišni odnosno stručni studij iz područje biomedicine i zdravstva (laboratorijskog, sanitarnog, veterinarskog usmjerenja) ili tehničkih znanosti,
  • poznavanje engleskog jezika,
  • poznavanje rada na računalu
  • probni rad – 3 (tri) mjeseca.
Dokumentacija koju je potrebno priložiti (u PDF formatu): životopis i dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta. Prijave na natječaj mogu dostaviti osobe oba spola (članak 13. stavak 2. Zakona o ravnopravnosti spolova, NN 82/08, 69/17). Prijavom na natječaj kandidat daje privolu da se svi njegovi osobni podaci sadržani u natječajnoj dokumentaciji prikupljaju i obrađuju u svrhu provedbe natječaja u skladu s propisima koji uređuju zaštitu osobnih podataka. Kandidati koji se na temelju posebnih propisa pozivaju na pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja, obvezni su u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i priložiti sve dokaze koje posebni propisi određuju za ostvarivanje tog prava. Takvi kandidati ostvaruju prednost prilikom zapošljavanja u odnosu na ostale kandidate, samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Kandidati koji ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju po Zakonu o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članova njihovih obitelji (popis dokaza za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju- ZOHBDR 2021.pdf (gov.hr)), Zakonu o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (popis dokaza za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju- Zakon o civilnim stradalnicima iz DR.pdf (gov.hr)), dužni su se uz prijavu na natječaj pozvati na to pravo, te priložiti dokaze o ispunjavanju tih uvjeta. Kandidati kojima hrvatski jezik nije materinji jezik moraju priložiti dokaz o poznavanju hrvatskog jezika (razina B2) prema Zajedničkom europskom referentnom okviru za jezike. Kandidati koji su stekli obrazovanje izvan Republike Hrvatske, moraju dostaviti mišljenje nadležne agencije o stečenoj inozemnoj stručnoj kvalifikaciji ili dokaz da je pokrenut postupak za stjecanje istog. O održavanju testiranja i/ili intervjua kandidati će biti pravodobno obaviješteni. Ukoliko kandidat ne pristupi provjeri, smatrat će se da je povukao prijavu na natječaj. Fakultet zadržava pravo da djelomično ili u cijelosti poništi natječaj te da ne izvrši izbor niti jednog kandidata bez posebnog obrazloženja. Rok za podnošenje prijava je 8 (osam) dana od dana objave natječaja. Prijave se podnose putem elektroničke pošte pisarnica@medri.uniri.hr s naznakom „Natječaj za radno mjesto viši tehnički suradnik – viši laborant (timaritelj) na Zavodu za histologiju i embriologiju“. jobs.title: STRUČNI/A SURADNIK/ICA - PSIHOLOG/ICA
jobs.description:
Na temelju članka 26. stavaka 1., 2. i 3. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju („Narodne novine“, broj 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22, 101/23, 145/23, 145/24, 146/25 i 22/26), članka 61. stavka 1. točke 1. Statuta Dječjeg vrtića Bambi Sunja KLASA: 011-02/22-01/01, URBROJ: 2176-75-01-22-03 od 27. listopada 2022. godine i Odluke Upravnog vijeća KLASA: 601-06/26-01/20, URBROJ: 2176-75-03-26-7 od 31. kolovoza 2026. godine, Upravno vijeće Dječjeg vrtića Bambi Sunja raspisuje

N A T J E Č A J

za obavljanje poslova

I.

STRUČNI SURADNIK – PSIHOLOG (m/ž) – 1 izvršitelj/ica,

za rad u Dječjem vrtiću Bambi Sunja, na neodređeno puno radno vrijeme

II.

UVJETI:

Na natječaj se mogu prijaviti osobe obaju spolova, sukladno članku 13. stavku 3. Zakona o ravnopravnosti spolova („Narodne novine“, broj 82/08 i 69/17), koje ispunjavaju uvjete propisane Zakonom o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju („Narodne novine“, broj 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22, 101/23, 145/23, 145/24, 146/25 i 22/26) i Pravilnikom o odgovarajućoj vrsti i razini obrazovanja odgojno-obrazovnih i ostalih radnika u dječjem vrtiću, ustanovama te drugim pravnim i fizičkim osobama koje provode programe ranog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja („Narodne novine“, broj 145/24 i 62/25 – ispravak):

• završen sveučilišni diplomski studij psihologije i stečen akademski naziv sveučilišni/a magistar/magistra psihologije.

Na natječaj se može prijaviti i osoba koja se prvi put zapošljava na radnom mjestu stručnog suradnika. Izabrani kandidat koji ima status pripravnika obavlja pripravnički staž i polaže stručni ispit u skladu s Pravilnikom o načinu i uvjetima polaganja stručnoga ispita odgojitelja i stručnih suradnika u dječjem vrtiću („Narodne novine“, broj 84/24).

Uz vlastoručno potpisanu prijavu, koja mora sadržavati adresu stanovanja, kontaktni broj telefona i adresu elektroničke pošte, kandidat mora priložiti sljedeće dokumente u preslici:

• životopis,

• dokaz o stečenoj stručnoj spremi,

• dokaz o državljanstvu,

• uvjerenje nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak za neko od kaznenih djela iz članka 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju, ne starije od dana objave natječaja,

• uvjerenje nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata ne vodi prekršajni postupak za neko od prekršajnih djela iz članka 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju, ne starije od dana objave natječaja,

• potvrdu nadležnog područnog ureda Hrvatskog zavoda za socijalni rad da kandidatu nije izrečena mjera žurnoga izdvajanja djeteta iz obitelji ili mjera za zaštitu osobnih prava i dobrobiti djeteta u nadležnosti suda, sukladno članku 25. stavku 10. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju, ne stariju od dana objave natječaja,

• dokaz o radnopravnom statusu (elektronički zapis odnosno potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje), ne stariji od dana objave natječaja.

Ako je kandidat obrazovnu kvalifikaciju stekao u inozemstvu, dužan je priložiti odgovarajući dokaz o priznavanju inozemne obrazovne kvalifikacije u Republici Hrvatskoj, kada je takvo priznavanje potrebno prema važećim propisima.

• Kandidati koji prema posebnim propisima ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju moraju se u prijavi pozvati na to pravo i priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju; prednost ostvaruju samo pod jednakim uvjetima.

Kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji („Narodne novine“, broj 121/17, 98/19, 84/21 i 156/23) dužni su, uz dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta natječaja, priložiti i dokaze potrebne za ostvarivanje prava prednosti, dostupne na mrežnoj stranici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/843.

Kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom („Narodne novine“, broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18 i 32/20) dužni su, uz dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta natječaja, priložiti i dokaz o utvrđenom statusu osobe s invaliditetom.

Kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48.f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata („Narodne novine“, broj 33/92, 57/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13 i 98/19) dužni su, uz dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta natječaja, priložiti i odgovarajuće dokaze o ostvarivanju prava prednosti te dokaz o načinu prestanka radnog odnosa kod posljednjeg poslodavca.

Kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata („Narodne novine“, broj 84/21 i 13/26) dužni su, uz dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta natječaja, priložiti i dokaze potrebne za ostvarivanje prava prednosti, dostupne na mrežnoj stranici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/843.

Osobni podaci prikupljeni na temelju ovoga natječaja obrađivat će se isključivo u svrhu provedbe natječajnog postupka, u skladu s propisima kojima se uređuje zaštita osobnih podataka, osobito Uredbom (EU) 2016/679 Europskog parlamenta i Vijeća od 27. travnja 2016. o zaštiti pojedinaca u vezi s obradom osobnih podataka i o slobodnom kretanju takvih podataka (Opća uredba o zaštiti podataka). Podnošenjem prijave kandidat potvrđuje da je upoznat s obradom svojih osobnih podataka u navedenu svrhu.

Kandidatom prijavljenim na natječaj smatra se samo osoba koja podnese pravodobnu, potpunu i vlastoručno potpisanu prijavu te ispunjava formalne uvjete iz natječaja.

S kandidatima koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete natječaja i podnijeli su pravodobnu i potpunu prijavu provest će se razgovor (intervju). Intervjuom će se procjenjivati stručna znanja i kompetencije kandidata, motivacija za rad, razumijevanje uloge stručnog suradnika psihologa u sustavu ranog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja, komunikacijske kompetencije te pristup radu i suradnji s djecom, roditeljima, odgojiteljima i drugim stručnim radnicima. Kandidati će o mjestu i vremenu razgovora biti obaviješteni putem adrese elektroničke pošte navedene u prijavi. Dolazak na razgovor je obvezan. Kandidat koji se ne odazove pozivu na razgovor smatra se da je odustao od prijave na natječaj i više se ne smatra kandidatom u postupku.

Kandidati su dužni priložiti dokaz o promjeni imena i/ili prezimena ako podaci u priloženoj dokumentaciji nisu istovjetni.

Kandidat predložen za izbor bit će pozvan da u primjerenom roku, a prije sklapanja ugovora o radu, dostavi uvjerenje o zdravstvenoj sposobnosti za obavljanje poslova radnog mjesta.

Prijave na natječaj s obveznom dokumentacijom dostavljaju se u zatvorenoj omotnici osobno ili poštom na adresu: Dječji vrtić Bambi Sunja, Matije Gupca 24, 44210 Sunja, uz obveznu naznaku: „Za natječaj – stručni suradnik – psiholog, neodređeno puno radno vrijeme – ne otvarati“.

Napomena: Kod prijava koje se dostavljaju poštom-preporučenom pošiljkom, kao dan dostave smatra se dan kada je preporučena pošiljka predana na poštu. U slučaju dostave prijave običnom poštom, kao dan dostave prijave smatra se dan kada je obična pošiljka zaprimljena u Dječjem vrtiću Bambi Sunja.

Rok za podnošenje prijava je osam (8) dana od dana objave natječaja.

O rezultatima natječaja kandidati će biti obaviješteni putem mrežne stranice Dječjeg vrtića Bambi Sunja https://www.dv-bambi-sunja.hr/ u roku od osam dana od dana donošenja odluke o odabiru kandidata na sjednici Upravnog vijeća.

Nepravodobne, nepotpune i nepotpisane prijave te prijave zaprimljene elektroničkim putem neće se razmatrati.

Natječaj je otvoren od 2. 9. 2026. do 10. 9. 2026. godine.

Job Title: Nurse

International SOS is the world’s leading medical and security services company with over 12,000 employees working in 1,000 locations in 90 countries. International SOS Government Services administers the TRICARE Overseas Program providing high-quality, accessible health care services for U.S. Military service members, family members, retirees, and other eligible beneficiaries overseas.

About the role

- Perhaps you live abroad and would like to return to Poland?
- Do you have a Polish nursing license?
- Looking to apply your experience in a new environment?
- Is it time to move away from the demands of clinical care in a hospital environment?
- Do you speak Polish and English?

We are looking for a Nurse (known internally as a Near Patient Nurse) based in Poznan or within proximity, to support our global patient care program, TRICARE. You will be responsible for providing medical case management for patients, visiting them at healthcare provider sites, writing medical reports and providing medical updates.

This is a fantastic opportunity for nurses to move away from the demands of a clinical environment to an on-site case manager role using their medical expertise.

Key responsibilities

- The nurse would provide comprehensive in-patient clinical case management
- Develop and maintain effective relationships with providers, (medical and administrative) internal and external stakeholders and suppliers to ensure excellent delivery of service
- Regularly visit or contact the care providers (civilian and military treatment facility centers) to obtain updates for medical cases
- Liaise with patients to obtain detailed clinical information including past medical history to allow for accurate on-going case management
- Support the medical collection team in obtaining the discharge summary and medical records from the care provider

About you

- Registered General Nurse or equivalent with minimum 3 years of experience with registration to practice in Poland
- Recognized qualification to minimum diploma level or equivalence in practice demonstrated through portfolio/CV
- A demonstrable commitment to professional development
- Able to communicate Polish and proficiently in English

Patienten-Empathie: Du schenkst Menschen in Ausnahmesituationen Sicherheit und das Gefühl, in den besten Händen zu sein.

Vielleicht hast Du schon länger über die Schweiz nachgedacht. Lass uns gemeinsam hinschauen, was Dich hier wirklich erwartet:
Spürbare Wertschätzung & Spitzen-Gehalt: Schweizer Saläre und hervorragende Sozialleistungen bieten Dir eine finanzielle Freiheit und Sicherheit, die Du so wahrscheinlich noch nicht kennst.

Lebensqualität pur: Die Nordschweiz bietet Dir die perfekte Balance. Atemberaubende Natur, die Alpen vor der Haustür und gleichzeitig die unmittelbare Nähe zur deutschen Heimat.
Dein Rundum-Sorglos-Paket: Wir sind an Deiner Seite. Von der SRK-Anerkennung Deines Diploms über die Wohnungssuche bis hin zu allen bürokratischen Schritten – wir halten Dir den Rücken frei.

Fundierte, professionelle Erfahrung in den Bereichen MRT und Angiologie/DSA.
Die Bereitschaft, Dich auf ein neues, wertschätzendes System einzulassen und Dich weiterzuentwickeln.

Mach jetzt den ersten Schritt in Deine neue Freiheit.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, EMEA Service Delivery Lead (f/m/d) - EMEA based (IT-Service-Delivery-Manager/in)

With the resources of a large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.

The EMEA Service Delivery Lead is a regional leadership role within Global Engineering Services (GES), part of Siemens' Global Technologies & Infrastructure (GTI) organization. This role is responsible for the end-to-end delivery of engineering support services across all EMEA sites, serving Siemens software engineers across Europe, Middle East, and Africa. The Senior Manager directly leads EMEA SD Managers and is accountable for service quality, regional consistency, and execution of global GES programmes within the EMEA region.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Regional Leadership & Operations

- Lead and develop a regional team of SD Managers responsible for engineering support across EMEA sites.- Own regional SLO/SLA performance; ensure targets are met, tracked, and reported consistently.- Drive operational consistency across EMEA sites aligned to global GES standards and Global Operations Excellence (GOE) defined processes.- Act as the primary escalation point for EMEA service issues, customer concerns, and critical incidents.- Ensure CMDB accuracy, asset management, and monitoring compliance across EMEA sites.

Programme Delivery

- Lead EMEA execution of global transformation programmes.- Maintain regional project status, risks, and blockers; provide regular updates to the Global SD Director.- Coordinate with different stakeholders on regional deployments and platform changes.

People Leadership

- Line-manage EMEA SD Managers; set clear objectives, conduct performance reviews, and support career development.- Foster a collaborative, high-accountability team culture across geographically dispersed EMEA teams.- Identify talent gaps, succession risks, and training needs within the EMEA SD function.

Stakeholder Engagement

- Build strong relationships with EMEA sites stakeholders, business units, and functional managers.- Represent the EMEA region in GES global leadership forums, cross-functional reviews, and planning cycles.- Collaborate with Americas and APAC SD Leads to share best practices and drive global consistency.

Engineering Segment Engagement

- Execute the GES engineering segment engagement model within EMEA; act as the regional point of contact for EMEA segment leads on infrastructure quality, environment needs, and development productivity.- Establish a structured engagement cadence with EMEA engineering segment representatives to gather feedback on CI/CD environments, tooling gaps, and productivity blockers.- Identify and escalate EMEA-specific development environment constraints that impact engineering velocity; collaborate with GOE and Architecture & Standards to drive resolution.- Contribute regional segment insights to GES-wide reporting on developer productivity and service quality.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE
Required

- Substantial relevant experience in service delivery, infrastructure operations, or engineering support, with a demonstrated track record of regional management responsibility across multiple countries.- Proven experience leading geographically distributed teams across multiple countries within the EMEA region.- Strong working knowledge of ITSM frameworks (ITIL) and service level management practices.- Experience managing escalations, service performance, and operational governance in a complex enterprise environment.- Demonstrated ability to drive cross-functional programmes and change within large, matrixed organizations.- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; fluent in English (additional language proficiency is an advantage).- Solid understanding of asset management practices, including CMDB governance, hardware lifecycle tracking, and software asset inventory across distributed sites.- Practical knowledge of data center operations, including RDC/colocation environments, physical infrastructure management, and capacity oversight.- Working knowledge of server and storage technologies, including enterprise server platforms, SAN/NAS storage, and backup frameworks sufficient to manage and govern SD teams responsible for these environments.- Awareness of vulnerability management practices, including coordination with security teams on remediation tracking and compliance obligations across EMEA sites.- Familiarity with software development practices and the SDLC; ability to engage with engineering teams on environment needs and tooling requirements without deep hands-on development experience.- Awareness of CI/CD concepts and pipeline dependencies; sufficient understanding to identify where GES infrastructure is a bottleneck or enabler for engineering delivery.

Preferred

- Background in software engineering or large-scale enterprise infrastructure environments.- Hands-on or supervisory experience with virtualization technologies (VMware ESXi, OpenStack or equivalent platforms).- Exposure to high-performance or grid computing environments — understanding of compute cluster operations, job scheduling, and distributed infrastructure management.- Understanding of enterprise networking fundamentals, sufficient to oversee network-dependent service delivery across EMEA.- Experience managing EMEA-specific regulatory and compliance considerations (e.g., data residency, works council processes, GDPR implications for IT operations).- Exposure to software engineering or DevOps environments — direct collaboration with development teams or platform engineering; comfort discussing developer workflow tooling, build pipelines, and environment provisioning.

EDUCATION
Degree — Required

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline.- Degrees in other disciplines will be considered where accompanied by strong relevant experience.

Advanced Education — Preferred

- Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering Management, or an MBA with a technology focus.

CERTIFICATIONS
IT Service Management & Governance — Preferred

- ITIL v4 Foundation — required at minimum; Managing Professional track highly valued.- COBIT 2019 Foundation — IT governance and control framework awareness.- ISO 27001 awareness — relevant to EMEA regulatory and security compliance considerations.

Project & Programme Management — Advantageous

- PMP (Project Management Professional) — PMI.- PRINCE2 Foundation or Practitioner.

LOCATION & TRAVEL
This role is based in EMEA, with a preference for one of Siemens' DISW established locations.
Regular travel across EMEA sites is expected.

Part of: GES Global Service Delivery function, GTI

- Own the end-to-end SLO/SLA framework for the SD function globally; ensure targets are met and reported.- Partner with the Global Operations Excellence (GOE) team to enforce standards, monitoring, and governance.- Ensure all regions are aligned on tooling, processes, CMDB accuracy, and asset management practices.- Oversee the successful delivery of global programmes (e.g., PCD migration, device refresh, CMDB clean-up…etc).- Identify operational risks and blockers across regions; escalate and resolve proactively.

People Leadership

- Directly lead three Regional SD Leads (Americas, EMEA, APAC) and maintain accountability for the full SD organization.- Build a high-performing, engaged, and geographically distributed team; develop regional leaders and successors.- Drive talent reviews, performance management, and calibration across the SD function.- Champion a culture of accountability, customer focus, and continuous improvement.

Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Engagement

- Serve as the primary SD point of contact for peer GTI functions.- Build and maintain strong relationships with key business stakeholders.- Collaborate with regional SD leads and managers to address customer escalations and service issues.- Provide regular operational reporting to the Senior Director, GES and GTI leadership.

Engineering Segments Engagement

- Own the customer relationship between GES and engineering segments globally; serve as the primary point of contact for segment leads regarding infrastructure, service quality, and engineering productivity.- Establish and maintain a regular engagement cadence with segment representatives to understand development pipeline needs, CI/CD tooling requirements, and environment pain points.- Proactively identify opportunities to improve developer productivity and engineering experience — including build performance, environment stability, tooling access, and onboarding friction.- Collaborate with SD Leads, GOE, and Architecture & Standards teams to translate segment feedback into actionable service improvements and capacity planning inputs.- Track and report on segments satisfaction, developer productivity trends, and GES contribution to engineering velocity — escalate where GES environment is a constraint on delivery.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE
Required

- Extensive relevant experience in infrastructure management, service delivery, or technology operations, with a significant portion of that time spent in senior leadership — managing global or multi-regional teams at scale.- Proven track record leading large, geographically distributed teams across multiple countries and regions.- Deep understanding of ITSM frameworks (ITIL) and IT governance practices (COBIT or equivalent).- Strong experience managing budgets, headcount planning, and resource allocation at a global scale.- Demonstrated ability to drive transformation programmes and change across complex organizations.- Experience operating in a matrixed, multinational corporate environment.- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; comfortable presenting to executive audiences.- Sound understanding of asset management practices, including CMDB governance, hardware lifecycle management, and software asset inventory at enterprise scale.- Demonstrable knowledge of data center operations and management, including RDC/colocation environments, capacity planning, and infrastructure governance.- Working knowledge of server and storage technologies, including enterprise server platforms, SAN/NAS storage, and backup/recovery frameworks.- Familiarity with vulnerability management processes, including risk prioritization, remediation tracking, and coordination with information security teams to ensure compliance.- Familiarity with software development practices and the software development lifecycle (SDLC); ability to engage credibly with engineering and development teams on environment and tooling requirements.- Working knowledge of CI/CD concepts and common pipeline patterns; exposure to CI/CD platforms, sufficient to understand engineering dependencies and environment requirements.- Understanding of developer workflow tooling and environment needs — including source control, build systems, artifact management, and test infrastructure — as they relate to GES infrastructure provisioning and support.

Preferred

- Background in software engineering, or large-scale enterprise Technology environments.- Hands-on or oversight experience with virtualization technologies (VMware ESXi, OpenStack, or equivalent platforms).- Experience with high-performance or grid computing environments — including job scheduling, compute cluster management, and distributed compute platforms.- Understanding of enterprise networking concepts, sufficient to oversee network-dependent service delivery.- Experience working with or transitioning to cloud-managed or hybrid infrastructure models.- Prior experience in a software engineering, DevOps, or platform engineering role — or significant direct collaboration with software development teams; comfort discussing CI/CD pipelines, build performance, and developer environment requirements.

EDUCATION
Degree — Required

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline.- Degrees in other disciplines will be considered where accompanied by strong relevant experience.

Advanced Education — Preferred

- Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering Management, or an MBA with a technology focus.

CERTIFICATIONS
IT Service Management & Governance — Preferred

- ITIL v4 Foundation — required; Managing Professional or Strategic Leader tracks highly valued.- COBIT 2019 Foundation or Practitioner — IT governance and control framework knowledge.- ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or Auditor — advantageous for security governance oversight.

Project & Programme Management — Advantageous

- PMP (Project Management Professional) — PMI.- PRINCE2 Practitioner or PRINCE2 Agile.

LOCATION & TRAVEL
This is a global role with flexibility on base location.
Regular international travel to regional sites and team face-to-face meetings is expected.

REPORTING STRUCTURE
Reports to: Senior Director, Global Engineering Services (GES)
Direct reports: Regional SD Leads — Americas, EMEA, APAC
Functional scope: Full global SD organization

jobs.title: Project Radioprotection Spezialist*in (w/m/d) (Medizinphysiker/in)
jobs.description:
Wollen Sie die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens mitgestalten? Wir bei Siemens Healthineers setzen auf Menschen, die ihre Energie und Leidenschaft diesem Ziel widmen – das sagt schon unser Unternehmensname. Siemens Healthineers steht für Pioniergeist unserer Mitarbeitenden, gepaart mit unserer langen Tradition als weltweit führender Technologiekonzern in der stets dynamischen Gesundheitsbranche.
Wir bieten ein flexibles und dynamisches Umfeld voller Gelegenheiten, über sich hinaus zu wachsen, um sich persönlich und beruflich weiterzuentwickeln. Klingt das interessant für Sie?

Dann werden Sie Teil unseres globalen Teams als Project Radioprotection Spezialist*in (w/m/d) und unterstützen Sie uns dabei, die Zukunft der Präzisionstheranostik aktiv mitzugestalten und gleichzeitig die Patientenversorgung weiter voranzubringen. Diese Position richtet sich an ambitionierte Fachkräfte, die den nächsten Schritt in ihrer Karriere gehen möchten. Sie bietet die Möglichkeit, Strahlenschutzaktivitäten über alle Projektphasen hinweg zu verantworten – von der Standortplanung über Genehmigungsverfahren und Abschirmungskonzepte bis hin zu regulatorischer Compliance und Projektumsetzung für neue und bestehende radiopharmazeutische Einrichtungen.

Wählen Sie den besten Ort für Ihre Arbeit - im Rahmen dieser Stelle ist es in Abstimmung mit Ihrer Führungskraft möglich, bis zu einem durchschnittlichen Volumen von 60% der jeweiligen Arbeitszeit mobil (innerhalb Deutschlands) zu arbeiten.
Noch mehr Flexibilität? Mobiles Arbeiten aus dem Ausland ist unter bestimmten Voraussetzungen und in ausgewählten Ländern für bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr möglich.

Diese Position kann an den Standorten Erlangen (Deutschland), Venafro (Italien) oder Barcelona (Spanien) besetzt werden.

Ihre Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:

- In enger, bereichsübergreifender Zusammenarbeit begleiten Sie Projekte von der Standortkonzeption bis zur Inbetriebnahme und steuern die fachliche Entwicklung sämtlicher relevanter Strahlenschutz‑ und EHS‑Prozesse und ‑Verfahren.- Sie sind verantwortlich für die Erstellung, Einreichung und fortlaufende Betreuung aller Genehmigungsunterlagen für den Umgang mit radioaktiven Stoffen, einschließlich der erforderlichen behördlichen Korrespondenz.- Sie entwickeln Abschirmungskonzepte für neue Anlagen, neue Anwendungen sowie neue Zyklotron‑Installationen.- Sie führen Abschirmungsüberprüfungen sowie verifizierende und bestätigende Messungen durch.- Sie leisten Vor‑Ort‑Unterstützung, um die korrekte Umsetzung der erforderlichen Strahlenschutz‑ und EHS‑Programme für einen erfolgreichen Anlagenbetrieb sicherzustellen.- Sie prüfen und reichen sämtliche erforderlichen Unterlagen für Stilllegungen ein.- Sie unterstützen Vor‑Ort als verantwortliche*r Lizenznehmer‑Stakeholder, um eine erfolgreiche Durchführung von Stilllegungsaktivitäten zu gewährleisten.- Sie steuern Projekte und stellen sicher, dass alle relevanten Fristen eingehalten werden.- Sie begleiten Standorte bei behördlichen Inspektionen, um Genehmigungen zu sichern und aufrechtzuerhalten.

Mehr über dieses Geschäftsfeld erfahren Sie unter Radiopharma (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de-ch/molecular-imaging/radiopharma)

Ihre Qualifikationen und Erfahrung:

- Sie verfügen über einen Masterabschluss in Medizinischer Physik, radiologischer Gesundheit, Strahlenschutz, Ingenieurwesen, Chemie, Pharmazie oder einem verwandten naturwissenschaftlichen Studiengang.- Sie bringen fundierte Kenntnisse im Umgang mit radioaktiven Stoffen sowie zu EHS‑regulatorischen Rahmenbedingungen mit, idealerweise aus einem regulierten industriellen oder pharmazeutischen Umfeld.- Sie verfügen über mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in radiochemischen oder radiopharmazeutischen Betrieben oder im angewandten Strahlenschutz mit offenen radioaktiven Stoffen.- Sie besitzen ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für GMP‑regulierte Umgebungen und die damit verbundenen regulatorischen Anforderungen.- Sie haben nachweisliche Erfahrung im Projektmanagement und sind in der Lage, Zeitpläne, Prioritäten und bereichsübergreifende Liefergegenstände effektiv zu steuern.- Sie verfügen über sehr gute Anwenderkenntnisse der Microsoft‑365‑Tools.- Wir freuen uns auch über Bewerbende mit Bachelor-Abschluss oder abgeschlossener Berufsaus- und Weiterbildung in Verbindung mit zusätzlicher Berufserfahrung in diesem Bereich.

Ihr Profil und Ihre Fähigkeiten:

- Sie verfügen über ausgezeichnete schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und können technische sowie regulatorische Inhalte klar und verständlich für unterschiedliche Stakeholder aufbereiten.- Sie zeichnen sich durch eine kooperative, proaktive Arbeitsweise aus und arbeiten effektiv in bereichsübergreifenden sowie remote organisierten Teams – bei gleichzeitig hoher persönlicher Verantwortungsübernahme.- Sie fühlen sich in einem hybriden Arbeitsumfeld wohl.- Sie sprechen fließend Englisch; weitere Sprachkenntnisse sind ein großer Vorteil.- Sie sind flexibel und bereit, bis zu 30 % pro Jahr innerhalb Europas, des Vereinigten Königreichs und Indiens zu reisen.- Sie sind bereit, in Deutschland, Frankreich, Spanien oder Italien zu leben bzw. bei Bedarf umzuziehen.

Unser globales Team:
Siemens Healthineers ist ein weltweit führendes Medizintechnikunternehmen. Mit mehr als 74.000 engagierten Mitarbeitenden in über 70 Ländern gestalten wir die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens. Jeden Tag profitieren etwa fünf Millionen Patient*innen weltweit von unseren innovativen Technologien und Dienstleistungen aus den Bereichen Diagnostik und therapeutische Bildgebung, Labordiagnostik und molekulare Medizin sowie von unseren digitalen Gesundheits- und Unternehmensdienstleistungen.

Unsere Kultur:
Unsere Unternehmenskultur schätzt verschiedene Blickwinkel, offene Diskussionen und den Willen, Konventionen in Frage zu stellen. Ständiger Wandel gehört zu unserem Arbeitsalltag. Wir wollen in unserer Branche Veränderungen vorantreiben, statt nur darauf zu reagieren. Deswegen laden wir Sie ein, sich neuen Herausforderungen zu stellen, eigene Ideen auszutesten und Erfolge zu feiern. Besuchen Sie auch unsere Karriere-Seite unter https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers)
Wir legen Wert auf Diversität und Chancengleichheit und freuen uns über Bewerbungen mit vielfältigen Hintergründen und insbesondere von Menschen mit Behinderung. #myabilityshs
Sie möchten mehr erfahren und erste Fragen gern persönlich klären – Sprechen Sie uns an: recruitinggersupport.func@siemens-healthineers.com. Kontaktperson dieser Stellenausschreibung ist SALIMA BOURHANI.
Wir nehmen den Schutz Ihrer Daten und die Einhaltung der DSGVO und anderer Datenschutzgesetze ernst. Deshalb bitten wir Sie, uns Ihren Lebenslauf nicht per E-Mail zu schicken. Bitte legen Sie ein Profil in unserer Talent Community an, um Ihren Lebenslauf hochzuladen. Daran erkennen wir, dass Sie an Karrieremöglichkeiten bei uns interessiert sind und können Sie zu relevanten Stellen benachrichtigen. Klicken Sie hier (https://jobs.siemens-healthineers.com/de_DE/searchjobs/RegistrationMethods) , um ein Profil anzulegen.

An alle Personalvermittlungsagenturen:
Die Personalbeschaffung bei Siemens Healthineers wird intern verwaltet. Externe Unterstützung ist nur dann gestattet, wenn eine qualifizierte Agentur einen formellen Vertrag mit uns abgeschlossen hat. Unaufgeforderte Bewerbungen und Empfehlungen von Kandidatenprofilen ohne aktuelle Lieferantenvereinbarung begründen keine Zustimmung und sind somit nicht gebührenpflichtig. Wir löschen und vernichten nicht angeforderte Informationen und empfehlen, von derartigen Praktiken abzusehen. Wir danken Ihnen für die Einhaltung unserer Richtlinien.

jobs.title: Driver
jobs.description:
St. Georgeâs University invites applicants for the position of DRIVER within the Transportation Department

Job Description

Objective

Drivers within the transportation department are responsible for operating SGU buses to transport students, faculty, staff, and other authorized personnel, in a safe and controlled manner.

Drivers play a pivotal role in enhancing the student success by providing a safe and reliable service along pre-determined routes to and from campus. The driver is expected to conduct himself in a professional manner which reflects the ethos of St. Georgeâs University.

Essential Functions

  • Communicate with passengers and employers regarding delays or any issues along a route.
  • Complete a daily vehicle inspection sheet prior to operating any SGU vehicle. The completed sheet is to be handed to the duty supervisor once completed. Should maintenance or cleaning be required, you are to inform your supervisor immediately and list any such issues on the daily inspection form
  • Adhere to the busing schedules
  • Wearing issued uniform in a presentable manner
  • Observance of all Government traffic laws and best practices which are enforced by the RGPF,
  • All accidents, penalties and fines, as a result of driving, on and off the job, must be reported immediately to the Transportation Manager.
  • Report all mechanical issues to management (manager or supervisor) as soon as is possible.
  • Prior to commencing duty, ensure route destination signs reflect designated route and is clearly visible, LED & Magnetic signs should both be used.
  • Follow all recommended health and safety practices ensuring the safety of the driver and all passengers
  • Maintain the assigned vehicle in a clean and tidy state
  • Any issues or concerns which involve students, faculty or staff should be reported to the transportation manager or supervisor at the earliest convenience. Confrontation with any of our passengers should be avoided.
  • Perform any other related duties as assigned by the transportation manager/supervisor or other appropriate administrator
  • Observe safety regulations and policies and perform other job-related tasks.
  • Promptly report all safety violation, including colleagues suspected of being under the influence of drugs or alcohol on the job.
  • Must be student centric and possess the ability to interact with students, faculty, and staff in a positive manner

Essential Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Should be willing to learn local areas of interest and to plan the safest route to and from those areas
  • Skillful at maneuvering of large or small vehicles along and around narrow and tight roads
  • Confident in basic mechanical skills
  • 20/20 vision with or without glasses or contacts
  • Willingness to submit to random drug screening
  • Able to occasionally lift 50 pounds
  • Ability to adapt to changing situations within the working environment

Work Environment/Physical Demands

  • Drivers within the transportation department are expected to work in varying conditions.

In addition, drivers are exposed to other environmental hazards during their daily duties, including the following:

  • Engine noise
  • A/C blower noise
  • Conversations between passengers especially the late-night revelers
  • Buzzer noise

Hours and Travel

  • St. Georgeâs University is a 24 hour operation, therefore drivers may be required to transport members of our community as necessary.
  • Drivers are expected to work a rotational shift system.

Qualifications

  • 6+ years of driving experience
  • Numerate and literate with the ability to complete basic forms and documents
  • A valid C1 Licence

St. George's University is an equal opportunity employer. As such, it is company policy to fill positions with qualified candidates regardless of race, color, sex (including sexual orientation and gender presentation), age, religion, ancestry, national origin, citizenship status, pregnancy, marital status, medical condition, genetic information, disability, veteran status or status as a victim of domestic violence, except where there is a bona fide occupational qualification. This policy protects applicants and employees from discrimination in the hiring process.

Seoses suvise hooaja ja suurenenud töömahuga otsime oma meeskonda külaliskorterite koristajaid nii täis- kui osalise koormusega. jobs.title: Tekniker
jobs.description:
Vi søger en en tekniker til automationsopgaver i produktionsvirksomhed – hos en af vores faste industrikunder i Hedensted. Du vil indgå i vores faste serviceteam, hvor du primært får service- og optimeringsopgaver, men kan også deltage i projekter

Om jobbet

Kundens maskinpark omfatter alt fra gamle maskiner med relæstyring til nye produktionsanlæg med PLC, HMI og robotter. Du arbejder med alt fra fejlfinding på eksisterende anlæg til design og programmering af nye styringer – og både med el, mekanik og pneumatik. Du skal derfor trives med praktiske opgaver, hvor du indimellem får snavsede fingre. Vi forbereder løbende kundens produktionsanlæg med fokus på sikkerhed, driftsoptimering og betjening – og fungerer som kundens tætte rådgiver.

Dine kvalifikationer

Vi forventer, at du er uddannet elektriker, tekniker eller lign. og har erfaring med eller flair for PLC-programmering; gerne Rockwell og Siemens. Du har den rette indstilling, bidrager positivt og tager ansvar for opgaven, indtil den er løst. Du hjælper dine kollegaer og holder den gode tone – og er derudover mødestabil.

Kjærgaard tilbyder dig

Du får en spændende stilling i en lille afdeling med ordnede forhold, kompetence kollegaer og gode muligheder for personlig udvikling i et selvstændigt og udfordrende miljø. Efter endt oplæring skal du deltage i vores vagtordning (ca. hver 8-10. uge). Du kommer til at arbejde i et uformelt miljø, hvor vi vægter samarbejde, kvalitet og faglig stolthed højt. Du får en central rolle i vores værksted og bliver en del af et stærkt hold.

  • et alsidigt job hvor du både arbejder med montage, service og tilpasning

  • frihed under ansvar og mulighed for selv at præge din hverdag

  • et fagligt stærkt miljø med gode kolleger og en uformel omgangstone

  • en arbejdsplads hvor vi prioriterer trivsel og ordnede forhold

  • løn efter kvalifikationer

Du skal kunne identificere dig i overensstemmelse med vores værdisæt K7.

Ansøgning og CV

Vi arbejder på at besætte stillingen hurtigst muligt og tager ansøgere ind løbende. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte divisionschef Morten Winther Juhlin på mwj@kia.dk eller 4080 0020.

Send din ansøgning ved at klikke på “Søg stillingen”-knappen til højre. Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

jobs.title: Project Engineer – Vaasa
jobs.description:
About the role

In this position, you will become part of a close-knit and experienced team of experts. We are looking for a long-term addition to the team: someone for whom this role offers an inspiring next step in their career, and who wants to thrive and grow in the position for years to come.

What We Offer You
- Salary: Approximately €2,800 – €3,500/month depending on your experience and background.
- A long-term career path: We offer a role where you are invested in and where you can genuinely deepen your professional skills over the long term.
- Responsibility and freedom: Once you prove your skills, you will have the freedom to independently drive your projects to completion.
- Comprehensive support: Although we expect an ability to work independently, you will not be left alone. Your supervisor and a team of top professionals will support your success, especially during the onboarding phase in the first few months.

Work tasks

Your role is not pure design work in front of a screen; instead, you will act as a dynamic technical coordinator. Working as the Project Manager's right hand, you will be responsible for the technical success of energy plant lifecycle upgrades and automation retrofits in accordance with contract specifications.
- Guide and supervise design work, review electrical and automation drawings, and ensure the technical correctness of procurements.
- Act as a knowledgeable link between designers, logistics, subcontractors, and international customers.
- Depending on the size of the projects, you may manage several (max. 10) smaller automation upgrades simultaneously or extensive plant retrofit projects (from foundations up to the MV side).

What We Are Looking For

In this role, technical theory alone is not enough; you need a professional approach and strong drive to push things forward. You are no longer a complete beginner—you have already gained valuable experience and now want to take on broader responsibility.

To succeed in the position, we expect you to have:
- A solid professional foundation: You hold a relevant technical degree (e.g., Electrical or Automation Engineering, B.Sc. or M.Sc.) and previous work experience (e.g., a few years) in industry, commissioning, field service, or automation projects.
- The right personality: You are stress-tolerant and understand that the project world evolves daily. You are a proactive expert who also knows how to justify technical choices constructively and firmly.
- Language skills: Fluent spoken and written English is mandatory. Finnish language skills are considered a major asset in teamwork.

Vaasa is the Heart of This Role

This is a role where you grow into an expert and solve challenges together with the team on site. We strongly believe that the deepest expertise and best support are transferred most effectively when working alongside more experienced colleagues. Therefore, we expect you to work mainly at the Vaasa office. We are not looking for a remote worker for this position, but rather a team player who enjoys communal daily life on site. The position also includes occasional travel to global customer sites (estimated at approx. 30 travel days per year).

Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

jobs.title: Architecte Cloud - Écosystème Cloud Chinois (H/F)
jobs.description:
A propos du poste

Dans le cadre de la modernisation globale de ses infrastructures, notre client migre ses workloads actuellement hébergés sur des serveurs physiques RKE en fin de vie en Chine vers des services managés d'un cloud provider chinois. Ce projet stratégique d'une durée estimée à 12 mois vise à concevoir une architecture cible moderne, automatisée et hautement disponible.

Contrat : CDI de projet ou contrat Freelance, projet d'une durée initiale d'une année (atterrissage prévu été 2027).

Localisation : Secteur de Montbéliard, une présence sur site à minima de 2 jours / semaine sera nécessaire les 2 ou 3 premières semaines pour la phase de cadrage.







Vos missions :

Rattaché(e) à l'équipe technique de la DSI, vos responsabilités seront les suivantes :

- Cadrage et Chiffrage : Réaliser l'étude technique de faisabilité, définir l'architecture cible et présenter le chiffrage détaillé au DSI courant septembre.

- Build de l'Architecture : Concevoir et construire l'infrastructure sur un cloud provider chinois (type Alibaba Cloud) en privilégiant les services managés.

- Automatisation & Déploiement : Reproduire les mécanismes d'automatisation existants sur GCP à l'aide de Terraform et déployer les nouveaux clusters via Helm.

- Résolution des points de friction : Concevoir les architectures réseau (SD-WAN, cross-border line) pour maintenir la connectivité API avec Google, gérer l'interopérabilité de l'authentification (Google Identity) et définir les politiques de sécurité équivalentes à Cloud Armor.








Talent recherché

Expérience : Track record avéré et obligatoire sur un cloud provider chinois (idéalement Alibaba Cloud).
Nous recherchons un profil ayant à minima 5 années d'expérience en tant que Consultant Senior Cloud ou Architect Cloud et ayant déjà participé à des phases de cadrage et de chiffrage.

Compétences techniques :
- Compétences Cloud Chinois (Alibaba Cloud ou autre)

- Maîtrise de l'écosystème Kubernetes managé, des bases de données managées et du stockage objet.

- Expertise sur Terraform et Helm.

- Solides compétences en architecture réseau internationale et connectivité cross-border.

- Compétences GCP

- Connaissance des solutions de sécurité (WAF/Cloud Armor) et de gestion des identités (SSO/Google Cloud Identity).

- Utilisation de l'IA au quotidien

Soft Skills :

- Esprit de synthèse et pragmatisme pour concevoir des solutions simples à exploiter au quotidien.

- Autonomie et force de proposition pour guider le client sur ses choix stratégiques (ex. alternatives à PubSub).

- Capacité à communiquer facilement avec des équipes transverses

Langues : Anglais fluent (contexte international), Français, Mandarin serait un très gros plus








Processus de recrutement :

- Entretien initial avec notre recruteur et le responsable de la structure qui est ingénieur en informatique.
- Présentation de votre candidature à notre client (suite à un accord commun).
- Rencontre avec le client et ses équipes pour échanger sur le poste et les attentes.

jobs.title: Senior IT Project Manager - Data & AI Migrations, Espoo
jobs.description:
About the role

We are seeking an experienced Senior IT Project Manager on behalf of our client to lead critical data and AI initiatives within their Hydro business area. In this role, you will manage a portfolio of parallel workstreams at 100% allocation for three months. This position offers an excellent vantage point in the energy sector, combining complex data migrations, modern AI applications, and enterprise IT governance.

You are offered
You will be at the forefront of digital transformation, working with modern tools like Databricks and Azure. The role offers a competitive salary, a flexible hybrid work model, and the chance to lead high-visibility AI and data projects.

Work tasks

The role involves managing the full lifecycle of data platform migrations and AI application deployments, focusing on stakeholder alignment, technical validation, and operational readiness.
- Lead the Hydro ADP to FDP data platform migration pilot and validate technical feasibility.
- Manage the implementation and deployment of AI-powered applications for environmental permitting.
- Define project scope, success criteria, and deliver go/no-go recommendations to steering groups.
- Coordinate cross-functional teams, external vendors, and key business stakeholders.
- Ensure project execution aligns with IT governance models and cyber security standards.
- Oversee project budgets, resource planning, and comprehensive risk mitigation strategies.
- Manage dual-run validation, testing coordination, and formal handover to operations.

We are looking for

- Advanced knowledge of IT project management within enterprise environments.
- Proven experience leading data platform migrations and pilot-to-scale implementations.
- Basic knowledge of data architecture, including data models, governance, and structures.
- Full professional proficiency in English.
- Ability to pass a comprehensive security clearance (SUPO/SÄPO).

It is meritorious if you have
- Proficiency in Finnish or Swedish.
- Professional experience within the energy industry.
- Familiarity with Azure, Databricks, and PowerBI environments.

To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:
- Supportive
- Stress tolerant
- Goal oriented
- Orderly
- Responsible

Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

jobs.title: Yksikönjohtaja
jobs.description:
**Oletko sinä trauma- ja kiintymyssuhdetyön taituri, jolla on suuri palo sijaishuoltoa kohtaan?**

**Nyt avautuu upea mahdollisuus päästä luotsaamaan Poutapolun Koivulammia yksikönjohtajan roolissa. Haussa yksikönjohtaja kenen sydän sykkii sijaishuollolle.**

**Etsimme sosionomi ammattikorkeakoulututkinnon** omaavaa ammattilaista, joilla on työkokemusta lastensuojelun kentältä vähintään kolme vuotta sekä riittävä johtamistaito.

**Koivulammi tarjoaa** kodinomaisen kasvupaikan ja kodin seitsemälle sijaishuollon erityislaitospalveluja tarvitsevalle lapselle ja nuorelle. Koivulammissa lapsen hyvinvointi ja kuntoutus on kaiken toiminnan keskiössä. Koivulammin arki rakentuu vahvan kiintymyssuhde- ja traumatyöskentelyn ympärille.

**Koivulammi sijaitsee** Nurmijärven kauniissa maalaismaisemassa vain 30 minuutin ajomatkan päässä Helsingin keskustasta, aivan Hämeenlinnan väylän kupeessa.

**Arvostamme erilaisia** persoonia. Työotteesi on iloinen, reipas ja osaava. Asiakaslähtöinen ajattelu ja kohtaava työote ovat työsi peruselementtejä. Työn keskiössä on tiimin ja lasten hyvinvointi. Hyvinvoiva tiimi on avain lasten hyvinvointiin.

**Yksikönjohtajana pääset rakentamaan lapsille kuntouttavaa ja turvallista arkea osana osaavaa ja moniammatillista tiimiä.** Yksikön arki pyörii kellon ympäri. Yksikönjohtajan työ painottuu päivä- ja ilta-aikaan, mutta yksikön vastuuhenkilönä yksikönjohtaja on tavoitettavissa myös muina aikoina. Yksikönjohtajana olet valmis työskentelemään kokonaistyöajalla. Työhön kuuluu myös päivystysvalmius ja valmius olla tarvittaessa töissä myös viikonloppuisin. Ajokortti on edellytyksenä työn hoitamisessa.

**Yksikönjohtaja toimii yksikön vastuuhenkilönä** ja tekee tiivistä yhteistyötä vastaavan ohjaajan ja aluejohtajan kanssa. Yksikönjohtajan työnkuvaan kuuluu Koivulammin kokonaisvaltainen luotsaaminen yhdessä vastaavan ohjaajan kanssa.

**Yksikönjohtajalta edellytetään** vahvaa trauma- ja kiintymyssuhdeosaamista ja ymmärtämistä. Halua jalkauttaa omaa osaamistaan arkeen ja olla tiimin tukena lasten kuntoutuksessa.

**Yksikönjohtajalta vaaditaan joustavaa ja positiivista työotetta.** Tiimiä ja toimintaa luotsataan positiivisella ja arvostavalla kohtaamisella. Sijaishuollon arki on nopeatempoista, joten työ vaatii joustavuutta ja heittäytymiskykyä arjen muuttuviin tilanteisiin.

**Keskustelemme avoimesti,** tarvitsemme erilaisia mielipiteitä ja vahvuuksia. Uskomme empatiaan ja huumoriin, johtamiseen ilman hierarkiaa. Pidämme lupauksemme, meillä kaikki ovat tasa-arvoisia.

**Tarjoamme kilpailukykyisen** palkan (palkkatoive). Kyseessä kokonaistyöaika. Haluamme nauttia yhteisistä työvuosista ja kerryttää niitä lisää, yhdessä.

**Olethan yhteydessä,** jos arvomaailmamme kohtaavat.

**Ole ripeä,** aloitamme haastattelut mahdollisesti jo hakuaikana.

**Poutapolussa tuotamme** ammatillista sosiaalihuolto- ja lastensuojelulain mukaista palvelua avo- ja sijaishuollossa. Poutapolusta tulee 1.9. osa Rinnekoteja ja samalla osa Diakonissalaitos-konsernia.
