jobs.title: PhD Research Fellow in Soft Matter
jobs.description:
About the position

Position as PhD Research Fellow in chemistry/physical chemistry available at Department of Chemistry.

The fellowship period is three years. 
A fourth year may be considered, and it will involve 25% of other career-promoting work. Other career-promoting work may consist of teaching, supervision, and/or research assistance. This is dependent upon the qualification of the applicant and the current needs of the department.

Starting date: as soon as possible, no later than January 1st, 2027.

No one can be appointed for more than one PhD Research Fellowship period at the University of Oslo.

Place of work is Department of Chemistry in the Life Science Building at the University of Oslo, Gaustad, Oslo.


Job description

This position is part of the convergence environment PERMEATE – Peptides for Membrane Targeting and Synergistic Drug Delivery. Convergence environments are interdisciplinary research initiatives that aim to address major challenges in health and the environment. They are funded by UiO’s interdisciplinary strategic area UiO:Life Science.
PERMEATE focuses on overcoming cell membrane barriers using peptides to enable targeted delivery of therapeutic molecules. The project adopts a multidisciplinary approach, integrating expertise from computational sciences, chemistry, pharmacy, biology, and medicine. The convergence environment comprises three PhD positions and one postdoctoral position.

PhD Position within PERMEATE
We are seeking a highly motivated candidate to work on peptide-membrane interactions and the development of lipid nanoparticles (LNPs) for applications in both cancer therapy and the treatment of bacterial infections. The work will be situated at the interface of (bio)physical chemistry, soft matter, and organic chemistry. The candidate should have a strong interest in multidisciplinary research and a clear motivation for interdisciplinary collaboration.

The PhD project will focus on:

  • Characterizing and understanding the dynamical and structural effects of different peptides on a range of membrane systems
  • Developing strategies to formulate and prepare building blocks for stable LNPs through organic synthesis and click chemistry.
  • Use broad advanced instrumentation for X-ray/neutron scattering studies, surface studies (QCM-D, AFM), analytics (SEC-MALS/A4F) as well as spectroscopy (NMR/fluorescence/UV/vis) – all supported by quantitative data analysis.

The PhD candidate will contribute to bridging research activities across groups based in:
Pharmacy, Theoretical chemistry, Medicine, Microbiology and Biophysics and will play an active role in fostering collaboration within the PERMEATE convergence environment.


What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe’s leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Required qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or equivalent in chemistry, physical chemistry, biophysics or physics or related fields  
  • Documented practical wet lab experience and basic skills in organic chemistry 
  • Documented basic knowledge and some practical experience in programming and numerical methods.
  • Foreign completed degree (M.Sc.-level) corresponding to a minimum of four years in the Norwegian educational system
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills in English

Desired qualifications:

  • Demonstrated ability in developing, executing and analysing data from experimental lab work
  • Documented experience within quantitative data analysis and interpretation
  • Documented experience within soft matter and (bio)polymer science 
  • Documented experience in organic synthesis and characterization
  • Previous expertise in nanostructural characterization tools, in particular scattering techniques will be given weight
  • Earlier experience in soft matter, synthesis, conjugation chemistry and click chemistry will be considered positively

Language requirement:

  • Excellent oral and written communication skills in English
  • English requirements for applicants from outside of EU/ EEA countries and exemptions from the requirements:
    https://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc8

Grade requirements:
The norm is as follows:

  • The average grade point for courses included in the Bachelor’s degree must be C or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The average grade point for courses included in the Master’s degree must be B or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The Master’s thesis must have the grade B or better in the Norwegian educational system

For more information see:

The purpose of the fellowship is research training leading to the successful completion of a PhD degree. 

All candidates and projects will have to undergo a check versus national export, sanctions and security regulations. Candidates may be excluded based on these checks. Primary checkpoints are the Export Control regulation, the Sanctions regulation, and the national security regulation.


What are we looking for in you?

Personal skills:

  • Strong motivation for research and able to work proactively in a multidisciplinary team 
  • Ability to work independently in a self-driven manner
  • Ability to work precise in a structured manner and swiftly adapts to new tasks
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills
  • Positive attitude and the ability to handle hectic periods

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal skills.


We can offer you
  • A pleasant and stimulating work environment
  • Good welfare schemes
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities
  • Career development programmes
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes
  • Oslo’s family-friendly surroundings with their rich opportunities for culture and outdoor activities
  • Salary in position as PhD Research Fellow, position code 1017 in salary range NOK from 550 800 - 595 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund 

We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues, could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. 

We hope you will apply for the position with us.


How to apply

The application must include:

  • A cover letter specific for this position - statement of motivation and research interests in the specific scope of the current position
  • CV (summarizing education, positions and academic work - scientific publications)
  • Transcripts of records, copies of the original Bachelor and Master degree diploma (see below)
  • Documentation of English proficiency if applicable
  • List of publications and academic work that the applicant wishes to be considered by the evaluation committee
  • Names and contact details of 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and telephone number)

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".
Foreign applicants should attach an official explanation of their University's grading system.

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

The best qualified candidates will invited for interviews.

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we can't, you will hear from us.

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian), Guidelines concerning appointment to post doctoral and research posts at UiO (Norwegian) and Regulations for the degree of Philosophiae Doctor (PhD) at the University of Oslo.  

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees that is intended to secure the rights to all research results etc.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest rated institution of research and education with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. Its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally esteemed research communities make UiO an important contributor to society.

The Department of Chemistry is Norway's largest institution within research and education in chemistry. Our research excels internationally and we educate students to a wide variety of jobs in industry, academia, research institutions, schools and public administration. Our research ranges from the core topics of chemistry to applied science within in environmental, health, energy and materials. The Department has extensive contacts with industry, research and educational institutions at home and abroad. As partner in the Centre for Materials Science and Nanotechnology our researchers contributes to a significant interdisciplinary efforts in cooperation with the Department of Physics. The Department of Chemistry has its own school laboratory as a great resource for teachers, public outreach and the didactics of chemistry.

Du skal bl.a. have boet (uden afbrydelser) i Danmark de seneste 7 år. Alle over 18 år som har adresse på husstanden, bliver også tjekket.

Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler og fjerner opslaget, når rette kandidat er fundet. Vi modtager ikke ansøgninger på mail. Vi opfordrer dig til, at undlader foto på dit CV, da vi foretrækker en upartisk rekrutteringsproces.

jobs.title: Ready to make an impact on the green energy transition? Join Voith Hydro AS as our next HSE Manager!
jobs.description:
The Voith Hydro Division is a worldwide provider of hydropower technology and services. In Norway, Voith Hydro AS acts as a turnkey supplier of new hydropower facilities, power plant control systems, and modernization projects for turbines and generators, as well as comprehensive service and maintenance solutions. The company employs 173 people across its offices in Oslo, Trondheim, and Fredrikstad and reports annual revenues of NOK 580 million.

Voith Hydro AS is actively engaged in a broad portfolio of hydropower projects throughout Norway and has a strong outlook for the future. As part of our continued growth, we are expanding our HSE organization and are looking for an HSE Manager to join our team. Working in close collaboration with our existing HSE Manager, you will play a key role in promoting a strong safety culture and supporting the successful delivery of our projects.

Position: HSE Manager- Norway

Reporting Line: Managing Director Voith Hydro AS, and functionally to the Regional Head of HSE.

Role Purpose

The HSE Manager is responsible for implementing and continuously improving the VHE HSE Management System within the Norwegian organization and ensuring safe, compliant and efficient execution of all operational activities.

The role acts as the primary HSE advisor to the Managing Director, drives a Zero Incident culture, maintains a strong field presence, and ensures HSE is fully integrated into project delivery, field service, workshop activities and business operations.

Key Responsibilities

Leadership & Culture

  • Drive a proactive safety culture across the the company.

  • Lead implementation of VHE HSE standards, Life Saving Rules and STOP Work Authority.

  • Conduct regular sites, workshop and field service visits.

  • Challenge unsafe conditions, behaviors and decisions.

  • Coach leaders and employees to improve HSE performance.

  • Local functional leadership of HSE coordination function

Operational HSE Management

  • Ensure effective management of operational risks.

  • Verify implementation of critical risk controls.

  • Support safe execution of high-risk activities.

  • Manage contractor HSE performance.

Incident Management & Compliance

  • Lead incident investigations and root cause analyses.

  • Ensure effective corrective and preventive actions.

  • Develop meaningful Lessons Learned.

  • Ensure compliance with legal, customer and VHE HSE requirements.

  • Maintain and improve the local HSE Management System.

Performance & Reporting

  • Monitor and report HSE performance.

  • Identify trends, risks and improvement opportunities.

  • Provide transparent reporting to the Managing Director and Regional Head of HSE.

Qualifications & Experience

Essential

  • Degree in Engineering, HSE or related discipline.

  • NEBOSH IGC or equivalent.

  • Minimum 8 years HSE experience within hydropower, offshore oil & gas, offshore wind, energy, OEM, EPC or heavy industry.

  • Experience leading incident investigations and contractor management.

  • The successful candidate must demonstrate strong proficiency in Norwegian, both written and spoken, as this is essential for carrying out the responsibilities of the position.

Preferred

  • NEBOSH Diploma or equivalent Level 6 qualification.

  • ISO 45001 Lead Auditor qualification.

  • Formal incident investigation training.

  • Experience within major projects or high-risk operational environments.

Success Profile

The successful candidate:

  • Demonstrates visible HSE leadership and strong field presence.

  • Ensures uncompromised safe execution across all operations.

  • Leads high-quality investigations and organizational learning.

  • Acts as a trusted advisor and challenger to management.

  • Promotes a proactive Zero Incident culture.

  • Drives continuous improvement and sustainable HSE performance.

  • Demonstrates a collaborative, accountable and "walk the talk" leadership style

What We Offer

  • A meaningful career in the hydropower industry, supporting Norway's renewable energy sector. Our solutions ensure the reliable operation of critical infrastructure and contribute to the generation of clean, renewable energy.

  • The opportunity to make a real impact on how we develop, standardize, and modernize solutions for the hydropower plants of the future.

  • Interesting and challenging responsibilities in a multidisciplinary environment within hydropower and renewable energy.

  • Exciting professional and career development opportunities within a large international organization.

  • A collaborative and supportive work environment, combining strong technical expertise with an excellent team culture. We offer modern office facilities and a variety of social activities.

  • Competitive salary and benefits.

Diversity and Inclusion

We believe that diversity and inclusion make us stronger. We welcome applicants with different backgrounds, experiences, competencies, and perspectives, as we believe this contributes to better solutions and stronger teams.

Background Check

In accordance with regulations related to power-sector security and access to sensitive information, Voith Hydro AS uses Semac to conduct background checks on employees. Employment is therefore subject to a satisfactory background check.

Location

The preferred place of work is one of our offices in:

Oslo (Østre Aker Vei 90)

Trondheim (Sluppenvegen 25)

Travel Requerements

As part of this role, you should expect regular travel to customer sites and project's locations across Norway, as well as periodic travel between our office locations.

Industry Background

Experience from the hydropower industry is considered an advantage; however, candidates with relevant HSE experience from other industrial, energy, engineering, or infrastructure sectors are also encouraged to apply.

If this opportunity sounds like the right fit for you, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your CV and application through our recruitment portal. Please note that both your CV and application must be submitted in English.

For further information about the position, please contact: Siv-Anita Nilsen HR Manager Norway Phone: +47 920 64 300

Ready for your next challenge? Submit your CV and application and join us in shaping the future of hydropower.

jobs.title: Project Researcher (PhD. Student) or Postdoctoral Researcher, engine emission aftertreatment modelling, simulation, experiments and control (Energy Technology)
jobs.description:
The University of Vaasa is an inspiring and international community where we work together for a sustainable and responsible future. We combine expertise in business and technology in a unique way, tackling current challenges with determination and collaboration. As part of the Nordic regions largest energy technology hub, we promote sustainable business, energy, and society. We educate future professionals who will create a fairer and more sustainable world.

The position is offered initially for two (2) years starting on January 2027 or at an earliest possible date mutually agreed between both parties. The position is located in the School of Technology and Innovation and under energy technology discipline.

https://www.univaasa.fi/en/about/organisation/schools/technology-and-innovations/

Your role

You will be part of the Efficient Powertrain Solutions (EPS) Research group working on several challenging projects, at the forefront of research and development of novel combustion engine technologies. With over 40 researchers and 3 MEUR of annual research turnover, we are the biggest focused powertrain-oriented research group in Finland. Our focus is on model-based development of advanced engine solutions supporting our industry partners in conforming to tightening emissions and noise regulation in marine and off-road sectors.

Hydrogen represents a promising zero-carbon alternative fuel for large oceangoing vessels, where internal combustion engines are expected to remain a prime mover. Hydrogen-biogas combustion is a green solution in marine application, where the methane slip in exhaust gases is challenging to remove by catalytic and thermal management methods, which require further development. Methane is counted parallel to CO2 as a greenhouse gas, which emissions are regulated. In addition, significant challenges have restrained its large-scale onboard integration, catalyst durability, amid concerns related to safety, fuel availability, and cost. This research is related to green shift in off-road applications (marine, machinery), where conventional fossil fuels like diesel oil will be replaced with low-/zero-carbon fuels with flexible mixtures.

The new EU-funded [H4PERION](https://www.uwasa.fi/en/research/projects/h4perion-hydrogen-performance-enhancement-and-reliable-ice-operation) project directly addresses these barriers by developing a new ultra-efficient hydrogen-capable internal combustion engine (TRL 7, while meeting 55% thermal efficiency target), followed by concept integration at ship level through a pilot demonstration.

In this context as a part of the EPS team, you will contribute to:

- Developing novel catalytic methane removal solutions securing low pollutant emissions and flexible operation with hydrogen and other gaseous fuels.
- 1D modelling and simulations of catalytic aftertreatment systems based on engine-out emissions and experimental catalyst performance results.
- Experimental catalyst testing campaign in corresponding off-road application.
- Integrating the exhaust aftertreatment systems together with appropriate thermal and energy management strategies to ensure compliance with the projects emission and efficiency targets.

Achieving the targeted efficiency within the project timeline requires deep integration of catalyst simulation and testing environments with autonomous calibration routines. To this end we are seeking talented and motivated researchers in simulation-driven catalytic aftertreatment development and optimization.

All tasks are agreed in more detail in the Annual Work Plan. The annual working time is 1612 hours.

Requirements

- You have a masters degree or a PhD in a relevant field. For example chemical/mechanical/process engineering, with a specialization in emission catalyst reaction reactions/modelling or combustion engines.
- You have documented experience in 1D aftertreatment/combustion model calibration and validation with experimental data. Experience in 3D simulation environments is a benefit.
- You are able to efficiently plan and conduct engine laboratory experiments and postprocess emission data. Laboratory experience such as test-rig development, instrumentation, and data-acquisition is considered a strong advantage.
- Engine emission aftertreatment involves chemical reactions, as a result good knowledge on catalysts as well as chemical reaction mechanisms and kinetics is a benefit.
- Excellent analytical skills in addition to good academic writing skills are highly advantageous for your candidature.
- Proven track record in high-quality journals/conferences/projects on the topics related to the position, is an additional advantage.
- You enjoy developing innovative solutions to technically challenging problems and have the right mix of intellectual curiosity and practical pragmatism.
- You have good communication and language (English is required) skills and enjoy working both independently and as part of a team. You are open to sharing your knowledge with colleagues and ambitious to develop yourself as a researcher.

To be eligible for a full PhD student position, the candidate is required to participate in a separate application process which is arranged at least twice a year in order to be admitted and enrolled as a doctoral student at the University of Vaasa. For more information about eligibility and the application process, please visit the Graduate School's website: [Doctoral education | University of Vaasa (uwasa.fi)](https://www.uwasa.fi/en/education/doctoral-education)

Inspirational work environment

In the University of Vaasa, we conduct combustion engine research focused on advanced energy concepts and alternative fuels. We have a special focus on large bore-marine and stationary engines, for which we have a unique, state of the art, research facilities at EnergyLab. With close collaboration with industry, we are transforming the energy sector by bringing the cutting-edge technology to real-world application. We welcome you to join one of the most fascinating energy innovation centers in the Nordic region in combustion modelling and control. For more information about the facilities see: [EnergyLab](https://www.uwasa.fi/en/research/research-platforms/vebic/laboratories)https://www.uwasa.fi/en/newshub/news/university-vaasa-university-oulu-vtt-and-wartsila-are-building-energy-laboratoryhttps://w

jobs.title: Pitkäaikainen sijaisperhe huostaanotetuille nuorille/teineille
jobs.description:
Olisitko valmis auttamaan apua tarvitsevia nuoria tarjoamalla heille pitkäaikaisen kodin, tasapainoisen elinympäristön ja tukemalla heidän kasvuaan ja kehitystään? Sijaisperheenä pääset tekemään todella tärkeää työtä ja vaikuttamaan lapsen elämään kokonaisvaltaisesti. Tällä hetkellä tarvitaan erityisesti sijaisperheitä, joilla on mahdollisuus ottaa sijoitukseen teini-ikäisiä lapsia ja kykyä vastata heidän vaativiinkin tarpeisiinsa.

Sijaisperhe on perhe, joka antaa kodin lapselle, joka ei voi asua omassa kodissaan. Sijaisperhe huolehtii lapsen arjesta, kasvatuksesta ja hyvinvoinnista. Sijaisperheelle maksetaan palkkiota ja kulukorvausta jokaiselta kuukaudelta, kun sijoitettu lapsi asuu perheessä. Kuukausitulot riippuvat sijoitettujen lasten määrästä (alla olevan taulukon mukaisesti). Tulot kerryttävät eläkettä.

-Yksi lapsi: palkkio 2009 euroa, kulukorvaus 1035 euroa, yhteensä 3044 euroa
-Kaksi lasta: palkkio 4018 euroa, kulukorvaus 2071 euroa, yhteensä 6089 euroa
-Kolme lasta: palkkio 6027 euroa, kulukorvaus 3107 euroa, yhteensä 9134 euroa
-Neljä lasta: palkkio 8036 euroa, kulukorvaus 4143 euroa, yhteensä 12179 euroa

Ennen kuin voitte toimia sijaisperheenä, tulee teidän osallistua sijaisperhevalmennukseen. Haemme nyt sopivia perheitä tähän yksilöllisesti toteutettavaan valmennukseemme. Valmennus räätälöidään teille sopivaksi ja sen voi aloittaa sopimuksen mukaan, vaikka heti. Osa valmennustapaamisista on perhekohtaisia ja osa toteutuu ryhmässä muiden valmennettavien perheiden kanssa (etäyhteydellä). Valmennus on prosessi, jonka kesto on keskimäärin 5-7kk.

Perhehoitajana eli sijaisvanhempana toimiminen edellyttää:
-Ikä noin 25-60 vuotta. Tätä ikähaitaria voi hieman venyttää lapsen iästä riippuen, mutta ajatuksena on, että henkilön tulee olla kypsä päättämään pitkästä (mahdollisesti yli kymmenen vuoden) sitoutumisesta ja henkilön ei tulisi saavuttaa eläkeikää, ennen kuin lapsi on täysi-ikäinen.

-Vakaa talous ja elämäntilanne. Traumatisoituneiden ja erityistarpeisten lasten hoitaminen on vaativaa ja jos oma elämäntilanne ei ole tasapainossa, saattaa se vaikuttaa voimavaroihin ja kyvykkyyteen toimia sijaisperheenä.

-Ei mielenterveys-, päihde- eikä rikostaustaa. Nämä lienevät itsestään selviä esteitä.

-Sopiva asumismuoto. Teinille pitää pystyä järjestämään omaa huonetta.

Arvostamme seuraavia asioita, mutta tiedämme, ettei koko listan mukaista superperhettä välttämättä löydy. Ota siis rohkeasti yhteyttä, vaikkei jokainen kohta täyttyisi.
-Ei omia alle kouluikäisiä lapsia
-Kahden vanhemman perhe
-Mahdollisuutta auttaa kahta tai useampaa lasta (esim. sisarukset)
-Kokemusta erityisyydestä, esim. nepsyoireista, traumatyöskentelystä, oppimishäiriöistä
-Kokemusta kiintymyssuhteen rakentamisesta
-Kokemusta kasvatustyöstä
-Kokemusta lastensuojelusta

Työtä tukevia ammattikoulutuksia ovat esim. sosiaali- ja terveysalan- sekä kasvatustieteen koulutukset. Näiden lisäksi erilaiset terapeuttiset, ohjaukselliset ja psykiatriset lisäkoulutukset tarjoavat vahvaa tukea työssä menestymiseen. Virallista koulutusvaatimusta ei perhehoitajan työssä kuitenkaan ole.

Aikaisempi työkokemus voisi esimerkiksi olla joku näistä:
-Lastenkodin ohjaaja, perhetyöntekijä, sosiaaliohjaaja
-Opettaja, erityisopettaja, varhaiskasvatuksen opettaja
-Sairaanhoitaja, terveydenhoitaja
-Psykologi / psykoterapeutti / toimintaterapeutti
-Nuoriso-ohjaaja, yhteisöpedagogi
Tai muu vastaava työkokemus.

Perhehoitajan tehtävässä pärjää parhaiten, jos osaa nähdä lapsen mahdollisesti haastavan käytöksen taakse ja ymmärtää aiempien elämänkokemusten merkityksen lapsen kasvulle ja kehitykselle. Työssä tarvitaan joustavuutta ja valmiutta ymmärtää ja kohdata lapsen biologinen perhe ja suku, eli läheisverkostot. Tämä voi joskus olla haastavaa, koska lapsen sijoitus herättää vanhemmissa usein paljon tunteita. Työhön kuuluu myös yhteistyötä sosiaalitoimen sekä muiden viranomaisverkostojen kanssa. Sijoitettu lapsi tarvitsee turvallisen kodin, paljon aikuisen huomiota, säännöllisyyttä ja rutiineja sekä tietysti kiintymystä, läheisyyttä ja rakkautta. Lapsesta tulee vähitellen sijaisperheen tärkeä ja tasaveroinen perheenjäsen.

Sijaisperheen arki mukailee tavallista lapsiperhearkea, sisältäen arkea ja juhlaa, itkua ja naurua. Perheen toisen vanhemman tulee jäädä kotiin hoitamaan sijoitettua lasta/lapsia ainakin vuodeksi, jotta kiintymyssuhde ja asettuminen perheeseen mahdollistuu. Työn tukena on meiltä ammattitaitoinen tukityöntekijä, jonka kanssa käydään säännöllisesti läpi kuulumiset sekä paneudutaan lapsen asioihin myös syvällisemmin, lapsen yksilöllinen tilanne huomioiden. Kuljemme sijaisperheen rinnalla ja meille on tärkeää saavuttaa avoin ja luotettava yhteistyösuhde. Tukityömme on säännöllistä ja toteutuu puheluin ja kotikäynnein. Tukityön lisäksi tarjoamme perhehoitajillemme työnohjauksen ja lisäkoulutusmahdollisuuksia.

Suomen Perhekodit Oy on nuori suomalainen yritys. Valmennamme ja tuemme sijaisperheitä arjen tilanteissa, koko lapsen perheessä asumisen ajan. Huolehdimme byrokratiasta niin että sinä voit huolehtia lapsesta ilman turhaa stressiä. Olemme helposti lähestyttävä, ihmisläheinen ja aidosti lapsen asioista huolehtiva joukko. Verkkosivuiltamme löydät kattavat tiedot sijaisperheenä toimimisesta.

Ota yhteyttä, niin mietitään yhdessä, olisiko teidän perheenne sopiva sijaisperheeksi!

jobs.description:

-Vakaa talous ja elämäntilanne. Traumatisoituneiden ja erityistarpeisten lasten hoitaminen on vaativaa ja jos oma elämäntilanne ei ole tasapainossa, saattaa se vaikuttaa voimavaroihin ja kyvykkyyteen toimia sijaisperheenä.

jobs.title: Svensk/tvåspråkig fosterfamilj för omhändertagna barn
jobs.description:
Är du redo att hjälpa nödställda barn genom att erbjuda dem ett långvarigt hem, en stabil livsmiljö och stödja deras uppväxt och utveckling? Som fosterfamilj gör du ett viktigt arbete som påverkar ett barns liv på ett helhetsmässigt sätt. Just nu söker vi svensk- eller tvåspråkiga fosterfamiljer längs södra kusten.

En fosterfamilj är en familj som ger ett hem åt ett barn som inte kan bo med sin egen familj. Fosterfamiljen ansvarar för barnets vardag, uppfostran och välbefinnande. Fosterfamiljen får ett arvode och en ersättning för utgifter varje månad så länge barnet bor i familjen. Månadsinkomsten beror på hur många barn som är placerade i familjen (enligt tabellen nedan). Arvodet bidrar till din pension, precis som en normal lön.

Ett barn: arvode 2 009 euro, utgiftsersättning 1 035 euro, totalt 3 044 euro
Två barn: arvode 4 018 euro, utgiftsersättning 2 071 euro, totalt 6 089 euro
Tre barn: arvode 6 027 euro, utgiftsersättning 3 107 euro, totalt 9 134 euro
Fyra barn: arvode 8 036 euro, utgiftsersättning 4 143 euro, totalt 12 179 euro

Innan ni kan verka som fosterfamilj behöver ni delta i en förberedande utbildning. Vi söker nu lämpliga familjer till vår individuellt anpassade utbildning. Utbildningen skräddarsys efter era behov och kan börja enligt överenskommelse till och med omedelbart. Utbildningen är en process som i genomsnitt tar 5-7 månader.

Att vara familjevårdare, dvs. fosterförälder, kräver:
- Ålder cirka 2555 år. Åldersspannet är inte absolut, men tanken är att personen ska vara mogen att fatta ett långsiktigt beslut (möjligen över tio år) och inte nå pensionsåldern innan barnet blivit myndigt.

- Stabil ekonomi och livssituation. Att ta hand om traumatiserade barn eller barn med särskilda behov är krävande. Om den egna livssituationen inte är i balans, kan det påverka förmågan att fungera som fosterfamilj.

- Inga psykiska problem, missbruk eller brottslig bakgrund. Dessa ses som självklara hinder.

- Lämplig boendeform. Barnet behöver ett eget rum. För barn under skolåldern krävs kanske inte ett eget rum omedelbart, men från skolåldern ska barnet ha sitt eget utrymme.

Vi värdesätter följande, men vet att ingen är perfekt så hör gärna av dig även om inte allt stämmer in:
- Era egna barn är redan fyra år gamla eller äldre, helst redan i skolåldern
- Tvåföräldersfamilj
- Möjlighet att hjälpa två eller fler barn (t.ex. syskon)
- Erfarenhet av specialbehov, t.ex. neuropsykiatriska diagnoser, traumaarbete, inlärningssvårigheter
- Erfarenhet av uppfostran
- Eventuellt erfarenhet av barnskydd

Yrkesutbildningar som stöder uppdraget kan till exempel vara:
- Social- och hälsovård eller pedagogik
- Terapeutiska, handledande eller psykiatriska tilläggsutbildningar
- Det finns dock inget formellt utbildningskrav för familjevårdare.

Tidigare arbetslivserfarenhet kan exempelvis vara:
- Handledare på barnhem, familjearbetare, socialhandledare
- Lärare, speciallärare, lärare inom småbarnspedagogik
- Sjuksköterska, hälsovårdare
- Psykolog / psykoterapeut / arbetsterapeut
- Ungdomsledare, samhällspedagog
- Eller annan motsvarande erfarenhet

Som familjevårdare är det viktigt att kunna se bakom barnets eventuellt utmanande beteende och förstå hur tidigare livserfarenheter påverkat barnets utveckling. Arbetet kräver flexibilitet och beredskap att möta barnets biologiska familj och släktingar. Detta kan vara utmanande, eftersom placeringen ofta väcker starka känslor hos barnets föräldrar.

Arbetet sker i samarbete med socialtjänsten och andra myndigheter. Ett placerat barn behöver ett tryggt hem, mycket uppmärksamhet, rutiner, struktur, närhet och kärlek. Barnet blir gradvis en viktig och jämbördig medlem i fosterfamiljen.

Fosterfamiljens vardag liknar en vanlig familjs, fylld med både vardag och fest, tårar och skratt. Den ena föräldern bör stanna hemma i minst ett år, på samma sätt som man stannar hemma med egna barn i början.
Ni får stöd av en professionell stödperson från oss, som regelbundet följer upp situationen och går igenom barnets ärenden även på djupet, med hänsyn till barnets individuella situation. Vi finns där för fosterfamiljen och strävar efter ett öppet och förtroendefullt samarbete. Vårt stöd är regelbundet och sker via samtal, meddelanden och hembesök. Utöver detta erbjuder vi handledning i arbetet och fortbildningsmöjligheter för våra familjevårdare.

jobs.title: Asistent preventisty pro práci s dětmi a mládeží mimoškolních aktivit [m/ž], Ostatní pracovníci péče o děti v mimoškolských zařízeních
jobs.description:
[] Místo výkonu práce: Staré Křečany č.p. 39
407 61  Staré Křečany

Asistent preventisty jpodporuje praventistu při každodenní práci s dětmi a mládeží. Jeho role je zaměřena zejména na dostupnost pracovníků cílovou skupinu, navazování kontaktů, přitomnost v terénu a pomoc při realizaci aktivit. Důležitá schopnost vytvářet vztah, pracovat s neformální autoritou a budovat důvěru.

Základní předpoklady
• bezúhonnost;
• nejméně středoškolské vzdělání ukončené výučním listem;
• schopnost navazovat přirozený kontakt s dětmi a mladými lidmi;
• sspolehlivost, respektující komunikace a schopnost týmové práce;
• výhodou je znalost místního prostředí a místní komunity.

Hlavní činnosti
1. Podpora ternní práce
2. Podpora kroužků a komunitních aktivit
3. Motivace cílové skupiny
4. Práce s rodinami
5. Monitoring situace ve veřejném prostoru
6. Administrativní pomoc

Požadavky na uchazeče
• aktivní a vstřícný přístup k dětem a mladým lidem;
• schopnost pracovat s různorodou cílovou skupinou včetně dětí a mládeže ze sociálně vyloučeného prostředí;
• odolnost vůčui zátěži, schopnost zachovat klid v konfliktní nebo nepřehledné situaci;
• ochota pracovat také v odpoledních hodinách, případně při komunitních akcích podle harmonogramu projektu;
• schopnost vést požadovanou dokumentaci a předávat informace v rámci pracovního týmu;
• respektování pravidel bezpečnosti, ochrany dětí, mlšenlivoati a ochrany osobních údajů.

Výhody
• zkušenost s prací s dětmi, mládeží, komunitou nebo ve volnočasových aktivitách;
• zkušenost s preventivními programy, sportovními nebo kreativními aktivitami;
• zkušenost s prací v terénu nebo s osobami ohroženými sociálním vyloučením;
• kurzy nebo vzdělání v pedagogické, sociální, volnočasové, preventivní nebo odborné oblasti;
• řidičské oprávnění sk. B a aktivní řidič.

Zaměstnavatel nabízí
• pracovní poměr na plný úvazek v projektu zaměřeném na podporu dětí a mládže;
• smysluplnou práci s přímým dopadem na život místní komunity;
• apolupráci s preventistou, asistentem preventisty, sociálnm pracovníkem, školou, obcí a dalšími partnery;
• metodickou podporou a možnost dalšího vzdělání.
• platový tarif: 6. platová třída

Přihláška do výběrového řízení musí obsahovat
- jméno a příjmení, případně akademický titut
- datum narození,
- adresu bydliště,
- kontaktní telefon a e-mail,
- označení pracovní pozice nebo pozic o které se uchazeč uchází,
- datum a podpis uchazeče

K přihlášce uchazeč přiloží
• strukturovaný profesní životopis;
• motivační dopis se stručným uvedením zkušeností s prací s dětmi, mládeží nebo komunitou;
• kopii dokladu o nejvyšším dosaženém vzdělání;
• výpis z evidence Rejstříku trestů ne starší než 3 měsíce, případně čestné prohlášení o
bezúhonnosti s tím, že doklad bude vyžádán před uzavřením pracovního poměru;
• případně kopie osvědčení, kurzů nebo jiných dokladů prokazujících relevantní zkušenosti.

jobs.description:
33220   Obchodní zástupci
ZamK
Jsme největší velkoobchod a dovozce čerstvých květin a rostlin v České republice a hledáme novou posilu do našeho obchodního týmu. Máte obchod v krvi, cit pro krásu a touhu být nejlepší v tom, co děláte? Staňte se pánem svého regionu a pojďte prodávat radost!
Kdo jsme? Patříme ke špičce na trhu. Dovážíme čerstvé květiny z celého světa - od holandských tulipánů přes kolumbijské růže až po exotické květy z Thajska. Naší filozofií je slušnost, spolehlivost a rychlost. Zákazníci se na nás mohou spolehnout a vy se stanete klíčovou tváří této důvěry.
Co bude Vaší hlavní misí?
-Denní prodej a rozvoz našeho širokého sortimentu květin a rostlin.
-Péče o stávající zákazníky a budování nových pevných obchodních vztahů založených na důvěře.
-Vaším posláním bude dosahovat skvělých prodejních výsledků a aktivně se podílet na růstu celé firmy.
-Budete srdcem i duší obchodník, který plní prodejní cíle a roste společně s námi.
-Péče o svěřené zboží a sklad.
Co od Vás očekáváme?
-Obchodního ducha, vysoké pracovní nasazení a tah na branku.
-SŠ vzdělání - pozice je vhodná i pro šikovné absolventy SŠ, které si rádi zaučíme!
-Skvělé komunikační, organizační a reprezentační schopnosti.
-Samostatnost, spolehlivost a vysokou odolnost vůči stresu.
-Časovou flexibilitu.
-Řidičský průkaz sk. B je nutností, sk. C velkou výhodou.
Na co se můžete na oplátku těšit?
-Nadstandardní finanční ohodnocení: Fixní základ a atraktivní provize z prodeje, které vám umožní dosáhnout na příjem 30 000 až 65 000 Kč.
-Zázemí jedničky na trhu: Stanete se součástí stabilní a úspěšné společnosti.
-Profesionální zaškolení: Vše potřebné vás naučíme.
-Smysluplnou práci: Čeká vás zajímavá, samostatná a různorodá práce v přátelském kolektivu.
-Zaměstnanecké slevy na veškerý náš sortiment jsou samozřejmostí.
Termín nástupu: dohodou

možnost podílet se na dalším rozvoji MSPP v okrese Chrudim
práci v multidisciplinárním týmu s lidským a profesionálním přístupem

v oblasti vzdělávání Vám poskytneme široké možnosti a péči
kvalitní pracovní oděv a obuv, s outfitem si tedy nemusíte dělat starosti
stravenky ve formě stravenkového paušálu
a především – smysluplnou práci, která má hlubší význam

doklad o atestaci v některém ze základních oborů, které jsou vstupní pro nástavbový obor paliativní medicína dle zákona č. 95/2004 Sb. – zejména v oborech jako je vnitřní lékařství, geriatrie, psychiatrie, anesteziologie a intenzivní medicína, klinická a radiační onkologie, neurologie, chirurgie či všeobecné praktické lékařství a další odpovídající specializace
atestace v oboru paliativní medicína je výhodou, nikoliv podmínkou

řidičský průkaz skupiny B – není podmínkou
schopnost řádně vést příslušné evidence, uživatelská práce na PC
aktivní účast na supervizích
trestní bezúhonnost

BEZ ČEHO SE NEOBEJDEME?
empatie, vstřícnosti a respektu k pacientovi i jeho rodině
týmového ducha a schopnosti pracovat i samostatně
ochoty učit se a rozvíjet své dovednosti v oblasti paliativní péče

jobs.description:
About This Role

  • Enjoy a variety of field work and office-based work
  • Ongoing, Full Time Opportunity in Bendigo
  • Salary Range $72,189 - $79,753 plus superannuation

Do you have great communication skills and want to be a role model to people hoping for a second chance? If you want to make time to help people get their lives back on track, read on.

Who are we?

Community Work and Partnerships We are responsible for the development of mutually beneficial partnerships with government agencies and non-government organisations so that individuals can undertake unpaid work as part of their community-based sentence imposed by the Courts of Victoria. Community work serves as a valuable way for individuals to pay back the community while also reconnecting and reintegrating into the community. We ensure individuals make genuine efforts to undergo rehabilitation, and we keep low risk individuals out of prison and help them contribute to the community.

What does a Field Officer do?

Your primary responsibility as a Field Officer will be to supervise a team of clients at community work sites and other community work programs. A field officer carries out many duties and functions, mainly the supervision of individuals completing community work tasks. Other responsibilities include performing site inspections, assess hazards, providing informed workplace health and safety advice, guidance and instruction; maintaining tools and equipment resister and ensuring repairs are undertaken.

A day in the life of a Field Officer. . .

Your shift starts at a Justice Service Centre location where you collect a bus/ trailer with equipment. You then drive to a site to collect a group of clients, where you will induct, instruct and transport them to a partner not-for-profit organisation in the community. Tasks for the day may involve graffiti removal, painting, litter collection, mowing and weeding. Your responsibility is to instruct the individuals to safely perform each task and monitor the work performed for the partner site before returning them to the drop off point and returning to your depot.

We are looking for individuals with various backgrounds and experience. Some desirable skills include:

  • You'll need to be able to communicate and demonstrate a range of tasks and ensure a safe environment for work teams.
  • Have a strong understanding of Occupational Health and Safety practices and their practical application.
  • Quickly build rapport in order to understand the motivations of others, identify issues and suggest courses of action appropriate to their needs.
  • Have demonstrated ability to manage conflict and strong problem-solving skills.
  • Model appropriate behaviours and attitudes to assist individuals to develop new skills and work practices.
  • Carpentry or handyman skills
  • Gardening landscaping or painting skills

Field Officers carry out a mixture of field work and office-based work, so it's important that you are able to demonstrate computer skills and written communication skills.

Transporting individuals is also a key part of the role and Field Officers will be required to drive a 12-seater bus with trailer. A full and current drivers' licence is essential for this position.

Community Work operates seven days per week and this role will be required to work on weekends. Weekend availability is required.

For More Information About The Role Please Contact

Sarah Thompson â Manager, Community Work & Partnerships on 0407 427 396 or Sarah.Thompson@justice.vic.gov.au

How To Apply

Please click the Apply button at the bottom of this advertisement. Applications should include a resume uploaded in .doc, .docx, .pdf, .txt or .rtf formats.

The Assessment Process Will Entail The Following

  • Several questions in the application form upon submitting your resume
  • A phone screen
  • An interview
  • Reference checks
  • Security checks
  • Health assessment â medical history and physical fitness components

The successful candidate will be required to undergo pre-employment checks which may include reference checks, nationally coordinated criminal history checks (NCCHC), and misconduct screening. Dependant on the role, other checks may include VicRoads checks, drivers licence checks, medical checks, Working with Children Checks, and Declaration of Private Interests (for executive and responsible officer roles).

If you require adjustments to the recruitment and selection process, or require an alternative format to any of the application material, please don't hesitate to get in touch with the contact person listed on this ad.

Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander people are strongly encouraged to apply.

Child Safe Statement Of Commitment

The Department of Justice and Community Safety is committed to the safety and wellbeing of children and young people. We seek to prevent harm of any kind impacting children and young people and have zero tolerance for racism, child abuse and inequality. Children and young people's rights, relationships, identity, and culture must be recognised and respected, their voices heard, and their concerns acted upon. We aim to foster a culturally safe, child safe and child friendly environment for all children and young people we have contact with, deliver services to, or are impacted by our work.

jobs.title: Business Operations & Strategy Lead
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

This is an opportunity to serve as a key partner and advisor on Notion's Business Operations team, working primarily with our Engineering, Product, and Design teams. Business Operations is a cross-functional team that partners with senior leaders across the company, focusing on high-impact strategic projects and analysis.

In this role, you'll independently identify the highest-leverage opportunities, define the problem, drive execution, and keep going. If you thrive when given full ownership and a blank page, this role is for you. You'll work hand-in-hand with senior leadership to identify, structure, and act on the most challenging strategic and operational questions impacting our business. And you’ll use AI to build scalable systems and processes that multiply your impact.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Proactively surface and prioritize high-impact strategic and operational opportunities and own them end-to-end from scoping through execution

 - Work cross-functionally with product, engineering, and go-to-market leaders to define and implement strategy across all Notion products, driving increased value for our users, our customers, and our business

 - Structure complex, ambiguous strategic problems for the Notion leadership team, defining clear hypotheses and building business cases and quantitative models that will inform and influence our approach

 - Work closely with cross-functional leaders to define and manage key drivers of business performance, identifying areas of opportunity and incorporating them into your work

 - Develop a comprehensive understanding of our competitive positioning by using, assessing, and developing insights about peer businesses to inform your recommendations

 - Deeply understand Notion customers and the broader market landscape to uncover insights that inform your recommendations

 - Use AI tools and drive automation to create scalable solutions that combine a broad vision for what is possible with an understanding of the practical demands that constrain them




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - 10+ years of strategy experience, with 5+ years’ relevant experience in management consulting, investment banking, or related professional services fields

 - Highly structured mindset with a strong focus on driving outcomes and turning data into actionable insights

 - Excellent financial modeling skills, with strong attention to detail and high standards for quality

 - Outstanding executive-level written and verbal communication skills

 - Ability to operate independently with senior stakeholders and manage relationships, deliverables, and timelines with minimal supervision

 - Genuine enthusiasm for and proficiency with AI tools; we use AI across the board to move faster and work smarter, and you do too

 - Hands-on experience with modern AI tools like Notion AI, Claude, Codex, or similar is expected; you should be actively experimenting with new models and workflows, not just aware they exist

 - Deep understanding of AI SaaS business models, monetization strategies, and pricing frameworks, or a strong demonstrated ability to get up to speed quickly

 - Data self-sufficiency; knowledge of SQL is required

 - Comfort working in a high-growth, constantly changing environment with passion and enthusiasm

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results




NICE TO HAVES

 - Prior experience in strategy and operations in B2B SaaS businesses

 - Prior people management experience

 - Proficiency in Python or R for data analysis and modeling



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $230,000 - $260,000 per year.

A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Vous participerez à l'organisation, à la planification et à la mise en œuvre des activités, animations et évènements destinés au personnel du ministère des Armées et à leurs familles. Nous recherchons un agent bénéficiant d'une expérience dans un environnement militaire, de même une expérience dans le domaine sportif ou touristique serait appréciée.

Vous êtes particulièrement sensible aux enjeux de cohésion et de soutien du personnel militaire et avez, de plus, un excellent relationnel et une capacité d'adaptation.
Vous êtes polyvalent et disposez de bonnes aptitudes techniques, lesquelles vous permettront d'être en capacité d'assurer des travaux courants d'entretien et de maintenance des installations.
Vous possédez également des compétences en informatique et dans le domaine administratif.

jobs.title: Chief of Staff, Sales
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As Chief of Staff you'll be the strategic copilot to Notion's Global Head of Sales. You'll work directly with our Global Head of Sales on the complex problems and decisions that drive our sales engine.



You'll thrive in this role if you enjoy being at the center of global sales strategy. Whether that's preparing for board meetings, facilitating cross-functional alignment, or representing the sales organization with key stakeholders.



We're looking for someone who gets energized by revolutionary sales challenges like balancing self-serve and enterprise motions, transforming our business motions internally and externally with AI, and identifying new market opportunities. If you can seamlessly shift between analyzing business metrics, facilitating executive decision-making, and strong project management execution - this role is for you! We’re looking for someone who is low ego, high motor, excited to roll up their sleeves, and ready to make an impact!

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Serve as the Global Head of Sales’ trusted partner. You'll help prepare for board meetings, facilitate executive decision-making, and represent the sales org with internal & external stakeholders.

 - Act as a strategic connector for the Sales organization. You'll use your cross-functional knowledge to identify trends, connect dots for stakeholders, and drive increased alignment between teams. This includes working across GTM teams as well as with close partners in EPD, Finance, People, and Legal.

 - Lead cross-functional projects. You'll run cross functional projects and forums to increase alignment for sales. This includes leading our sales organization planning and reporting.

 - Identify and drive forward global sales strategy. You’ll run analysis on the Notion business and opportunities to deepen customer deployments. Through this work you’ll identify opportunities and provide recommendations for the sales business as it continues to grow and scale. In some cases you’ll own the execution of the strategy too.

 - Drive our rhythm of business. You’ll play a key role in driving the weekly sales Leads meeting, spearheading quarterly Sales Lead offsites, and working closely with the Global Head of Sales on regular communications to the sales org.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 8+ years experience in senior sales or sales adjacent leadership roles

 - You have previously worked with, advised, and influenced senior executives

 - You seamlessly swap back and forth between strategic thinking and operational details

 - You’re extremely organized and strong in project management - experience leading initiatives from inception through execution

 - You dive deep into projects individually as well as know when to delegate and empower teammates

 - You’re a pace setter, you have previous success operating in fast paced B2B SaaS environments

 - You’re strong and comfortable with both written and verbal communications, a super power is making complex topics sound simple

 - You’re a self starter, you don’t ask for permission - you make it happen

 - You’re a problem solver who leverages first principles thinking and focuses on what’s best for Notion and our customers

 - You’ve started to adopt AI to help you spend more time on the work that matters




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Background in management consulting, strategy, or operations

 - Experience working in GTM or directly reporting to the C-suite

 - Experience driving initiatives that serve both PLG and Enterprise Sales motions

 - Familiar with using Notion as a product

 - AI power user
   
   

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is $230,000 - $280,000 per year.

#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.

jobs.description: Project Manager - Cantieri navali Nuove Costruzioni L'Azienda Il nostro cliente è uno storico cantiere navale genovese con un consolidato know how nella riparazione e costruzione navale. Il ruolo Nell'ambito dello sviluppo del business delle nuove costruzioni, siamo alla ricerca di un Project Manager che segua la realizzazione delle commesse dalla fase di avvio fino alla consegna finale, garantendo il raggiungimento degli obiettivi contrattuali, tecnici, economici, temporali e qualitativi. Opererà come principale punto di riferimento verso Direzione, Cliente e funzioni interne, coordinando in modo strategico e gestionale tutte le attività necessarie alla corretta esecuzione del progetto. Principali responsabilità Gestire l'intero ciclo di vita della commessa di nuova costruzione, dall'avvio alla consegna finale dell'unità. Pianificare e monitorare il programma generale di commessa, assicurando milestone e scadenze contrattuali. Coordinare funzioni interne e stakeholder (Ufficio Tecnico, Produzione, Procurement, Qualità, HSE, AFC/Controllo di Gestione). Gestire la parte economica della commessa: predisposizione e monitoraggio di budget/forecast, controllo costi, cash flow, analisi scostamenti e azioni correttive a tutela della marginalità. Selezionare e gestire fornitori/subappaltatori/partner: valutazione offerte, controllo prestazioni e gestione criticità/ritardi. jobs.title: Telecom Lead (m/f)
jobs.description:
Telecom Lead

Role Summary

The Telecom Lead is responsible for leading and growing OQ Technology's telecom engineering team and for the technical direction of the end-to-end telecommunication system that underpins the Company's 3GPP-based 4G/5G Non-Terrestrial Network (NTN). The role brings together the Core Network, physical-layer/DSP, and protocol-stack disciplines into a single, coherent engineering roadmap, and holds ultimate accountability for the architecture, quality, and delivery of the telecommunication stack from research and prototyping through to operational deployment on the Company's satellite missions.

The Telecom Lead manages the Senior Core Network Engineer, Core Network Engineer, DSP Algorithm Engineer, Telecom Engineer, and any other engineers assigned to the telecom function, setting priorities, allocating work, developing technical talent, and acting as the primary point of technical and people- management accountability for the team. The Company may assign the Employee to any other job or tasks if it believes it is in its best interests to do so.

Key Responsibilities

The list below is representative and not exhaustive of the tasks and responsibilities of the role.

• Lead, manage, and grow the telecom engineering team, providing day-to-day direction, coaching, and performance management.
• Plan resourcing and recruitment for the team, define roles and career paths, and build the technical bench
strength required to deliver the Company's telecommunication roadmap.
• Foster a collaborative, high-performance engineering culture across the core network, DSP/physical layer, and protocol-stack disciplines, and ensure effective knowledge-sharing between them.
• Own the technical onboarding of new engineers and ensure consistent engineering standards, coding practices, and design-review discipline across the team.

Technical Ownership and Architecture

• Hold overall technical authority for the architecture and evolution of OQ Technology's telecommunication
system, spanning the Core Network, the physical layer/DSP chain, and the NB-IoT/LTE/NR protocol stack adapted for NTN.
• Define the technical roadmap and research strategy for new functions, algorithms, and system architectures for 4G/5G communication over Non-Terrestrial Networks, and align it with the Company's product and mission timelines.
• Review and approve system-level designs, ensuring consistency and interoperability across core network, baseband/DSP, and protocol-stack workstreams, and across the space, ground, and user segments.
• Set and enforce engineering standards, design-review practices, and quality gates for networking architectures and control algorithms against latency, high-availability, and Quality of Experience requirements, from prototype through operational deployment.
• Own system performance models and lead cross-functional systems-engineering activities related to end-to end system performance optimisation.
• Guide the design and implementation of microservices-based, real-time and near real-time applications, and of DSP algorithms and baseband processing for the telecommunication payload and user terminals.
• Oversee the development, optimisation, and continuous upgrade of the protocol stack(s) supporting current and future missions, ensuring features are delivered against space and product team requirements.
• Approve subsystem budgets and specifications, and confirm regulatory and mission compliance in coordination with the systems engineering team.

Delivery, Testing, and Operations

• Direct the full development lifecycle across the team, from concept, prototyping, and proof-of-concept experimentation through implementation, verification, integration, and deployment.
• Ensure rigorous validation of telecommunication software and hardware features through simulation, lab testing, and end-to-end testing in simulated NTN environments.
• Oversee the maintenance, upgrade, and improvement of the internal telecommunications and RF lab, and ensure appropriate configuration control and version management of all deliverables.
• Support the space team with authoritative technical inputs for the design, optimisation, and maintenance of Operational and Demo Missions, including mission needs, expected performance, dependability, and safety goals.
• Own the resolution of escalations and cross-team technical blockers, and ensure timely, transparent reporting of progress and risks to senior management.

Stakeholder, Partner, and Standards Engagement

• Lead technical discussions and negotiations with external suppliers, MNO/MVNO partners, contractors, and research institutes, including evaluation of designs and acceptance of deliverables.
• Represent the Company in standardisation bodies and lead the Company's technical contributions to relevant standardisation activities.
• Own or contribute to technical documentation for project reviews, including ESA-related deliverables, and defend designs at formal project and customer reviews.
• Work with and support teams across OQ Subsidiaries and manage technical interfaces with external partners and contracting organisations.

Planning and Reporting

• Participate in project management and planning activities, including proposals, roadmaps, budgets, and resourcing for the telecom engineering function.
• Provide regular reporting on team progress, technical risks, and delivery status to the Head of Engineering / CTO and other stakeholders.
• Ensure proper documentation of all technology development undertaken by the team and maintain traceability for audits and project reviews.

Requirements

Education

• Master's degree (or higher) in Telecommunications Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field. A PhD is a plus.

Experience

• Significant professional experience (typically 8+ years) in telecommunications engineering, spanning at least two of the following domains: core network (EPC/5GC), physical layer/DSP, or protocol stack development.
• Proven experience leading or mentoring engineering teams, including performance management, technical coaching, and resource planning.
• Hands-on experience with 3GPP-based 4G/5G systems; experience with Non-Terrestrial Networks (NTN) or satellite communications is highly desirable.
• Experience engaging with standardisation bodies (3GPP, GSMA, ITU) and managing relationships with external suppliers, MNO/MVNO partners, or research institutes.
• Track record of taking systems from research/prototype through to operational deployment, including verification and validation in lab and field environments.

Technical Skills

• Strong knowledge of Core Network architecture and functions (MME, SPGW, HSS, OAM, IREG, IPX, BCE) and of NFV/microservices-based network applications.
• Solid understanding of physical-layer and DSP concepts (modem design, baseband processing, transceiver architecture) and of the NB-IoT/LTE/NR protocol stack.
• Proficiency with relevant development and simulation tools (e.g. C/C++, MATLAB, VHDL) and with CI/CD and version-control tools (e.g. Git).
• Familiarity with systems-engineering practices, including requirements derivation, performance modelling,and subsystem budgeting (e.g. RF link and power budgets).

Leadership and Personal Skills

• Excellent leadership, coaching, and people-management skills, with the ability to develop technical talent and build a high-performing team.
• Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills, able to engage effectively with senior management, external partners, and standardisation bodies.
• Strong organisational and prioritisation skills, able to balance strategic technical direction with hands-on problem-solving when required.
• Fluent in English (written and spoken); additional languages are a plus.
• Willingness to travel occasionally for partner, supplier, or standardisation meetings

This role will support the day-to-day running of the Distribution Support team. Summary:

The Associate – Corporate Secretarial Services will be an integral part of the team's success. This role is responsible for working on a single client relationship, with a complex portfolio of underlying client entities (ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, overseeing corporate documentation and supporting board governance processes) and assisting with the delivery of services within a team. Key responsibilities include maintaining statutory records, managing company lifecycle events and operations. • Draft, finalise and manage resolutions and other corporate documentation;
• Prioritise workload effectively, identifying and escalating scheduling conflicts or delays as needed;
• Monitor task tracking systems to ensure timely completion of responsibilities;

• Provide support to colleagues when capacity allows and communicate availability to management;
• Assist with inbox monitoring and task processing during team absences;
• Participate in team projects as directed by management;
• Professionally and independently liaise with fund service providers and clients;

• You have a minimum of 2 years of experience in company secretarial roles.

jobs.title: Commercial Counsel
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

We are looking for an experienced attorney to join our Commercial Counsel team. This senior role will help build and support Notion’s rapidly evolving Enterprise customer sales motions, bringing deep expertise in negotiating complex AI SaaS agreements with enterprise customers, as well as acting as an advisor and coach to our account teams and cross functional partners. Notion is scaling rapidly, and we need people who work well as a tight-knit team with a passion for driving revenue deals to conclusion. If you enjoy using your deep industry and technology transaction expertise to support revenue generating functions, this role is for you.


Our Commercial Legal team sits at the center of Notion’s growth. We simplify how customers contract with us, take clear and unambiguous positions on AI, privacy, and security, and drive revenue deals to a fast, predictable close. That means exercising real judgment and finding creative, pragmatic paths forward through complex customer requests and requirements.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Have broad responsibility for negotiating SaaS AI agreements and providing practical day-to-day commercial legal support - primarily in the Americas region - for the sales, marketing, channels, and customer success teams with a focus on supporting the Enterprise segment

 - Collaborate with Product Legal team on product and operational items that impact customer agreements and go-to-market initiatives

 - Draft and negotiate complex agreements regarding privacy, security, and AI regulatory matters

 - Identify and independently pursue process improvements for buy-side supporting motions

 - Develop and revise contract templates and playbooks as necessary, based on changes in our product offerings, organization, and law




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Admitted to the California State Bar, New York State Bar, or Registered In-House Counsel in good standing

 - 10+ years of combined experience practicing as a commercial attorney within a law firm or software technology company

 - 2+ years in-house experience at a SaaS and/or AI technology company

 - Privacy and artificial intelligence subject matter expertise, including privacy regulations (GDPR, e-Privacy Directive, CCPA, etc.) and AI regulations (EU AI Act) with the ability to incorporate evolving requirements into the customer facing agreements

 - Experience driving commercial transactions, SaaS, and enterprise B2B transactions

 - Strong negotiation skills, including ability to explain nuanced legal concepts to internal and external parties and tailor approach to the audience

 - Excellent drafting, written and verbal communication skills and ability to adapt legal requirements in balanced, creative and pragmatic ways to facilitate communication at all levels of the organization

 - Ability to directly interact and build meaningful relationships and trust with internal and external clients and leaders

 - Demonstrated curiosity about AI and a willingness to adopt AI tools to work smarter, move faster, and deliver better results. Developing your personal AI fluency is required for this role

 - Resilience, resourcefulness, and the ability to make recommendations and decisions with imperfect facts

 - Independent and strategic thought combined with excellent team player qualities and a willingness to take on additional responsibilities




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Certified Information Privacy Professional or equivalent

 - Prior experience with a fast growing technology company

 - Experience supporting channel and reseller partnerships

 - Experience supporting customers in the financial services industry

 - Familiarity using Notion



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $280,000-340,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528.



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. jobs.description:
At Damia Group Portugal (Permanent)Portugal
Expires at: 2027-05-12
Remote policy: Full remoteAbout the company: Damia Group is an international tech recruitment agency with 3 decades of experience. Our arrival in Portugal, 7 years later, was set on a mission to transform IT recruitment experiences and, through them, achieve better results. We believe in long-term relationships with a transparent and relaxed mindset. In a short period, we have reached the hearts of both scale-ups and larger organisations by delivering spot-on curated candidate shortlists, increased job offer acceptance rates and shorter time-to-fill.

Main requirements

Role OverviewThis is a senior, hands-on role for someone who views Data Infrastructure as a product.You will define how billions of records are structured, indexed, and exposed to the rest of the company. Ideal for someone who combines strong backend engineering skills with deep expertise in data platforms, data lakes, and large-scale data systems. Key Responsibilities

-
Database Reliability & Scaling:

- Own the health and performance of their core databases.
- Own and optimize their MongoDB clusters and OpenSearch indexes, which houses billions of documents. You will design sharding strategies and indexing patterns to ensure search performance.
- Design and implement a multi-tier storage strategy. You will determine which data remains "hot" in production databases for their Product team and which data is offloaded to "cold/analytical" storage for AI and R&D.
-
Data Access Layer:

- Build and maintain internal APIs that allow internal teams to build features without worrying about the underlying database complexities.
-
Schema Evolution & Migrations:

- Lead the strategy for updating data structures across billions of records. You will design "no-downtime" migration paths for their production MongoDB and OpenSearch environments.
-
Data Platform & Architecture

- Own and evolve their Core Data Architecture, ensuring it supports analytics, product features, AI workflows, and internal consumption.
- Evaluate the feasibility and ROI of introducing a Data Lakehouse architecture for long-term storage and AI training.
- Define standards for how data is ingested, stored, versioned, and exposed to downstream systems.
-
Data Quality & Documentation:

- Ensure data accuracy, freshness, and consistency through validation and testing.
- Maintain clear, up-to-date documentation of pipelines, schemas, and data assets to enable internal adoption.
-
Collaboration:

- Act as a bridge between Core, Product, and R&D, ensuring research initiatives (e.g. data enrichment) are integrated into the Core platform.
- Translate business and product needs into scalable, maintainable data solutions.
- Comfortable working in async-first environments, keeping task statuses and documentation up to date for full team visibility.

What They're Looking For

- 5+ years of experience in Backend, Data Engineering and/or Data Platform roles, specifically within high-concurrency/high-volume environments.
-
NoSQL & Search Expert. Professional experience tuning MongoDB and OpenSearch/Elasticsearch at massive scale (sharding, cluster topology, query optimization).

-
Strong Python Skills. Proficiency in writing production-grade, highly efficient Python. Experience with asynchronous programming (FastAPI, etc.) for building high-performance Internal APIs is essential.

-
System Design & Architecture. A strong grasp of distributed systems, including eventual consistency, message queues (Kafka/RabbitMQ), and caching strategies to protect production databases.

-
Strategic Storage Thinking. Familiarity with Data Lakehouse concepts (e.g., Parquet, Delta Lake, Iceberg). Proven experience building one.

- Excellent communication skills and attention to documentation.
- Self-managed and comfortable working cross-functionally.
- Fluent in English.
- Tax residency in Portugal.
